chapters.title: Chapter 251: Childish
paragraphs: "Yes, my lord, that place became too chaotic after you were gone. No one dared to attack it when you were still alive, but a lot of demons attacked us to steal whatever they could, so we had no choice but to leave that realm, taking whatever important we could," Thaddeus said, his eyes burning with hatred.
"So where is everyone staying at currently?" he continued, while also showing anger.

"With the help of your close friend, Demon Lord Skum Bo, we were able to find a different realm a bit further away but safer. We named it The Voromir Kingdom. It is located outside of this Topaz Continent, so do you—" Silquor was speaking, but Vritra raised his hand to stop him.
’I am planning to go to the White Kingdom and then leave the Topaz Continent after that, but traveling with these demons would undoubtedly bring more trouble.
Like Yennefer almost recognized me, but thankfully she thought I only possessed dragon physique and bloodline.’ Vritra began pondering and finally spoke:

"I am heading outside of this continent as well, but I don’t think it would be good for us to travel together. That way I won’t be able to grow as fast, and I have a few plans of my own. So why don’t we just meet outside? But when I need to call you, how can I contact the three of you?" Vritra asked.
"You are indeed correct. Oh right—" Morvik hastily took out a big pouch that seemed to be filled with dozens of glyphs. He handed them to Vritra and said:
"You can keep these. Whenever you crush one of these glyphs, we will be teleported to your location. We had bought these to keep the people of our realm safe."
Vritra nodded and put them away into his inventory. Then, after a moment, he asked: "Are you carrying some soul potions? My soul is still weak and needs a lot of them."
"Ah, we aren’t carrying too much, but this is all we have." The three generals took out bottles upon bottles of soul potions from their storage glyphs and lined them over the ground.

’This isn’t too much? This stash is even bigger than the one in the Dunshire Kingdom. Haa, so my slaves are rich.’ Vritra smiled as he swiftly put them all away and then said: "Sigh, what a pity, it is too little. Try to gather as much as you can in the future."
"Yes, lord. We will collect enough soul potions to heal your soul as soon as possible," the three generals said at the same time.
"Alright, that’s all for now. Do whatever you wish and don’t get caught. We will be meeting again very soon." Vritra said as he waved his hand. After a respectful bow, the three of them disappeared.
"Now that was a profit, getting three powerful slaves just like that." Yasmine laughed, her man had fooled the generals way too easily.

"Yeah, this is nice. My preparations for the next adventure are going well. I have entered 2nd Legion ranks, my soul wraiths are growing rapidly, I have got three powerful demon generals as my loyal slaves, and not to mention a waifu who supports me through thick and thin." Vritra muttered.
Except for Misty Essence, there wasn’t any reason for him to stay here.

"I wonder if we will be killing the king of the White Kingdom or not, but based on your luck I won’t be surprised even if you two had become enemies without even meeting once." Yasmine said, she had already gotten used to such occurrences now.
No matter what schemes, battles, wars, trouble—literally anything related to chaos—just won’t be possible if Vritra isn’t involved in it.
"Anyway, let’s go back." Vritra said. He finally deactivated the Shift skill and felt weakness surrounding him, though it wouldn’t last too long and he still had around half his strength.
While talking, the two were going back, their playful banter continued, filled with teasing and jokes.

Just then, Vritra noticed a demon walking around a desolate part of the forest. It was only at around level 300. With just a thought, a needle of dust flew towards the demon at high speed and pierced through its head, killing it immediately.
A couple of messages appeared in front of him, but Vritra continued ahead until he noticed something on the ground at the place where the demon was just killed.

It was a beautiful round stone with a pinkish shade, and eyes and a mouth were carved over it just like Zengis. Vritra had killed many before, but he didn’t get any similar drop again. After pausing, he flew down and landed beside the corpse of the demon.

Vritra picked the stone and looked over it, then he nodded: "I approve of you to be my best friend’s girlfriend. So Pinky, meet my friend Zengis." Vritra brought Zengis out and allowed the two of them to meet.
"What am I even watching right now? Is this a dollhouse show but with stones? I thought you had already gotten over your best friend thing—" Yasmine said in exasperation.

"Wifey, don’t say anything about my friend. He had been with me even before you. I would have really given up if I didn’t have anyone to talk to, so even if Zengis is just a stone, we are best friends for life." Vritra said in a solemn tone.

"Uh... Okay hubby, then congratulations Zengis and Pinky. When are you guys going to hold your wedding? Hehe, and don’t delay having babies. Hubby, wouldn’t that be great when our babies play with Zengis’s and Pinky’s babies?" Yasmine spoke, her tone mischievous.
Vritra rolled his eyes, then he muttered: "Zengis, I have fulfilled my promise finally. I got such a beautiful girl for you. Take care of her."
Then he put them back into the inventory together.
Finally, Vritra flew away from there, while Yasmine continued with the same topic the entire way—talking about how Zengis should go on a honeymoon or earn some money, or their future, and so on.

It was late in the night when Vritra arrived back in the castle. Vanessa was still waiting for him. They had slept quite long during the day, so she wasn’t sleepy. After seeing Vritra appear in the room like a ghost, she stood up and walked closer to him.
"Honey, did everything go alright?" Vanessa asked, putting her arms over his shoulder and pressing her body against his.
"Yes mom, it went better than expected." Vritra replied and added: "See who I brought today."
He took out Zengis and Pinky, and showed them to Vanessa.
"Oh, it looks like such a nice pair. They look good together." Vanessa said with a beautiful smile.
’See? That’s a normal reaction.’ Vritra spoke in his mind.
"Yeah yeah, I am the abnormal one here..." Yasmine shook her head.
After putting them back in his inventory, Vritra and Vanessa climbed onto the bed and slipped under the sheet after throwing away their clothes.
None of them were going to sleep in the remaining part of the night—they hadn’t trained together in a while, after all.
Vanessa climbed on top of Vritra and started kissing him, while grinding her vagina on top of his member.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Most wonderful, intelligent, talented and...
paragraphs: The pair of mother and son went at their training for several hours and then slept for a little while, embracing each other comfortably.

The next morning, Vritra woke up a bit late. Instead of going to the Small Forest where danger might still be lingering, he decided to let Fiona and the others train in one of the training areas of the castle.
They gathered at the dining table to have breakfast together, and Vritra explained the plan to all the women.
After breakfast, he wanted to meet the crown prince to arrange a training area for them all, but the crown prince seemed to be cooped up in his room.

He barely ever came out, so Vritra just asked one of the guards to bring them to a training area. After going there, he locked the area so that no one would be able to see anything, then he sent Ghost, Ghoul, and Psyche to bring demons for the three women to fight.

Bringing the demons into the castle wasn’t too hard for such strong soul wraiths. And currently, Fiona had become the strongest of the three; she could solo kill all the demons that were brought here.
He sat over a chair not too far away and watched his mother, Fiona, and Diana fight against the demons. While observing them, Vritra pondered about something and asked:
’That Field thing, how do I learn or use that?’

"You have to select a particular ability, element, or something else and then comprehend it; not just in practice but theory as well. You must have a deeper understanding of that thing," Yasmine explained simply.
’Does it even have any benefit?’ Vritra questioned.
"Of course, your Field could bring wonderful transformations. It could grow in unimaginable ways. Without a doubt, they would increase your strength.
A person with a stronger Field would always be the winner, even if the other person is a level or two higher.
Not to mention, in the future, your Field will transform into a domain. Have you thought about what sort of Field you plan to comprehend?" she answered.
’Hmm, I am thinking of Null, but I am not exactly sure... can a person have two Fields?’ he asked after thinking for a moment.
"In theory, yes, but under the rarest of combinations and possibilities. Still, I have never heard of anything like that before," Yasmine replied.

’...’ For some reason, after seeing a few parts of Yasmine’s past, he felt that she just might be the one with two Fields. It was just a feeling, but all the trouble that befell her family had something to do with her Field.
And he didn’t believe that a Fire Field—although very strong—could be the reason behind all that.
Maybe her parents were aware of it and tried to hide it from everyone, but of course, they weren’t very successful. In the end, she lost both her parents and barely managed to preserve her own life.
Yasmine spoke and brought him out of his thoughts:
"Null is too complicated. It compromises the ability of time, but there is more to it. The Scarlet Couple were only able to use Time ability to some extent.

Even they didn’t dare to use it as their Field, and now Yennefer must already have a Field so she can’t change it. Anyway, what I want to say is, you might find extreme challenges, dangers, and failures if you really follow this path."
’... I understand. I still want to give it a try. Null... let’s start with time then.’ Vritra made up his mind, but this was no place to train Null and experiment.
’Oh right, at what level can one turn their Fields into domains?’ Vritra asked. There was still so much left in this new world to know about.

"Once you enter the 7th Legion rank. Well, by the 5th Legion rank, you should get as close to the perfection of your Field as you can, though only very, very few could reach that perfection state—one in a hundred million, or even a thousand million. Then you start molding it into your domain," she replied.
’Did you reach perfection?’ Vritra followed with another question.
"Heh, ask anyone who is the youngest to ever achieve the Perfect Field throughout the entire history till the present," Yasmine said, her voice full of confidence.
"Is that so?" Vritra hummed, then he looked at Fiona and called her: "Fiona, can you come here for a moment?"
Vanessa and Diana took over, and Fiona stopped fighting. She wiped her sweat and walked closer to Vritra, looking absolutely stunning and cool.
"Do you know who is the youngest to ever achieve the Perfect Field throughout the entire history till the present?" he asked.
"No, I don’t." Fiona shrugged her shoulders, wondering why he was asking this question.
’Heh, what do you have to say about this, wifey?’ Vritra joked.
Yasmine rolled her eyes. He was catching her habit of teasing him. Diana, who was curiously observing Vritra, felt that he might be genuinely curious. Feeling excited, she answered:
"It was the former Dragon Queen, Yasmine Firehart. She achieved what most people couldn’t achieve throughout their lives at just the age of twenty, a terrifying genius—"
"Yeah, yeah, go back to your training." Vritra said, shooing her away with his hand.
Diana pouted, her shoulders slumping. She had just been answering his question.
"Hehe, see? What do you have to say about this, hubby?" Yasmine laughed at Diana’s comical timing. The goddess was really becoming cuter by the day.
’Yeah, yeah, I know I have married the most wonderful, intelligent, and talented woman in the entire world—’ Vritra was praising but was interrupted.

"You forgot to add beautiful and strong, I think... hehe." Yasmine just loved teasing him so much. Previously she couldn’t have imagined that just talking with her man could be so fun and relaxing. It was as if no problems were left in the world.
’Yes, my wife is the best at everything. Happy?’ Vritra really wanted to bring this perfect wife of his into her body—after all, she still had many overdue spankings.
Just then, their conversation was broken by Fiona: "Can we talk for a bit?"
"Sure." Vritra pulled her close and let the beautiful girl sit over his lap. As he wrapped his arms around her delicate waist, he knew exactly what she was going to talk about.
Kissing her cheek, he spoke: "Just say whatever you want to say, don’t hesitate."
"...Your relation with Diana and your mom, I have some idea, so is it really...? I know that is why you haven’t taken that final step with me. I am ready, so please tell me." Fiona asked slowly.

"Yes, I am in a romantic relation with them. Well, not yet with Diana, but yeah, they are both my women as well. Do you want to leave me because of that?" Vritra asked, looking at her face emotionlessly.
"...Can you leave them?" Fiona thought for a few seconds and asked. She was holding her breath without even knowing it.
"No." Vritra answered with a single word.

"Sigh... And I can’t leave you. I don’t want to leave you. I just don’t want to be neglected or thrown away in the future. I trust you, but... that thought is a little too scary." Fiona said, finally releasing her breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Wild Imagination
paragraphs: "You have already lost your chance of leaving me, now even if you want, I won’t let you go. So just remove the thought that you aren’t important to me or that for whatever reason we can’t be in the future.
Just take your time. I won’t start disliking you just because we haven’t had sex yet. Believe me, all your worries are for naught."
Vritra spoke in a gentle tone, he wanted to have a close relation with his women in which they could understand each other without even saying anything.
"Mmm..." Fiona nodded, feeling his arm tightening around her waist, she felt protected and loved.
Changing the topic, he asked: "Should I bring stronger demons for you, since it seems with your current strength these demons are nothing?"

"Yes, I think I can fight beginning 1st Legion rank demons now. Oh right, I forgot to mention it before, but I heard about some Phoenix Realm inside that inheritance ground and the first Phoenix Queen wanted me to go there." She replied, looking up at his face while hugging him just as tightly.
"And did you receive some sort of map or something?" Vritra asked. It is better to always be cautious in such matters which consist of the unknown.
"No, she said the fire will lead you." Fiona replied. She didn’t really care about that, she would just go wherever Vritra goes.
They talked for a while longer and then Fiona resumed her training. Vritra closed his eyes and decided to take a nap since he planned to go out at night.

Several hours passed just like that, while watching their training Vritra would take out the soul potions and drink them casually. It wasn’t long before he had finished drinking all of the soul potions.
Not only was his soul growing stronger rapidly but Nihil-Anima and Yasmine were recovering faster. The soul potions from the demon generals had ended, but he would soon be getting more from the king.
The day passed quite peacefully without any disturbance. Vritra did hear the news about the disappearance of more than three hundred people from the temple.

The Golden Moon was still looking for them, for Vritra, and for Nine Pacts, but failed at all the tasks. There was even news about a certain monk who had wrecked havoc across the city; the guards were constantly trying to catch him.
After having dinner, they returned to their rooms. Vritra informed Vanessa about his trip and then he walked out of the room. He paused in front of Diana’s room and knocked.
KNOCK KNO-

Before he could even knock twice, the door opened as if the goddess had been waiting to hear that sound for days. She looked outside with hopeful eyes and was overjoyed to see that it really was Vritra.
She was wearing a beautiful blue dress that made her milky skin glow even more. Diana looked really beautiful.
"I am ready, let’s go." She said as she stepped out and closed the door behind her, not even waiting for him to speak.
Vritra: "..."
"I haven’t even asked anything yet."

"We are going to look at that part of the forest for the inheritance, aren’t we? I am ready to accompany you there, or did you call me here for something else?" Diana asked, really hoping to go out with him.

It was dark outside and the two of them would be all alone in the desolate part of the forest, and then Vritra, having complete control over her body, could do anything to her. He could remove her clothes, spank her, ravage her body, and much more.
{Sin Point Gained: Expectant +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Lusted after +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Tempted +1}
Just thinking of her helpless situation, the goddess was getting really excite—cough afraid, but the poor Diana couldn’t even reject him. She could only follow him happily—cough unwillingly.
"... Yeah, let’s go." Vritra looked strangely at the fast-changing expressions of the goddess, ignoring the messages. Something dirty was definitely cooking in that small head of hers.
"Can you fly?" Vritra remembered and asked. He hadn’t seen her do that before.
"Yes, I am a goddess and that is but one minor ability of mine." Diana replied, shrugging.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Betrayal?
paragraphs: Vritra looked at Diana, who was looking down at her body for some reason. She seemed quite satisfied upon seeing that she had successfully kept the thick fluid inside.
"Let’s go." Vritra extended his hand to grab Diana’s hand.

But all of a sudden, the ground shook as if a light earthquake had just gone through the place, and in the dead of the night, a blinding light spread throughout the place, making the two unconsciously close their eyes.

Vritra finally got a hold of Diana’s hand. He pulled her closer, confused about the sudden change in the condition. Neither he nor Yasmine felt any sort of presence around them, so unless the opponent was too strong or using some great technique or tool, it shouldn’t be an enemy attack.
[Nether Eye Activated.]

Vritra instantly activated his third eye, but he couldn’t sense anything different. The blinding light remained for a few seconds but then disappeared just like it had appeared, leaving absolutely no traces behind.
’What was that?’ he asked while cautiously observing his surroundings. He looked at the mountain, but it didn’t even seem to be related to the inheritance.
The commotion for a mythic halo shouldn’t be so low; everyone in the city would have been informed if the inheritance had really opened.
"I am not sure either. It all happened too fast, but I have a feeling it is somehow related to the inheritance. There is no other explanation." Yasmine replied, feeling a bit puzzled.
’The inheritance doesn’t seem to be opening. Maybe it would be better to just leave.’ Vritra thought after scanning his entire surroundings once again and not finding anything out of the ordinary.
He finally glanced at the goddess, who floated dazedly beside him, staring into the empty air.
"Diana, are you fine?" Vritra asked, lightly squeezing her hand. A strange feeling filled his heart, but he just couldn’t understand what was wrong.
"...Yes, master, I am fine. What was that light?" Diana smiled sweetly all of a sudden and looked at Vritra’s face, shifting her hand slightly and interlocking fingers with him.
"I don’t know, let’s go back for now." Vritra replied, the feeling of some anomaly suddenly rising in his heart, and in most cases, his danger senses were correct.

Suddenly pulling his arm, Diana’s expression changed as a ferocious look appeared on her face. Out of nowhere, a white-colored knife had appeared in her hand, and without wasting a heartbeat, she stabbed the knife into Vritra’s chest, piercing it directly through his chest.
Her speed was so high that even Vritra was caught off guard as he felt faint pain, the knife piercing through one of his hearts.

"Hah! Did you think that I trust you? I love you? I hate you with all my heart. Who do you think you are to make a goddess such as me into a slave? I was waiting for a chance—a chance to kill you and gain my freedom back.
DIE! DIE! DIE! You can never control me, you demon. Do you think I would be happy getting humiliated by you? You trampled all over my dignity. So what if I tried to kill you?
You are just a mortal, a pathetic mortal. HAHAHA now DIE!!" Diana shouted like a madwoman, her expression becoming crazier by the moment.

She pulled the knife out, struck it at the same spot again, cutting through his heart once again. Jerking off his arm, Diana laughed maniacally and moved away from Vritra, leaving the knife stuck in his chest as red blood dripped down his body.

"Haha! Why are you so silent now? You didn’t expect that, did you? After killing you here, I will go back to the castle and kill your mother and those little lovers of yours while they don’t suspect anything." She said, going completely mad.
"..." Vritra stared at her with wide eyes. He glanced down at the wound on his chest as the red blood continued to flow down. It seemed he was going to die very soon.

"Y-You... how could you? I t-trusted you... ughhh... the promise we made just now, the love between us, was it all just a lie?" He slowly approached Diana with a pained expression, raising a bloody hand to touch her cheek.
"Haha, that look suits you so much. Now let me enjoy as you die in misery, betrayed by the person you trusted." Diana laughed, as if enjoying the heartbroken look on Vritra’s face.

"P-Please, end y-your... haa... hatred with me and d-don’t do anything to mom and F-Fiona... ugghhh... I still love you, even if you kill me..." Vritra spoke, his bloodied body slowly beginning to slide down as if he was losing all strength.
Diana was grinning, watching him struggle in his last moments, as if he were a fool.
CLENCH!!
But suddenly, Vritra gripped her throat and squeezed hard enough that she choked. The painful expression disappeared instantly as he looked at her emotionlessly and spoke:

"Why are you so silent now? You didn’t expect that, did you? This is how you need to act. Your acting is seriously so bad." He shook his head and suddenly squeezed his hand as her neck snapped and she coughed out blood.
SNAP!!
BOOM
"Just as I thought..." Vritra mumbled as the fake goddess’s body broke into powder and fell down. Even the wound and blood on his body fell down upon transforming into powder.
"So I was right. We had been pulled into the inheritance ground all of a sudden. This is quite strange, but we can’t expect the inheritance of a mythic halo to be simple." Yasmine mumbled.
"Yeah, everything was so realistic that I wouldn’t have doubted it if Diana didn’t act like that out of nowhere. And I also wasn’t able to sense the invisible flames in her body.
So this is the power of the Misty Essence mythic halo—quite praiseworthy." Vritra spoke as he looked at the fake world around himself, which seemed way too real.

"But Diana got separated from me right before I could have taken her hand. It seemed this mythic halo was waiting for the perfect moment. But she should be fine. After all, Hellmancer is with her." Vritra always kept a few soul wraiths to protect the ladies.
Like Dark Knight, Ghost, and Ghoul were currently protecting Vanessa and Fiona, while the remaining ones were either with him or Diana.

"Yeah, she should be fine. Hellmancer is one of the most reliable, especially in such an environment. But what exactly is happening here?" Vritra mumbled. He looked around and even used the Nether Eye but couldn’t sense anything.
"I have heard a lot about the Misty Essence. It is truly a great mythic halo. Except for having no ability to physically harm anyone, it could be used in countless situations.
Anyway, let’s look around first. Maybe we can find a way out." Yasmine said, even she wasn’t sure of how exactly to break this illusion that was just too real.
Vritra nodded. Then he flew towards the mountain where the inheritance was supposed to open. He paused in front of it and mumbled:
"Sigh... I came all the way here again, but why isn’t the inheritance opening? Guess I will have to wait a little longer."

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Trapped
paragraphs: "Sigh... I came all the way here again, but why isn’t the inheritance opening? Guess I will have to wait a little longer."
Then Vritra turned around and actually began to fly back home, only to pause after a few moments as he realized that he had just gotten influenced.
"...by- Hubb- HUBBY!! Can you hear me?" Vritra finally heard Yasmine’s voice, which he was unconsciously ignoring all of a sudden.
This mythic halo was truly terrifying. It was quickly adjusting and making everything more realistic.
Previously, it had gotten some information from Diana, whose mental defense wasn’t as strong as Vritra’s, but Diana didn’t know about Yasmine.
And Misty Essence is weaker than Nihil-Anima, so it wasn’t able to know about the invisible flame—nor the fact that Vritra possessed it.
But sensing something, the Misty Essence cut off any sort of Vritra’s mental connection, and so he wasn’t able to hear Yasmine’s voice.

’Yeah, I can. It took control of my mind within moments without me even noticing it.’ Vritra thought. He wasn’t afraid, especially with Serene Mind that was working in the background and kept him sane.
It was Serene Mind just now that hastened the process of breaking the illusion.
"How do I keep myself unaffected by the illusion? And what am I actually searching for?" Vritra mumbled. The more he stayed in that familiar yet strange place, the more confused he felt.

"Calm down, first of all. Why don’t we try finding the source of the mythic halo? It should be present somewhere around here. The illusion will end once you get a hold of it." Yasmine said, her presence—as always—bringing calmness to Vritra.

"Hoo... Let’s try repeating your name. Maybe it will help and I can stay out of this bullshit illusion." Vritra said, then he began to repeat her name again and again while flying in random directions.

"Yasmine, Yasmine, Yasmine..." He was flying around rapidly, and repeating her name seemed to be helpful. It was like the Misty Essence could easily bypass all sorts of mental barriers and affect directly.

"Yasmine, Yasmine, Yasmine... Serpentine, Clementine, Evergreen, Quarantine, Routine, Routine..." Vritra was flying across the forest, but soon he paused and found himself standing in front of the temple back in Dunshire Kingdom.

"Huh? Routine? Why was I saying that—Oh right, I need to follow my routine and kill demons to level—FUCK!! This darned mythic halo, it’s playing with the circuits of my brain. Just don’t let me catch you, you cowardly halo."
Vritra cursed, feeling angry at the sudden changes in his own behavior and memory. It was so frustrating.

And the more time he spent in this strange space, the easier it got for him to fall into the trap. Even his skills and soul wraiths couldn’t be of any help in such a situation. Instead, the soul wraiths might end up causing more trouble.
"Haa... Wifey, what if I just destroy everything?" Vritra asked, controlling his anger as he calmed down once again.
"No, this mythic halo especially plays with your emotions. Try to be as calm as you can. You don’t actually want to kill Diana accidentally, right?

You won’t even know it and you might really end up destroying an entire city, killing hundreds of thousands of innocent people under its influence without even knowing anything. So just stay calm." Yasmine advised, even though she herself felt frustrated with this situation.
A mythic halo is powerful enough to even affect the Gods, so even she wasn’t of much help in this situation.

"Hmm... I understand, let’s do this." Vritra tried his best to remember his original motive as he started walking forward into the familiar temple, and was surprised to see a sight he could never forget.
Diana was standing there with a haughty look, and all the confused teenagers were looking around. It was exactly the time when they were pulled—or rather kidnapped—into this new world.
Vritra saw Vanessa standing in the midst of the crowd. She was looking around and upon seeing Vritra, the beautiful milf smiled and waved her hand: "Honey, I am here."
Vritra looked down at himself and found that he was back in his school uniform, and then he found himself standing beside his mother while looking at the goddess in confusion.
"Huh? What’s going on? Am I forgetting something?" he wondered, but Vanessa grasped his hand and spoke in a relaxing tone: "Don’t worry, honey, I am right here with you."
Vritra nodded and then fixed his gaze on the goddess who seemed familiar yet completely new. He had a sinking feeling in his heart that something was wrong, but he just couldn’t grasp that thought.
"In the name of fucking gods, look at her!" Raino spoke.
"She’s... she’s incredibly gorgeous! Is this some kind of setup? And where has my phone disappeared off to? Fuck, I just bought the expensive one last week." Another boy added.
"Where are we? What is the meaning of all this? How did we suddenly arrive here?" Mia, their teacher, stepped forward and asked.
"You have all been chosen," Diana began to speak. Her haughty gaze swept through the entire crowd.

Vritra had a feeling of déjà vu. He frowned and tried hard to think what exactly he was missing. He completely ignored the words of the people around him, but soon Vanessa tapped over his shoulder and spoke: "Honey, try looking at your status window."
"Yes, mom." Vritra nodded, as he opened the status window and started reading.
After looking at his stats, his gaze moved down to his seemingly trash skill—an ability to move around dust—and an unknown ability which didn’t really give any information.
He saw the slight blush over Vanessa’s face as she gazed at her status panel. She quickly closed it and carefully looked at her surroundings.
"Well done," Diana said. She smiled faintly and observed them all. "It seems you have all been blessed with incredible abilities. Some of you even received legendary ones."

She continued to praise Jack, Fiona, Max, and so on. Then a few of the students showed their concerns about the aspect of fighting against dangerous creatures, but Diana gave a lame excuse and silenced them.

"Vritra Arclis," Diana said, her voice cold and scornful, "Dust Manipulation. A most... unusual ability. Seems like you have obtained the worst ability in the entire group. It’s truly a pity—you aren’t suitable for any role."
And what followed was the mockery of his classmates. Everything seemed to flow in a manner that Vritra found way too familiar. Then they returned, and the next day headed to the labyrinth.
What followed was a betrayal and attempt at murder, which Vritra was unexpectedly expecting. Then came the death trap as he fought against those demons until he was on the verge of madness.
He fought there for months, doing his best to survive while devouring the demons. After five or so months, Vritra finally saw an invisible flame—
WHOOSH

All of a sudden, the illusion broke apart as Vritra found himself standing back in the familiar forest. The Misty Essence had entered his mind and was making him go through all that again, but it had not expected to meet the Nihil-Anima in his memories.

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Goddess Gone Crazy
paragraphs: The misty essence retreated at lightning speed. All mythic halos were afraid of Nihil-Anima, even the 2nd-ranked mythic halo, so how could the misty essence not be?
Despite consuming so many souls and soul potions, Nihil-Anima wasn’t even back to a quarter of its total strength, yet just its presence scared the misty essence.

"Haa... What the hell, I just went through all that experience all over again. This misty essence could seriously make the mind into a mess," Vritra panted lightly, as he finally remembered everything.
It was more powerful than Yasmine made it seem. It was better than any sort of hypnosis, and the illusion it created was near real.
"Can you hear me again?" Yasmine’s voice sounded. It seemed she had been calling continuously.
"Yeah. How long have I been controlled by this halo?" Vritra said as he looked around and saw the destruction in the forest he had just caused. Thankfully, the strength he just used was minimal.
"It’s only been a few minutes, but suddenly you started attacking everything. Are you okay now?" Yasmine asked, finding the misty essence was getting harder to deal with by the moment.
That thing was just too sly.

"Yes, I am fine. Anyway, that thing seemed really shocked upon sensing Nihil-Anima, so it won’t try to control my mind again so casually," Vritra said, feeling relieved. If Nihil-Anima was at full strength, then he could have directly subdued the misty essence mythic halo.
"That’s good. Still, be careful. Will Diana be fine though?" Yasmine mumbled.
It was as if the concept of time didn’t exist in this place.
Just as the blinding light had come, Diana was startled, and she too extended her hand towards Vritra. But the space in front of her felt empty for a moment, then she finally got a hold of his hand.
"What was that?" Diana rubbed her eyes and looked around before fixing her gaze on Vritra and looking at him strangely.
’That’s not Vritra...’ Her senses were exceptionally sharp—after all, being a goddess has its perks. She let go of his hand and created some distance.
"Who are you?" Diana asked, as she clenched her fists and holy energy started to burst out of her body.
She didn’t like fighting all that much, but if she went all out and borrowed power directly from the gods, then her strength would grow exponentially for a period of time.

"What’s wrong, Diana? It is me. Why are you acting like that suddenly?" Vritra spoke as he started approaching her. All of a sudden, his expression changed as he pulled out a sword and plunged it in her direction while screaming, "Die, you vile goddess!"
A black shadow suddenly twisted and took form in front of Diana, as a dark sorcerer came into view.
The Hellmancer repelled the sword with its staff and then thrust the staff into Vritra’s chest, killing him instantly as he broke into powder and fell apart.
"Oh!!" Diana exclaimed upon seeing the Hellmancer and then seeing the fake Vritra die. She was sure at least this soul wraith was real.
"Hell!! So master sent you to protect me. Hehe..." Even in this dangerous situation, Diana felt funny in her belly becoming his love interest and someone he wanted to protect.
"Let’s move," Hellmancer said in its rough voice, a robe of darkness covering its body.
"Yes!!" Diana happily nodded. It finally felt that she had become a part of the family, and her importance had increased.
The two continued to venture forward, and it wasn’t long before Diana was trapped in the illusion. It was a situation where she had become a true god, one of the strongest beings she knew of.
The Hellmancer wasn’t affected by the illusions—it was made by the Nihil-Anima, so the misty essence was a little hesitant to get close to it.
While the goddess was going through all sorts of her fantasies, she even saw the Great Demon Vritra marrying her, as the two became entities even above the gods.
Hellmancer soon brought Diana back to her feet, as the dream-like state broke and she blinked her eyes only to again get struck in another illusion—this time of when she first met Vritra.
Shaking its head, Hellmancer began to babysit the goddess as he kept waking her up while searching for Vritra or a way to get out of there.

Diana was acting really strange. Sometimes she would start attacking Hellmancer, sometimes she would start running, then she would start speaking, laughing, or would just lie down on the ground and start sleeping.
"Masterrrr, where are you? Sob I am going crazy..." Diana was desperately looking for Vritra, at least when she was sane and not in an illusion.
In the next moment: "Muahaha Mortals, kneel!!"

Each time Hellmancer brought her out of the illusion, she would get incredibly embarrassed and would soon start acting up.
Even after so long, the dark sorcerer wasn’t able to find anything. It was like they were just roaming around in circles.
Although Hellmancer’s mind wasn’t affected by the illusion, the entire surroundings—everything—was created and being controlled by the mythic halo, so it seemed impossible to get out of there.
After walking for more than five hours, Vritra finally saw a large door.

Thankfully, the mystic halo was no longer messing with his mind, but all its creations were still way too realistic, and Vritra didn’t have a choice but to walk in the direction the mythic halo wanted him to.

Looking at the large door that seemed to be made of some sort of ancient wood, Vritra pondered and spoke, "Wifey, do you think I should go inside? It feels like such an obvious trap, but I can’t think of any other place where the misty essence might be hiding."

Still, it might or might not be inside. This is too risky... Let’s go inside and check it. It’s not like we have any other choice," Yasmine said, becoming more cautious.

Vritra kept his nether eye activated as he started walking forward, carefully and slowly. Then, creating a large hand of dust, he pushed the door forward. Despite their size, it was rather easy to move them.
Even after the door opened, Vritra wasn’t able to see anything inside. It was like endless white light was coming from the inside, making all senses useless.
"Haa... Here goes nothing. Who could have thought a normal sex session with a goddess would end up like this?

By the way, is this considered good luck that it opened exactly when I was here before the others could even notice, or bad luck that I got trapped like this?" he spoke. In this place, it was really hard to keep track of time.

"Whatever it may be, we are going to get out of here," Yasmine said with determination. Since the misty essence couldn’t control Vritra, then it must have labelled him as a great threat which needed to be eliminated immediately.
Finally, Vritra walked into the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: The Six Truths
paragraphs: Vritra walked into the door. For a moment, he closed his eyes and then looked at the vast space that had appeared in front of him.
It was like he had travelled outside the planet. There was endless darkness as far as he could see, and even the distant stars seemed much bigger.
The ground was made of darkness. Most of the things appeared like that, but when his vision cleared and he looked forward, Vritra saw an enormous throne with its back facing him.
It was so big that Vritra and the entire space around it seemed insignificant in front of the throne. There even seemed to be something on it, though Vritra couldn’t see that entity from the back.
Looking at the vast throne, he noticed that something was written on the back, and with his language mastery skill, it was easy for him to decipher almost any language.
Narrowing his eyes, Vritra began to read it.
"ZARTOS WE-" But before he could read the complete thing, Yasmine’s voice exploded in his mind. She seemed really panicked.
"DON’T READ IT, CLOSE YOUR EYES, CLOSE YOUR SENSES. RIGHT NOW!!"

Vritra had no doubt about her judgement. He wasted no time and closed his eyes. A wave of thunder coursed through the ground and sky. The trembling was clearly felt through the ground. It almost felt like a destructive storm was about to descend.

A strong force surrounded the entire place, enough to easily make Vritra’s body freeze and make his mind become a mess despite the serene mind. Vritra had closed the nether eye and shut down all his senses, cutting himself off from the surroundings.
The wild changes remained around for a few seconds before everything started to return to normal, and then the storm, earthquake, and aura disappeared as if they had never existed in the first place.

’What was that now? Was it also an illusion? Wifey, what’s going on?’ Vritra asked, staying perfectly still and feeling really confused. This one didn’t seem to be just an illusion. The trap had actually almost worked to take him out, only if Yasmine wasn’t with him.
"Huff... We were this close to destruction..." Yasmine took a few long breaths, sounding very anxious, and then she explained:
"There are few things in this world that could never be said, heard, or seen—the greatest taboo in the world.
And that is called The Six Truths. Just hearing or speaking of them could make a person go crazy to the point they would commit suicide or be crushed to death by Gods.
Like I have said before, we can’t speak the names of a God or Demon God.
If you so much as read it, we would have been killed instantly for the disrespect. It is one of the Six Truths—The Truth of Prohibition."

"..." Vritra listened to it all in silence and finally understood what sort of trap the misty essence had set up for him. Since it couldn’t use force to kill Vritra, it had decided to borrow the force and kill him brutally.
’The Six Truths... what other such truths are there?’ Vritra asked, feeling curious.
"The Truth of Creation, The Truth of Betrayal... and that’s all I know of," Yasmine replied. It was a topic so dangerous that just knowing it could bring unimaginable trouble.
’Do you know what these truths actually are?’ Vritra asked, wondering how long he had to stand there like that.
"Of course not. Do you think I would be alive—even in this state—if I knew that?" Yasmine said, rolling her eyes.
’But you knew of the Gods’ names. Isn’t that also one of the truths?’ Vritra asked, as he started to sense his surroundings little by little, while ignoring the large throne completely.

"Yeah, I know of that because of an incident that nearly cost me my life. Anyway, this is not important now, and it would be better if you don’t talk about this topic with anyone else," she said seriously.
If Diana were here, she would have certainly mentioned one of the Truths she had heard a little about... The Truth of the Divine.
’Yeah, I won’t talk about this with anyone. Anyway, what should I do now?’ he asked, keeping his senses limited just to make sure he wasn’t going to get attacked.

"The Misty Essence is definitely here. Just don’t look at anything here and we would be safe. Let me guide you. For now, start walking to your right," Yasmine replied. She could sense something strange on the other side of the throne.
’Okay.’ Vritra turned a sharp ninety degrees and began walking. After walking nearly a couple of hundred meters, Yasmine’s voice sounded in his mind again, "Now turn to your left and walk."

Vritra changed his direction and followed her instructions. He could tell that he was walking on the side of the throne, and various sorts of changes were constantly occurring in his surroundings as the misty essence tried its best to trap him.
"Alright, that’s enough. Now face your left and fly straight upwards," Yasmine said, and Vritra started flying. If it wasn’t for her, then he might never have been able to get out of there.
She continued to give him instructions as Vritra avoided several things and soon reached the top of the enormous throne. He landed over an arm that was lying over the armrest.

The entity sitting on the throne made no movements. Vritra moved according to Yasmine and was soon floating exactly in front of the entity’s forehead, where a bright crystal shining with a green colour was embedded.

The misty essence was present inside the crystal. It had tried all sorts of things to get Vritra killed, but Yasmine protected him. Seeing Vritra finally finding its main body, the mythic halo panicked, and breaking the crystal, it began to flee.
"Heh. Where do you think you are going now? We haven’t played enough yet." Vritra’s hand shot forward at full speed as he caught the flame in his grasp. The green flame was struggling badly.

This green flame looked less like a flame but more as if it was made of powder—like a fire in a 2D game. The mythic halo was shocked that Vritra had managed to grab it so easily. Despite all its struggles, it couldn’t get out.
And then Vritra did the most natural thing—
BITE!!

Just like with Nihil-Anima, he began to devour the mythic halo. Within moments, he had devoured the entire green flame and then felt a shiver as the green flame continued to struggle even inside his body.
Mutamorphis’s message was about to pop at any moment, but suddenly, a strong presence spread within Vritra’s body as the invisible flames surrounded the new green flames, making it cower in fear.
Misty Essence’s struggle stopped instantly as it shrivelled like a frightened kid, hiding from that monster in a corner.
"Oh, now this is nice. Great job, Nihil-Anima." Vritra smiled and finally opened his eyes. Everything around him had started to break apart after turning into powder.
"Let’s take control of this thing first."

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Stinging Jealousy
paragraphs: [Mutamorphis: Analysing the body...]
[You have one of the Mythic Halos.]
[The twentieth-ranked Mythic Halo: Misty Essence Mythic Halo detected.]
Vritra calmly read the messages and felt the changes occurring in his body. He had finally succeeded in obtaining another great treasure of the universe.
[Warning: Mythic Halo assimilation in progress...]
[Absorbing Misty Essence Mythic Halo into the host’s soul.]
[Processing...]
[Synchronization in progress.]
[Success!!]
"Oh, it succeeded in a single try, unlike before..." Vritra muttered. It was definitely thanks to the Nihil-Anima.
[Synchronization with Mythic Halo: Misty Essence — 0%... 1%...]
[Assimilation complete.]
[Mythic Halo successfully integrated.]
[Misty Essence Mythic Halo has fused with the host’s soul.]
[Misty Essence Mythic Halo successfully consumed.]
The whole process took quite long, probably around four to five hours, but this time Vritra didn’t become unconscious. The entire process was a lot smoother, all thanks to the supervisor Nihil-Anima.
And Vritra could feel the presence of another mythic halo in his body. Unlike Nihil-Anima, which was silent, prideful, and battle-crazy, this one was more childish and playful.
"Congratulations hubby, well that went easier than I expected hehe. Except that part, anyway let’s head out now," Yasmine said, feeling a bit exhausted by the thrilling experience.
"Hmm, let’s head out. I wonder where Diana is wandering." Vritra flew back the way he came from. The whole place seemed to be crumbling slowly.
’"The Six Truths," huh? I wonder what sort of secrets they hold.’ Vritra was feeling incredibly curious about them, but not enough to throw his life away just to find the secrets.

Just as he arrived outside the large dark space, the whole place finally broke into powder. Vritra could easily control the dust, so he stayed still and all the falling dust passed by his side without touching him.

"Maybe I should use my Dust Ability as my Field. After all, it is also going to become extremely strong in the future and has less risk compared to Null..." he pondered while watching the whole place fall apart.
"Yeah, that is a good choice. Who knows, after upgrading, the Dust ability might become just as powerful as Null or maybe more.
But you are just at the beginning stages of comprehending your Field, so you can take your time. There is no hurry," Yasmine added. She was sure whatever Field he chose would be exceptional.

"Hmm." Vritra nodded and soon a bright light hit his face. Placing his hand in front of his eyes, Vritra looked at the bright surroundings. He was floating in the air exactly above the mountain where the inheritance had opened. The mountain had broken and was now just a pile of sand on the ground.
"M- Master?!" Diana was also floating some distance away from him, with Hellmancer hovering beside her.
The Hellmancer bowed and disappeared, finally done with his duty to babysit the goddess.
Diana flew towards Vritra and hugged him, then started complaining like a child about all the things that had happened inside.
"...A- And in the end, I obtained this." Diana raised her hand and showed a green flame burning over her hand. She looked really proud.
"Second Misty Essence?" Vritra was shocked. Then he looked at Diana cautiously, his expression showing that he was thinking she might be fake.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}

"W-Why are you looking at me like that, Master?! I-I am the real Diana..." Diana was truly shaken as she saw the look on Vritra’s face. It seemed he really was about to kill her just to make his doubt disappear.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
"I am really not a fake, see this." Diana hastily turned around and raised her dress, showing the handprints on her ass cheeks despite feeling embarrassed.
"Hahaha, yeah yeah, I know you aren’t fake. Don’t worry, I am not going to attack you." Vritra laughed seeing the goddess act like that; she looked really cute.
Diana pouted, knowing that he recognised her from the beginning and was just playing around.
"Master, you just gave me a heart attack. Please don’t bully me like this in the future." Her breasts moved up and down as she took long breaths.
"Hmm, that isn’t a mythic halo, so what is it?" Vritra asked, as Diana displayed the green halo once again.
"Yeah, it is not the Misty Essence Mythic Halo. After all, there can’t be two of such a treasure. But it is a Halo of the highest grade under the Mythic Halo.
If it grows in the future, it could almost be considered a Mythic Halo, though that would need a lot of time," Yasmine explained.
Her halo could also create illusions; it could almost be considered a child of the Misty Essence in a sense.
"Good job. You didn’t get hurt inside, right?" Vritra patted the goddess’s head. His hatred for her was already gone.
"Hehe, Hellmancer protected me all the time. Mmm, though I was really scared in there." Diana hugged Vritra and pressed her face against his chest, enjoying the closeness.
"Let’s go back. We had stayed here for more than seven or eight hours." Vritra caressed her back and spoke after a few minutes.

Diana lovingly held his hand and interlocked fingers with him as the two flew away. This sort of experience would surely stay with them for the rest of their lives, and the goddess was extremely happy to make special memories with him.
Upon returning to the castle, Vritra and Diana saw Vanessa and Fiona walking near the gate of the castle. The two women seemed to be waiting for them.

"Oh, they are here..." Fiona called upon seeing them fly closer. She looked at their hands and, despite knowing of their relationship, Fiona couldn’t help but feel jealous, though she showed no such emotion on her face.

"Honey!!" Vanessa smiled brightly as she saw Vritra. She jumped into his arms as soon as he got down, hugging him tightly. She knew he used to fight back on Earth too, but in this world she always had a lingering fear in her heart whenever he went out.
"Are you okay? What took you so long? Fiona hasn’t even eaten anything since this morning and was very worried about you," Vanessa said, pressing him closer into her body.

"Yes, I am fine. The inheritance I told you about finally opened, and I had finally achieved my goal." Vritra said before his gaze shifted to the redhead who was standing a meter away with a faint smile on her face.

She tried hard to push away the stinging feeling of jealousy, but it wasn’t easy to see another woman in the arms of the man she loved so much. Fiona sighed and knew she would have to get used to such a sight.

After getting out of Vanessa’s arms, Vritra stepped in front of Fiona and pulled her into his arms, embracing her. Fiona’s tensed body relaxed and she forgot all about her worries, burying her face into his chest.
"Sorry for being late, but I am fine. You shouldn’t starve yourself even if I am away. I don’t like that, okay?" Vritra cupped her cheeks and looked into her eyes.

[Assimilation complete.]
[Mythic Halo successfully integrated.]
[Misty Essence Mythic Halo has fused with the host’s soul.]
[Misty Essence Mythic Halo successfully consumed.]
The whole process took quite long, probably around four to five hours, but this time Vritra didn’t become unconscious.
The entire process was a lot smoother, all thanks to the supervisor Nihil-Anima.
And Vritra could feel the presence of another mythic halo in his body.
Unlike Nihil-Anima, which was silent, prideful, and battle-crazy, this one was more childish and playful.
"Congratulations hubby, well that went easier than I expected hehe.
Except that part, anyway let’s head out now," Yasmine said, feeling a bit exhausted by the thrilling experience.
"Hmm, let’s head out.
I wonder where Diana is wandering." Vritra flew back the way he came from.
The whole place seemed to be crumbling slowly.
’"The Six Truths," huh?
I wonder what sort of secrets they hold.’ Vritra was feeling incredibly curious about them, but not enough to throw his life away just to find the secrets.
Just as he arrived outside the large dark space, the whole place finally broke into powder.
Vritra could easily control the dust, so he stayed still and all the falling dust passed by his side without touching him.
"Maybe I should use my Dust Ability as my Field.
After all, it is also going to become extremely strong in the future and has less risk compared to Null..." he pondered while watching the whole place fall apart.
"Yeah, that is a good choice.
Who knows, after upgrading, the Dust ability might become just as powerful as Null or maybe more.
But you are just at the beginning stages of comprehending your Field, so you can take your time.
There is no hurry," Yasmine added.
She was sure whatever Field he chose would be exceptional.
"Hmm." Vritra nodded and soon a bright light hit his face.
Placing his hand in front of his eyes, Vritra looked at the bright surroundings.
He was floating in the air exactly above the mountain where the inheritance had opened.
The mountain had broken and was now just a pile of sand on the ground.
"M- Master?!" Diana was also floating some distance away from him, with Hellmancer hovering beside her.
The Hellmancer bowed and disappeared, finally done with his duty to babysit the goddess.
Diana flew towards Vritra and hugged him, then started complaining like a child about all the things that had happened inside.
"...A- And in the end, I obtained this." Diana raised her hand and showed a green flame burning over her hand.
She looked really proud.
"Second Misty Essence?" Vritra was shocked.
Then he looked at Diana cautiously, his expression showing that he was thinking she might be fake.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
"W-Why are you looking at me like that, Master?!
I-I am the real Diana..." Diana was truly shaken as she saw the look on Vritra’s face.
It seemed he really was about to kill her just to make his doubt disappear.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
"I am really not a fake, see this." Diana hastily turned around and raised her dress, showing the handprints on her ass cheeks despite feeling embarrassed.
"Hahaha, yeah yeah, I know you aren’t fake.
Don’t worry, I am not going to attack you." Vritra laughed seeing the goddess act like that; she looked really cute.
Diana pouted, knowing that he recognised her from the beginning and was just playing around.
"Master, you just gave me a heart attack.
Please don’t bully me like this in the future." Her breasts moved up and down as she took long breaths.
"Hmm, that isn’t a mythic halo, so what is it?" Vritra asked, as Diana displayed the green halo once again.
"Yeah, it is not the Misty Essence Mythic Halo.
After all, there can’t be two of such a treasure.
But it is a Halo of the highest grade under the Mythic Halo.
If it grows in the future, it could almost be considered a Mythic Halo, though that would need a lot of time," Yasmine explained.
Her halo could also create illusions; it could almost be considered a child of the Misty Essence in a sense.
"Good job.
You didn’t get hurt inside, right?" Vritra patted the goddess’s head.
His hatred for her was already gone.
"Hehe, Hellmancer protected me all the time.
Mmm, though I was really scared in there." Diana hugged Vritra and pressed her face against his chest, enjoying the closeness.
"Let’s go back.
We had stayed here for more than seven or eight hours." Vritra caressed her back and spoke after a few minutes.
Diana lovingly held his hand and interlocked fingers with him as the two flew away.
This sort of experience would surely stay with them for the rest of their lives, and the goddess was extremely happy to make special memories with him.
Upon returning to the castle, Vritra and Diana saw Vanessa and Fiona walking near the gate of the castle.
The two women seemed to be waiting for them.
"Oh, they are here..." Fiona called upon seeing them fly closer.
She looked at their hands and, despite knowing of their relationship, Fiona couldn’t help but feel jealous, though she showed no such emotion on her face.
"Honey!!" Vanessa smiled brightly as she saw Vritra.
She jumped into his arms as soon as he got down, hugging him tightly.
She knew he used to fight back on Earth too, but in this world she always had a lingering fear in her heart whenever he went out.
"Are you okay?
What took you so long?
Fiona hasn’t even eaten anything since this morning and was very worried about you," Vanessa said, pressing him closer into her body.
"Yes, I am fine.
The inheritance I told you about finally opened, and I had finally achieved my goal." Vritra said before his gaze shifted to the redhead who was standing a meter away with a faint smile on her face.
She tried hard to push away the stinging feeling of jealousy, but it wasn’t easy to see another woman in the arms of the man she loved so much.
Fiona sighed and knew she would have to get used to such a sight.
After getting out of Vanessa’s arms, Vritra stepped in front of Fiona and pulled her into his arms, embracing her.
Fiona’s tensed body relaxed and she forgot all about her worries, burying her face into his chest.
"Sorry for being late, but I am fine.
You shouldn’t starve yourself even if I am away.
I don’t like that, okay?" Vritra cupped her cheeks and looked into her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Tv and Chill
paragraphs: "Mmm..." Fiona nodded softly. Glancing to the side, she saw the big smile on Diana’s face, and for some reason didn’t like it. The feeling of jealousy just won’t go away.
But just then, Fiona felt a pleasurable current course through her body as Vritra pressed his lips against her. After he sensed her thoughts, he didn’t want her to feel insecure about this.

"Come with me, I will feed you myself." After a soft kiss, he smiled and gently took Fiona into his arms. Vritra wasn’t too experienced in romantic relations, but he knew that she needed more attention now. He glanced back and nodded at Vanessa.
The succubus smiled as she blinked her eyes in understanding. She was the least worried in that aspect — after all, their bond was just unbreakable, even before coming to this world.
"..." Diana watched as Vritra flew towards the castle. A big smile was plastered all over her face that just won’t go away. She was having the time of her life.
"So how did your adventure outside go?" Vanessa looked at the goddess with a knowing smile and asked, pulling her along towards the castle.
"Uhm..." Diana felt shy all of a sudden, but after some hesitation she began to explain everything to her sensei. She had just achieved one of her life’s greatest feats, after all.
Vritra sat in his room with Fiona sitting on his lap facing to his right. On her lap was the tray of food from which Vritra was feeding her, giving kisses as she giggled and shifted over him.

"So, my Fiona, look at this." Vritra said and pointed a finger towards the wall in front of them. She looked up and was shocked to see a big TV on the wall. It was even working and displaying a channel where songs had started to play.
"H- How did you do that?" Fiona asked. Vritra passed her the remote and the redhead curiously pressed all the buttons and was shocked to see it work just like it would back on Earth.
There were even so many channels. It was just too magical.

"Haha, I can do that with the help of this..." Vritra raised his right hand while his left was wrapped around her waist. Then a green 2D-looking flame made of powder or tiny particles appeared over his palm. It looked quite beautiful.
"Whoa, what is this, darling?" Fiona asked, stars appearing in her eyes.

"This is Misty Essence Mythic Halo. It can create super realistic illusions." Vritra said, but then Fiona was even more amazed. Since the whole TV and the channels were made of his imagination, it was so real she couldn’t find a single flaw.
"Oh, you already have such good control over it. As expected of my husband." Yasmine spoke.
’Right, I am still waiting for the promised surprise, don’t forget about that.’ Vritra reminded her. He was really looking forward to it.
"Yes, I remember it. Don’t worry, I will give you the surprise very soon." She said in a mysterious tone. Vritra felt a bit frustrated, but all he could do was wait.
"So this is the thing you obtained in the inheritance? This is so cool!! Can you show that famous web series on the TV?
The one about drugs — I was watching it before being pulled into this world." Fiona asked excitedly. She wanted to hug him so badly but couldn’t because of the tray of food on her lap.
"Ah, that. Yes, I have seen it so I can make it appear. What season were you at?" Vritra said. His memory has always been great, but after the rise in Intelligence points, it had grown exponentially.

"I was at the second episode of season four. A cousin of mine told me that Gus was going to die in that season, and I was really mad at him for giving this spoiler." Fiona said, puffing her cheeks like a hamster.
"Okay, let’s start from there then." Vritra smiled as the screen of the TV suddenly changed, and then the second episode started playing.
Fiona clapped her hands in pure joy as she gave a kiss on Vritra’s cheek and started watching the web series with delight.
"Wow!! Even the quality is so good, thank you so much darling." She said in delight.

’Sigh, looks like her emotions had stabilized now. Well, I understand. It isn’t an easy decision for her.’ Vritra thought. He continued to feed her, and Fiona ate while her eyes remained pasted to the TV.

Diana and Vanessa soon entered the room and were shocked when they heard the sound of the TV and then saw it hanging on the wall. Though the goddess soon understood and relaxed, she was surprised at Vritra’s capability.
With her Halo, she was still just trying to create shapes in the air, while Vritra was controlling the Mythic Halo with such ease.
"Woah, honey, where did you find that?" Vanessa said. She quickly sat beside Vritra and started watching the episode with interest.
"Ah, you are watching this. I liked this series quite a lot, but because of work I could barely get any time, so I was still at the third season." Vanessa spoke.

"Then let’s watch this together!!" Fiona was even happier — after all, watching her favourite thing with someone was just the best while sitting on her man’s lap. The situation couldn’t get any better.
"Darling, can you please..." Fiona looked at Vritra with a cute expression, blinking her eyes rapidly.
"Haha, sure, it’s no problem." Vritra chuckled, and once again the screen of the TV changed — and this time, it was the first episode of season one.
Even the quality was so good. Diana sat beside them and asked in confusion: "I know this thing is present back on your Earth and is called television, but what is it that you are watching?"
"Do you want to watch it together with us?" Fiona’s eyes were shining brightly at finding another comrade. She already seemed to have forgotten about her jealousy.
"...Yeah!!" Diana smiled and nodded enthusiastically. Then the three women all glanced at Vritra, and he nodded, as the screen changed again and started with episode 1 of season 1.
Vritra wondered if he got himself into additional trouble by showing this to the three ladies. They seemed as if they might really get addicted to watching TV in this world.
Vritra fed the entire food to Fiona. She ate more than usual without even noticing it while watching the series.
The three women were completely focused on watching it — one episode ended and then another started, and there were still no signs of stopping.
After the second episode ended, the TV flickered and disappeared. The six eyes were instantly focused on him, complaints filling their gazes as they asked without actually speaking.
"Haa, I am feeling exhausted after using so much mental energy. It is hard to constantly keep using the Mythic Halo." Vritra said, though he could go on forever without actually feeling exhausted.
"Oh sorry, we forgot that this isn’t an actual TV but your creation. Rest well and thank you for letting us experience such a wonderful thing." Vanessa said.
Watching TV was fun, but to her it was more important that Vritra is comfortable. The other two nodded, they didn’t want Vritra to feel even the slightest pain just because of their entertainment.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: The Truth Talk
paragraphs: "Haa, this TV thing is actually quite nice. Though a lot of things are present on other continents from your Earth, even cars," Yasmine said, as Vritra removed the TV. Though it seemed a bit slow and confusing at the start to her, it was getting really interesting.

’Many other people had been called here from Earth, and the technology here—just keeping Glyphs in mind—is quite high, so that’s not a surprise,’ Vritra said as he lay back on the bed, Fiona resting over his arm, hugging him while talking about all the series she wanted to see.
Though Vritra himself hadn’t seen many of them.
"When are we leaving for the White Kingdom now that all the goals are complete?" Yasmine questioned. She really wanted to see what sort of trouble he could cause there.

In the Topaz Continent, the White Kingdom alone is a lot bigger and richer compared to all other kingdoms, even by several times. Since the White Kingdom possessed direct teleportation to other continents, the growth was astronomically high there.
Fourth Legion rank isn’t even the highest there, and all sorts of strong warriors are coming into the White Kingdom from outside.

’I want to enjoy this momentary peace for a few days. I am sure we would end up getting wrapped in all sorts of trouble upon arriving there. Not to mention, there is even a Bone Blood Cult base there.
But since the demon war is coming closer, I won’t be wasting too much time.’ After replying to his wifey, Vritra looked to the side and saw Diana and Vanessa chatting.
All three of the women were close to reaching the 1st Legion rank—just one more day of training and they would level up.
So Vritra wanted to let them reach that rank before leaving, and with most problems gone, he could enjoy his time here for a little bit.
"Diana, what do you know about the Six Truths?" he asked so casually that it didn’t look like he was talking about a taboo topic.

"..." The goddess’s mouth opened slightly as if she was about to speak something but then closed. After a moment, she said in a solemn tone: "We shouldn’t be talking about that. Knowing it will only bring destruction."
"Yeah, I am asking so I can avoid it. You know I don’t want to accidentally get involved in all that," Vritra replied with an honest smile.
Though the goddess looked at him suspiciously, sighing, she spoke: "It is better to stay away from these topics, but I will tell you what I know."
She went silent for a few seconds, arranging words carefully in her mind. Then she added: "I don’t know how much you know, but I have only heard the name of a few of the truths.
Like the Truth of Prohibition, which is related to gods, the Truth of Betrayal, the Truth of Creation, and... the Truth of the Divine.
These are things that are made forbidden by the gods and demon gods. If these truths were to come out, it is said they could create great calamities."
She finished her explanation, knowing fully well the more she warned, the more interested Vritra would become in this.

"Divine... Do you know absolutely anything about the Divine? There was even that box in your temple that was related to the Divine as well," Vritra said. Fiona and Vanessa knew of almost all his secrets, but the goddess was yet to know it all.
But as their relationship progressed and they got to know each other better, both of them would certainly know each other’s secrets.
"I don’t know much either, since even if you somehow get to find little bits of secrets about the Six Truths, you will end up forgetting about it very soon. They are forbidden secrets, after all.
Anyway, the only thing I know is that once, the Divine had been inside the Topaz Universe," Diana said. Even as a goddess, she had to try really hard to remember that one thing.

’If that’s the case, then how does wifey still remember what she saw long ago? And since the gods make everyone forget about the content of these Six Truths, then why don’t they just make everyone forget about the Six Truths itself?
Doesn’t it increase the chances of exposure if people remember that such a thing exists? Or do they want people to look for these truths?
I wonder what the answers to all these questions are.’ Vritra pondered, and the more he thought, the more questions appeared in his mind.

Just after hearing Diana’s words, he almost forgot what she had said, but with two mythic halos present in his body—the treasures that could easily rival gods—Vritra’s capability to remember the forbidden secrets was higher than most other people.
Like Diana could remember bits and pieces because of her status as a goddess and her holy energy, Yasmine could remember for some reason as well.
"Okay, Mom, Fiona, do you remember what she just said?" Vritra looked at his mother and the redhead in his arms.
"About the Six Truths—the Truth of Prohibition, Betrayal, Creation, and Divine," both the women answered one by one.
"That’s all?" Vritra asked again.
"Yes." Fiona and Vanessa nodded, wondering if they were missing something.

’It is just as I thought. Anyway, Fiona also has the physique and bloodline of the Phoenix Queen, but she still doesn’t remember it. So wifey, how can you remember so much about one of the Six Truths?’ he asked.
"I don’t know either. After knowing that, I just never forgot it," Yasmine answered, sounding just as confused.
"Sigh, let’s put all that aside for now. Don’t talk about it and just forget we ever had this conversation," Vritra said, and the three women nodded.
These topics were sensitive enough to bring down continents within moments.

Vritra rested for a while longer. It was already past evening and the sky was turning dark. Vanessa and the others were ready for dinner, but Vritra decided to go meet the king and give him the sad news of him leaving the kingdom.
Though for Henry, this might be the best news of his life.
Leaving the room, Vritra headed outside. While passing through one of the corridors, he faintly caught sight of some young man training hard outside even at this time.
’How hard-working...’ Vritra thought as he continued to walk, but paused when that man seemed a bit familiar. He looked around and found that it was the crown prince.
He was bare-chested and covered in sweat, doing heavy exercise.
"Poor prince had his heart shattered by a woman—or rather a man—so he is hitting the gym now." Vritra then continued to walk forward. Maybe this incident might just make him a real hard worker.
Arriving in front of Henry’s room, Vritra was about to kick the door open, but remembering the last disgusting scene, he decided not to.
Instead, he tapped on the door.
KNOCK KNOCK
There was no sound from inside.
KNOCK KNOCK

After a minute, an annoyed voice sounded from inside and the door was pushed open from within: "Which bastard dares to disturb me this late in the night? I am going to cut you to pieces if you don’t have a good reason—Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!"
