"Yes." Fiona and Vanessa nodded, wondering if they were missing something.
’It is just as I thought.
Anyway, Fiona also has the physique and bloodline of the Phoenix Queen, but she still doesn’t remember it.
So wifey, how can you remember so much about one of the Six Truths?’ he asked.
"I don’t know either.
After knowing that, I just never forgot it," Yasmine answered, sounding just as confused.
"Sigh, let’s put all that aside for now.
Don’t talk about it and just forget we ever had this conversation," Vritra said, and the three women nodded.
These topics were sensitive enough to bring down continents within moments.
Vritra rested for a while longer.
It was already past evening and the sky was turning dark.
Vanessa and the others were ready for dinner, but Vritra decided to go meet the king and give him the sad news of him leaving the kingdom.
Though for Henry, this might be the best news of his life.
Leaving the room, Vritra headed outside.
While passing through one of the corridors, he faintly caught sight of some young man training hard outside even at this time.
’How hard-working...’ Vritra thought as he continued to walk, but paused when that man seemed a bit familiar.
He looked around and found that it was the crown prince.
He was bare-chested and covered in sweat, doing heavy exercise.
"Poor prince had his heart shattered by a woman—or rather a man—so he is hitting the gym now." Vritra then continued to walk forward.
Maybe this incident might just make him a real hard worker.
Arriving in front of Henry’s room, Vritra was about to kick the door open, but remembering the last disgusting scene, he decided not to.
Instead, he tapped on the door.
KNOCK KNOCK
There was no sound from inside.
KNOCK KNOCK
After a minute, an annoyed voice sounded from inside and the door was pushed open from within: "Which bastard dares to disturb me this late in the night?
I am going to cut you to pieces if you don’t have a good reason—Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Hubby~ Do you love me?
paragraphs: "I am going to cut you to pieces if you don’t have a good reason—Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!" The king let out a frightened scream as soon as he opened the door and saw Vritra standing there. He had assumed it to be one of the guards.

"S- Sir, forgive me! I didn’t know it was you. I am so sorry, s- should I cut off my other arm too?" The king instantly knelt. For some reason, Vritra seemed a lot more terrifying than ever before—his natural aura screamed strength and terror.
Waving his hand, Vritra got to the main topic: "Have you gathered the soul potions yet?"

"A- Ah, yes sir, I have gathered quite a bit of soul potions. The number is a bit less than the ones present in our inventory, but this is all I was able to gather in such a short time." Henry felt a little better that he didn’t have to cut his other arm as well.
First, he waved his hand and made the guards leave.
He had played smart and spread the news that the king had received a serious soul injury, and then all the noble and rich families began to send all sorts of soul potions to curry favour with him.
And so, he gathered so many soul potions without spending a single penny. Vritra knew that he was a smart king—no stupid king could raise his kingdom to such a state.
"H- Here, this is all I was able to gather. I- If you want, I can try to find some more..." Henry spoke as he pulled out a storage glyph and passed it to Vritra.

Sensing the storage inside, Vritra threw it into his inventory and then looked back at the frightened king. After a short silence, he finally gave the sad news: "In a few days, I will be leaving for the White Kingdom—"
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Euphoric +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Rhapsodic +1}
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "Hahaha, just look at his face. He looks as if he had just killed the murderer of his entire family."
"Sir, that’s such a wonderful—cough cough—sad news. When are you leaving?" Henry asked in haste, a glint of joy in his eyes.
"You think this is sad news?" Vritra asked.
"O- Of course, you are a guest here. It is always sad to watch a guest leave." Henry lied through his teeth, his left eye blinking rapidly as he spoke, barely stopping his lips from curling up.
"Sigh, I don’t like making people sad. I will just stay here—" Vritra began to speak, but the king let out a frightened voice:
"NOOOOOO!! I- I mean, I don’t want to hold you back. This place is too small for you."
"Anyway, what do you know about the White Kingdom’s current situation? Is it safe there?" Vritra asked, deciding not to waste any more time with this king.

"Hmm, I haven’t heard anything recently from there. They have been unusually silent for a few days. But I did hear before that the number of demons located around the kingdom has increased, so they are expecting a demon swarm to attack soon.
B- But if you’re planning to go there, then I have a way which would make your experience in the White Kingdom a lot easier," Henry said as he remembered something.

"Soon, an envoy of the Blue and Dunshire Kingdom will be leaving for the White Kingdom while bringing the strongest and most talented warriors for a big tournament that will be happening in the White Kingdom in a few months.
If you want, you can enter the White Kingdom as one of the members of the envoy. The security around that kingdom is especially high currently, and this way you won’t face any difficulties."
The king finished speaking in one breath, waiting for Vritra’s reaction.
"When is this envoy leaving?" Vritra asked, no emotion on his face.
"Somewhere around two weeks later," came the reply.

"Make it one week, and good job. You are a smart king." Vritra smiled and patted Henry’s shoulder. The king felt quite proud of himself for some reason. He saw Vritra as someone very terrifying and special, so his praise felt nice.
"Y- Yes sir. A- And about the White Kingdom, the technology there is much more advanced compared to here.
The average level is also higher—you can easily find countless warriors at the 1st Legion rank walking on the roads. I even heard Hans Gratt was seen in that kingdom recently.

That place is thousands of times richer and more dangerous. The king there rules by the oppression method, and the rules are too harsh... but only for the poor. It could even be called a slightly evil kingdom."
"Alright." Vritra nodded after listening, then turned and started walking away.

Henry finally relaxed as Vritra left. He was still afraid that Vritra might kill him, but now that didn’t seem to be the case. Thankfully, there were no guards outside his room to see his pathetic state.
Jumping with joy, he ran into the room.
While walking back, Vritra started pulling one bottle of soul potion after another and drank them.

"Mmm, yummy. So we will be leaving after a week. I thought it would take more than a year to reach even the White Kingdom, but we are just going so fast. But it also scares me a bit—such fast growth might bring dangers soon that we can’t handle," Yasmine said, worry filling her voice.
"That is true, but I can’t stop moving forward just because the challenges ahead might be too big. Haa, well, all we can do is be extra cautious.
But with my luck... sigh, it’s like I am carrying around a very, very strong magnet and pulling any and every trouble towards me, even though my luck is so high already..." Vritra shook his head.
"Hubby, do you love me?" Yasmine asked out of nowhere. Vritra was a bit surprised, but he nodded and said: "Yeah, I love you."
"Can you fight Bone Blood Cult, Nine Pacts, Golden Moon, Divine Kage, dragons, and even demon lords for me?" Yasmine asked.
"Yes, I will." Vritra replied seriously, though he wasn’t sure where she was bringing this conversation.
"Will you do anything for me?" she asked, and now Vritra was getting really curious.
"Of course, I will do anyyy~thing for you." Vritra replied while walking back towards his room, answering his wife in all seriousness. He felt that she might have something important to ask.
"Then can you continue playing that series? Just five more episodes for today, pretty pleaseeeee~" And Yasmine finally revealed her true evil motives.
Vritra: "..."
"You naughty wifey, if you were just going to ask that, then you should have just said so directly. There is absolutely no need to spiral it around." Vritra said with a smile.
"Yayyy!! So we are having a TV night?" Yasmine really liked the idea of watching the series along with the other women, though she couldn’t sit beside them and eat with them.
"Haha, no." Vritra said as the dragoness’s celebration paused instantly and she began to ask cutely.
Soon, Vritra returned to his room. He ate food along with the three ladies while watching TV and then binge-watched the entire night.
Who can deny Yasmine’s request?

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Third?
paragraphs: The group barely slept through the night and watched several episodes of the series. Vritra was regretting showing it a bit by now. All four of them just fell asleep over the bed several hours past midnight.
They woke up late in the morning and freshened up. After having breakfast, Vritra decided to just relax for the day while the ladies could train.
He sent his soul wraiths to bring demons from the different forests and sat relaxedly while watching them train. Taking out one soul potion after another, he drank them while enjoying the battle.
GULP
’Haa, this is nice.’ Vritra thought, drinking the slightly sweet soul potions.

"Yeah, so relaxing," Yasmine added, while absorbing the energy from the soul potions. After drinking a few potions, Vritra’s mouth was suddenly filled with a sour taste. He coughed the potion out and felt the poison entering his body.
Though almost instantly, the effect of the poison was neutralised.
"Poison? Did that bastard really just try to kill me?" Vritra frowned and decided to go pay the king a visit. Taking the bottle along, he got up and started walking away.
Fiona and the others noticed him leave, but they were too occupied with fighting the demons. They were just about to reach the 1st Legion rank.
When Vritra arrived at the hall, the king was having a meeting with his ministers. Henry was startled upon seeing Vritra arrive at the entrance.
"P- Pause the meeting for a while, I will be back in a minute." Henry rose from his throne and ran out, wondering if something had gone wrong.
"Henry," Vritra called as they arrived in a vacant hall.
"Y- Yes, sir." The king was ready to kneel, feeling his heart beat wildly.
"Do you want to kill me?" Vritra asked.
"N- No way, sir. Why would I? You are such a respected guest at our place," Henry replied, the fear in his heart rising.
"Then why did you try to poison me?" Vritra asked as he showed the half-filled glass bottle, his eyes narrowing.

"O- Oh, this is poison? I- I didn’t give it to you, sir. I had received all the potions from rich families of my kingdom, s- so someone tried to kill me, it seems... I am really sorry that I didn’t test them before giving them to you. Please forgive me." Henry knelt once again.
"...Take care of it." Vritra frowned and was in no mood to waste any more time with the king. He just wanted to enjoy his peace a little longer.
"Y- Yes, I will, sir. I will find out who did it," Henry shouted towards Vritra, who was already walking away, then thought: ’H- He didn’t die even after drinking half of this poison?!!’
Vritra pushed this matter out of his mind and decided to continue with his rest.

But when he arrived back at the training area, he saw Vanessa standing there with a helpless expression, Diana standing with a look as if she had made a mistake, while Fiona had tears in her eyes and seemed sad and mad at the same time.

’Haa, I just left for a few minutes. What happened here now? What about my peaceful time?’ Vritra thought. He knew Fiona had already been quite sensitive recently, and now it seemed she had somehow had a fight with the goddess.

"Welcome to relationships. They can’t always be sweet, you know. You have to face every side of it, and even more with multiple women," Yasmine said, now watching the twist of drama in her hubby’s life.
"What’s wrong?" Vritra approached Fiona and asked. The redhead looked at him with teary eyes, then with a humph, she pouted and walked towards her room.
"Sigh... So what happened?" Vritra looked at his mother, scratching his head. Thankfully, Yasmine and Vanessa were quite understanding.
"..." Vanessa glanced at Diana and spoke: "Why don’t you rest for a bit?"
The goddess nodded and sat down on the chair, looking a bit uneasy.

"You know Fiona has already been feeling jealous of Diana, and while fighting they had an argument, and this argument quickly shifted to you. In the end, Diana showed that green halo that is quite similar to yours, and Fiona got really sad after that," Vanessa explained. She had tried to stop the fight from escalating, but both girls just wouldn’t listen.
"I will go talk to Fiona. You stay here with Diana," Vritra said, and Vanessa nodded. Then he walked up to Diana and, while patting her head, spoke:
"I know you didn’t mean to hurt Fiona, but it would be better to be a bit careful around her. I wonder if she is on her periods... Anyway, you should have a sister-like relation with her, okay?"
"Hmm," Diana nodded. She was thinking that Vritra was going to scold her for what she had done, because a part of her still believed that he loved Fiona more than her, and so she also became jealous.
"Don’t worry, she will be fine," Vritra smiled and then walked away. Vanessa sat beside her and started having a deep conversation.
’Maybe staying here to enjoy the peace was a bad idea, but the situation between them would have to be resolved sooner or later,’ he thought.
Vritra headed towards Fiona’s room. Upon arriving outside, he tried to open the door, but it was locked from the inside.
"Fiona, can you open the door?"
"Fiona?"

Even after calling several times, no reply came from inside, so Vritra just used his dust ability to open the lock. Then he stepped inside and saw Fiona lying on the bed with her face buried in a pillow.
’Now how should I go about this situation?’ he wondered.
"You don’t want to talk to me?" Vritra sat beside her and asked, caressing her head gently.
"You know, Dia—" Vritra forcefully pulled the brake. Taking another woman’s name right now would only make her madder, so he changed his wording.
"You know, I love you a lot, right? Do you still think I will leave you in the future or that I love others more than you? How about we go on a date together?"
Vritra tried to speak, but Fiona just kept her head buried in the pillow and wouldn’t respond.

Again, Vritra decided to use a different approach: "Haa... Don’t tell me you still miss Max and you just couldn’t push him out of your memory. Is staying with me a bother to you? Do you find loving me back a chore?"
"NO I DON’T!!" Fiona suddenly pulled her head up and said, tears still present on her cheeks and the pillow.
Vritra quickly cupped her cheek and asked: "Then do you love me?"
"...Yes." Fiona said with a pout. She still felt angry; the burning feeling of jealousy was ignited a thousandfold upon the fight with Diana.
"I love you a lot too, so don’t be sad. Hmm, since you feel so insecure, how about we have a wedding and seal our relation forever?" Vritra asked.
"R- Really?" Fiona’s mood instantly seemed to brighten up, her lips curling up in a faint smile.
"Yeah, you could be my third wife—" Vritra spoke instinctively, but by the time he stopped, it was already too late.
More tears were about to roll out of her eyes as she asked in a shaky voice: "T- Third?"

chapters.title: Chapter 267: The First Wife
paragraphs: "T- Third? If your mom is first t- then you are still putting Diana before me?" Fiona was teary-eyed; it seemed Vritra had just made the situation worse for himself.
"That’s not what I..." Vritra sighed and tried to explain, but Fiona once again buried her face into the pillow and then wouldn’t respond to him.
’Sigh, this relationship thing might be harder than I thought...’
Five minutes later, all three of the women were seated on the bed. Fiona was still angry at Diana, so the two women sat with some distance between them, and Vanessa was seated between the two.
Fiona looked as if she might start crying at any moment, so Vritra wasted no time and started to speak: "So there is something that the three of you don’t know yet.
I didn’t really mean to hide this, but it is a sensitive topic, and even if by accident a single word of it got out, then all of us would be in grave danger."
"What is it about?" Vanessa asked. Seeing his seriousness, the three women were now even more curious.

"Actually, there is someone I want all of you to meet." Vritra spoke, not sure how all of them were going to react. Gesturing with both hands to the side, he spoke: "Meet her, this is Yasmine Firehart, my first wife."
Just as the shocked gazes of the three women moved to the side, a translucent white dragon appeared there; Yasmine had reduced her body size by a lot and was now barely bigger than a normal snake.
"S- She is a dragon?!!" Vanessa asked in shock. The three women looked at Vritra with questioning gazes, then back at Yasmine.
"Hello, mother-in-law, Fiona, and Diana, I am Yasmine. It is nice to finally meet you all. You don’t know me, but I know a lot about you all." Yasmine said, gazing at the three of them.
"Yes, she is a dragon, and we met inside the labyrinth. When I got stuck in the death canopy, I met her after a few months, and since then she has helped me a lot.
So, it all started when I saw an invisible flame..." Vritra began to explain everything from their first meeting and how Yasmine had been with him all this time.
Every minute and second she had been with him, supporting him in every possible way, even protecting his life without caring about herself.
"Oh, Yasmine, those scales are so pretty!!" Fiona said as she moved closer to Yasmine and looked at her beautiful white scales.
"You are the Dragon Queen?!! Yasmine Firehart, the greatest genius?!!"
Diana seemed the most shocked out of all. She knew the legend of the former dragon queen, a terrifying existence whose death had changed the power dynamics of all the continents and realms.
"Whoa, an actual dragon? My first daughter-in-law is a dragon, wow, that’s so... surprising and unique. But welcome to the family, Yasmine."
The three women surrounded Yasmine and began to ask all sorts of questions and share various things with her.
Yasmine also enjoyed talking to them; she was finally having a conversation with someone other than Vritra after such a long time, and all three of them seemed so warm and welcoming.
Vritra heaved a sigh of relief; this introduction went better than he expected, and it didn’t seem any of the women had any problem with Yasmine. He sat on the side and let them have a personal chat.
Having ruled over the dragons for a long time, Yasmine was quite proficient in speaking, and Vritra was well aware of it—after all, she wouldn’t leave a chance to tease him.
And even now, just after a few minutes, Yasmine had handled the situation quite well; Fiona was all smiles and seemed to have already forgotten everything.
’As expected of my wifey, you are the best.’ Vritra thought, as he lay back and finally had the peace he so much wanted.
The next few days went by quite fast. All four of the women seemed to have formed a group together and had so many topics to talk about that they could talk without stopping for eternity.
But Vritra finally didn’t have to handle any sort of trouble; the fight between Fiona and Diana was easily resolved, all because of Yasmine and Vanessa.

It was the fourth day, and there were still a few days before they would leave for the White Kingdom. Vritra woke up early and dressed up in nice clothes; today he was planning to go on a date with Fiona.

Their relationship had already deepened enough, and there was no longer any need to hold back anymore. Walking out of the castle, he found the beautiful redhead waiting for him in a pretty black dress, looking sexy over her pale milky skin.
"Let’s go, darling." Fiona extended her hand towards him as her fingers slid between his, and the two walked away while holding hands.
Fiona had been waiting so long for this moment. She hugged his arm as the two soon arrived in the market; they decided not to take the carriage so they could spend as much time together as possible.
Just walking on the street, hands in hands in the slightly rainy weather with cold wind blowing, felt really nice.
"My lady, would you like to eat something or visit other places first?" Vritra asked; such a sweet smell lingered around her.
"Hmm, let’s buy some snacks, and we can visit other places while eating them. What do you think?" Fiona asked. This was definitely one of the best days of her life.
"Sure, if that’s what you want, we will do as you say. So just say the word, and I will grant you your wishes." Vritra said, leaning close to her and kissing her cheek.
"Hehe, thank you darling, I love you. Oh, can you buy that and the ice cream for me?" she spoke while pointing towards a couple of shops.
"Of course, I will be back in a minute." Vritra said, and like the perfect boyfriend he was, he went to the shops and bought several things.
"Here, your ice creams, my love." Vritra said, as Fiona laughed and took the ice creams from him. While eating them, they continued to explore further in the market.
Vritra hadn’t been to the market much, but Fiona had seen a few things the previous times she was there with Diana and Vanessa.
"Why don’t we go see the Magical Circus? I wanted to go there the previous time, but because of the Grieves we left early." Fiona said and started leading him towards the circus.
"Okay." Vritra replied.

Soon the two were standing in front of a large tent. The circus seemed quite popular, and there was a large queue gathered to get its tickets. Based on the number of people, it didn’t seem Vritra would be able to get the tickets.
"Sigh, guess we were too late. Let’s just go see something else; maybe we will see it some other time." Fiona said in a disappointed tone.
She really wanted to see it with Vritra, and there was a high chance she wouldn’t be able to see it ever again since they would be leaving the kingdom soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Face Slapping?
paragraphs: "Wait, we don’t really need a ticket to get inside," Vritra said, and with a flip of his finger, two tickets appeared between his fingers.
"Whoa, is that Misty Essence Mythic Halo?" Fiona asked, a playful smile appearing on her face.
"Yeah, and we got VIP tickets. Let’s go inside and watch this show." Vritra took her hand and walked towards the VIP entrance with his head held high.
The line in the VIP section was very small. Vritra and Fiona soon arrived at the front, and after showing their tickets, they were allowed to sit in the VIP area with better seats.
"Hehe, darling, going inside like this has a thrill of its own," Fiona said, enjoying the new sort of experience.

The two were soon seated, and it wasn’t long before the show started. It was the perfect mix of comedy and tricks. Those tricks might not seem as special to the people of this world, but for Fiona, the show was super great.
Vritra also enjoyed the comedy part, but without even trying, he could clearly see through their tricks, so they lost their charm.
He glanced around and saw that many men seemed more interested in Fiona rather than the show they had paid for, and it was at this moment that Vritra realized why he was given such a godly ability.
Dust Manipulation!!
In the next moment, several cries came as many of the men felt dust going into their eyes—it was even burning their eyes slightly.
Putting his arm over Fiona’s shoulder, Vritra embraced her possessively, giving a death glare to several men.

’Having beautiful women also requires a lot of work, sigh, I am suffering from success. The crown prince didn’t have to worry about that at least—his wife’s so ugly even his lustful father rejected her.’ Vritra thought, as he once again focused on the show.
The whole show was around an hour long; around forty minutes had passed when all of a sudden, a message popped in front of Vritra that took him by surprise.
{Divine Sin Arrow upgrade available!!}
{Require 30,000,000 Sin Points to upgrade the Divine Sin Arrow.}
{Would you like to upgrade?}
Vritra coughed imaginary blood. This greedy bastard—the price of each and everything was so damn high.
Thirty million for the upgrade... Vritra would have to work hard to earn those and also need a large audience to earn that, and getting that much attention usually meant trouble.
And this upgrade didn’t even specify the type of changes that would occur.
’With already so much mess here, if I grab too much attention, then I won’t even know which among my enemies had killed me. Damn it, why do I even have so many enemies?
Anyway, I guess I will have to wait until I reach the White Kingdom before I try anything.’ Vritra pondered. Although the White Kingdom was dangerous, that also meant more opportunities.
Pushing this topic to the back of his mind for now, he just focused on the show.
"Aside from the exorbitant price, I wonder what exactly this upgrade will bring. But I am sure it won’t be small," Yasmine said—nothing related to the word ’Divine’ could be average.
’Yeah, but the upgrade would have to wait,’ he replied.
After an hour, the show finally ended. Being in the VIP audience, Vritra and Fiona were even given funny-looking accessories as gifts before leaving.
Vritra and Fiona visited a few more shops—they did a little shopping, purchasing clothes for themselves and even for Vanessa and Diana.
After venturing around for a while, they stopped at a nice restaurant and had lunch.

For some reason, this date was unlike any before. In her heart, Fiona was anticipating how this date was going to end—she had always been too curious about sex, but in front of Vritra, she didn’t want to look weird or too horny.
"Haa, the food there was delicious. I ate a bit too much," Fiona rubbed her belly while speaking, but she was glad her stomach hadn’t puffed up after the meal.
"On our way to the hotel, I saw several shops with different challenges—would you like to check them out?" Vritra asked. By winning, they could get cute toys and teddies as well.
"Yes, that’s perfect. Let’s go there, darling." Fiona was really enjoying this date—from the start till now, there was a big, beautiful smile on her face.

After a short walk, Vritra and Fiona arrived at one of the shops. It was similar to something they had seen back on Earth too—the shooting game—except that they were using a bow and arrow here to shoot the target.
After three hits on the moving target, the winner would be able to get a toy of his choice from the shop.

Vritra and Fiona decided to watch others play first. Looking to the side, he saw another couple who were about to try it. The man was wearing the uniform of a guard commander, and he seemed to be in the 1st Legion rank.
The girl standing beside him was dressed in orange and seemed to be in her twenties. Her level was low, though she was fairly beautiful and was trying her best to seduce the guy.
Coincidentally, Vritra’s gaze met with the guy with glasses, who seemed rather arrogant—but when he looked beside Vritra, a look of pure jealousy appeared on his face.
Fiona was countless times more beautiful than the other girl. But the same happened when Fiona’s eyes met with the girl—she was also jealous upon seeing Vritra.
"Hmph, Jaggy, can you get that for me?" the girl threw a sidelong glance at Fiona while clinging to the glasses guy, as if saying:So what if Vritra is handsome? My guy is better.
"Ha! That is easy. Just stand behind me, I will get that immediately for you," Jaggy said, throwing a challenging glance towards Vritra.
The couple were clearly jealous of Vritra and Fiona and were trying to satisfy their egos for absolutely no reason. Both of them seemed too proud of the glasses guy’s job and strength.

"Jealousy is injurious to health, haha. Are we finally going to see the first face-slapping in the dramatic life of my hubby? If you want to know, then keep read—" Yasmine spoke but was interrupted by Vritra.
’Of course not, unless they try something. I am not going to start a fight for no reason... or am I?’ Vritra stopped himself when seeing the flames of retaliation burn over her face.
"..." For now, Fiona watched silently. The glasses guy was given five chances, and based on his level, the speed and the size of the target were adjusted, then he needed to shoot the arrows.
Out of the five tries, he actually managed to hit the target three times and won a gift.

"Hehe, thank you, my love. I will cherish this gift forever. Not everyone could be as good as you, hehe..." the girl glanced at Fiona and said. She really hated that her guy had a horse-like face while Fiona’s looked so charming.
"Darling, can you get that for me?" Fiona couldn’t let the other two look down on them. She held Vritra’s arm and said with a smile, making the other guy very jealous.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: I don’t even want to cheat...
paragraphs: "Darling, can you get that for me?" Fiona couldn’t let the other two look down on them, she gave off a mocking look to the other couple.
"Uh... sure." Vritra couldn’t deny it now that Fiona had said it out aloud, but he had never really used a bow and arrow before, so he was afraid that he might end up messing it.
Though he had clearly observed how the glasses guy used the bow, but using it for the first time, he could end up making mistakes.
’Sigh, oh well guess we don’t have any choice now.’ Shaking his head, Vritra paid the money and got five chances. Then he picked the bow and an arrow, and held them while imitating the other guy.
"Haha, don’t tell me this is your first time ever using a bow?" the man in glasses laughed, trying to act superior in front of Fiona.
"Sir, what is your level?" the shopkeeper asked, he loved such competition, after all, he would end up earning more.
"I am close to the middle of the 2nd Legion rank," Vritra said, and the smiles on the couple’s faces immediately froze, they didn’t think Vritra could be so strong.
"Don’t tell me you are lying—" Jaggy spoke with a scornful look, but just after sensing a little of Vritra’s aura, his body shook and he felt like running away.
The couple now regretted getting into a fight with such a dangerous entity, Vritra could kill them in an instant after all and not even the king would do anything.

Not even the king has reached the 2nd Legion rank yet after all. They really wanted to just run away, what if Vritra actually fails and gets humiliated in front of his girl, won’t he just come to find them in darkness and make the two disappear.

’Ughh, I got ahead of myself and forgot to ask darling if he could even do it.’ Fiona cursed herself for losing her mind just because of slight provocation, but she just couldn’t accept anyone who tries to insult Vritra.

Even the shopkeeper straightened up, he became a lot more careful with his words: "Oh respected sir, forgive me for my rudeness. I welcome you to this small shop of mine, I can’t take money from you, please just take as many tries as you need."
"No, it’s fine, keep the money," Vritra said, and despite the shopkeeper’s pleading, he didn’t take it back.

"The target in my shop can’t move at a speed that could be a challenge for you, although no one that strong has ever visited my shop, but I will add lots of fake targets to make it a little challenging for you," the shopkeeper said, but he didn’t actually plan to make it more difficult, what if Vritra just destroyed his shop in anger.
Vritra nodded, by now along with Fiona, all four of the people were feeling quite nervous. After hearing Vritra’s level, more and more people started to gather to watch the show.
As the number of people increased, the couple got more and more frightened, their clothes were already drenched in sweat and now they couldn’t even slip out of the crowd.

"S- Sir, haha please don’t take my words to heart, I was merely joking. You don’t need to prove anything, I- I was just—" the glasses guy tried to get out of the danger, the girl with him was even more afraid.
But Vritra interrupted him: "No, it is fine. But since I have never used a bow before, the first time would be a trial."
He couldn’t get out now that Fiona had said it, and with his capability, Vritra was sure he could hit the target after a few tries.
"..." A crowd of nearly fifty people had gathered around them and all of them watched in silence, whether Vritra wins or loses, they were all sure that the other couple was now in deep trouble.
They had provoked someone way too strong.
’Damn it, I had just come back to the kingdom after a long holiday with this girl, and right away I got in such trouble. It is all this bitch’s fault.’ Jaggy thought, and felt like crying.
Almost all the guards knew about Vritra, Henry had personally warned every person to not ever offend Vritra.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra readied himself to shoot while trying his best to take aim at the target. After adjusting the arrow, he pulled back the string and focused on the moving target.
The size of the target was half that of a palm, and it was moving around rapidly. Vritra focused on the red target, ignoring dozens of the black ones, and finally, he released the string.
BANNGGG!
The arrow shot with a loud explosive sound that startled everyone, it hit a few inches above the target and tore through the wall and then flew into the sky, even the bow in Vritra’s hand was broken.
’Oh, I used a bit too much strength...’ Vritra thought. All the people looked at the big hole in the wall and the broken bow, they were truly frightened, especially the couple.
They felt that Vritra was just trying to scare them. But Vritra’s mind was on something else...
[Mutamorphis: Analysing Body Conditions...]
[Analysing the environment...]
[Analysing Threat Levels and nearby lifeforms...]
[Triggering Automatic Morphological Adaptation...]
[Adaptation in Progress.]
[You have acquired the passive skill Archery Mastery.]
’Haa, I seriously didn’t want to cheat.’ Vritra thought, he could feel new knowledge appearing in his mind, when he looked at the target again, quite a bit of information instantly popped up.
A lot of information about archery had entered his mind through this skill.
"Can you give me another bow please, I will pay for this, I accidentally used a little too much force," Vritra said as he put away the broken metallic bow.

"Y- Y- Yes sir, I will get you another one immediately, and of course you don’t have to pay for it, it was getting very old so it is not your fault that it broke," the shopkeeper said as he hurriedly brought out another bow.
"D- Do you need more trial shots?" he asked again, while hiding in the corner.

"No, I am ready now," Vritra said and held the bow and picked the arrow. This time his stance was perfect, all the people with even the slightest knowledge of archery were shocked, they were sure he was just pretending earlier.
"Darling, should we just leave?" Fiona asked, feeling guilty for putting Vritra on the spot, but Vritra smiled and replied:
"No, and thank you, just enjoy the show." More and more people were gathering around, he was getting quite a bit of sin points and even got a new skill so it was a win-win situation for him.
And the Archery Mastery was activated instantly.
After getting into position, Vritra didn’t even have to try all that much, after locking onto the red target he lazily let go of the string.
TUK!
This time the red target was pinned to the wooden board behind it, the force and aim were so perfect that it left everyone speechless, the arrow had pierced exactly at the centre of the oval target.

sentences.text: "Darling, can you get that for me?" Fiona couldn’t let the other two look down on them, she gave off a mocking look to the other couple.
"Uh... sure." Vritra couldn’t deny it now that Fiona had said it out aloud, but he had never really used a bow and arrow before, so he was afraid that he might end up messing it.
Though he had clearly observed how the glasses guy used the bow, but using it for the first time, he could end up making mistakes.
’Sigh, oh well guess we don’t have any choice now.’ Shaking his head, Vritra paid the money and got five chances.
Then he picked the bow and an arrow, and held them while imitating the other guy.
"Haha, don’t tell me this is your first time ever using a bow?" the man in glasses laughed, trying to act superior in front of Fiona.
"Sir, what is your level?" the shopkeeper asked, he loved such competition, after all, he would end up earning more.
"I am close to the middle of the 2nd Legion rank," Vritra said, and the smiles on the couple’s faces immediately froze, they didn’t think Vritra could be so strong.
"Don’t tell me you are lying—" Jaggy spoke with a scornful look, but just after sensing a little of Vritra’s aura, his body shook and he felt like running away.
The couple now regretted getting into a fight with such a dangerous entity, Vritra could kill them in an instant after all and not even the king would do anything.
Not even the king has reached the 2nd Legion rank yet after all.
They really wanted to just run away, what if Vritra actually fails and gets humiliated in front of his girl, won’t he just come to find them in darkness and make the two disappear.

’Ughh, I got ahead of myself and forgot to ask darling if he could even do it.’ Fiona cursed herself for losing her mind just because of slight provocation, but she just couldn’t accept anyone who tries to insult Vritra.
Even the shopkeeper straightened up, he became a lot more careful with his words: "Oh respected sir, forgive me for my rudeness.
I welcome you to this small shop of mine, I can’t take money from you, please just take as many tries as you need."
"No, it’s fine, keep the money," Vritra said, and despite the shopkeeper’s pleading, he didn’t take it back.

"The target in my shop can’t move at a speed that could be a challenge for you, although no one that strong has ever visited my shop, but I will add lots of fake targets to make it a little challenging for you," the shopkeeper said, but he didn’t actually plan to make it more difficult, what if Vritra just destroyed his shop in anger.
Vritra nodded, by now along with Fiona, all four of the people were feeling quite nervous.
After hearing Vritra’s level, more and more people started to gather to watch the show.
As the number of people increased, the couple got more and more frightened, their clothes were already drenched in sweat and now they couldn’t even slip out of the crowd.
"S- Sir, haha please don’t take my words to heart, I was merely joking.
You don’t need to prove anything, I- I was just—" the glasses guy tried to get out of the danger, the girl with him was even more afraid.
But Vritra interrupted him: "No, it is fine.
But since I have never used a bow before, the first time would be a trial."
He couldn’t get out now that Fiona had said it, and with his capability, Vritra was sure he could hit the target after a few tries.
"..." A crowd of nearly fifty people had gathered around them and all of them watched in silence, whether Vritra wins or loses, they were all sure that the other couple was now in deep trouble.
They had provoked someone way too strong.
’Damn it, I had just come back to the kingdom after a long holiday with this girl, and right away I got in such trouble.
It is all this bitch’s fault.’ Jaggy thought, and felt like crying.
Almost all the guards knew about Vritra, Henry had personally warned every person to not ever offend Vritra.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra readied himself to shoot while trying his best to take aim at the target.
After adjusting the arrow, he pulled back the string and focused on the moving target.
The size of the target was half that of a palm, and it was moving around rapidly.
Vritra focused on the red target, ignoring dozens of the black ones, and finally, he released the string.
BANNGGG!
The arrow shot with a loud explosive sound that startled everyone, it hit a few inches above the target and tore through the wall and then flew into the sky, even the bow in Vritra’s hand was broken.
’Oh, I used a bit too much strength...’ Vritra thought.
All the people looked at the big hole in the wall and the broken bow, they were truly frightened, especially the couple.
They felt that Vritra was just trying to scare them.
But Vritra’s mind was on something else...
[Mutamorphis: Analysing Body Conditions...]
[Analysing the environment...]
[Analysing Threat Levels and nearby lifeforms...]
[Triggering Automatic Morphological Adaptation...]
[Adaptation in Progress.]
[You have acquired the passive skill Archery Mastery.]

A lot of information about archery had entered his mind through this skill.
"Can you give me another bow please, I will pay for this, I accidentally used a little too much force," Vritra said as he put away the broken metallic bow.

paragraphs: "Oh, t- that’s perfect." Seeing the arrow pinning the target in the wooden doll, everyone in the crowd was surprised.
"T- That was a great shot, sir." The shopkeeper said as he pulled away the arrow and removed the target, but just when he was about to set up the next round, Vritra added: "Make it more challenging."
"H- Huh? But that’s—" the shopkeeper hesitated, but just a look from Vritra made him turn silent.
"W- What should we do now? We made a mistake by provoking him, it is too dangerous..." the girl whispered in the glasses guy’s ear.
"Shut up, this is all your fault." The two instantly broke out in a fight and the man slapped the woman first, throwing her back into the crowd.

Vritra looked at the couple and seeing that the girl was alive and only with slight injury, he decided to ignore it. The shopkeeper put the difficulty to the maximum, he was still afraid that Vritra might get angry after a failure.
"Darling, you even know how to use a bow?" Fiona asked, a proud smile appearing over her face, she was so happy with her choice she really had gotten the best of the world.
"Yeah, now I do." Shrugging, Vritra replied, Mutamorphis or rather his sugar mommy was way too generous.
Again, Vritra picked another arrow and got into position, he pulled the arrow and barely paid any attention to the target before shooting the arrow.
TUK!

Again, with such precision, Vritra hit the target. The shopkeeper put up exactly three red targets upon Vritra’s order, in the midst of hundreds upon hundreds of black targets, the speed was extremely fast.
Holding the three arrows at the same time, Vritra took the stance and for a second observed the target before shooting the three arrows at the same time.
And all three arrows hit their targets with perfection.
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +78}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +78}
"Can you give me that now?" Vritra said as he put down the bow and pointed at one of the prizes that Fiona wanted, the shopkeeper nodded hurriedly and gave it to Vritra.

"What’s going on here?" Finally, the guards patrolling the area noticed the crowd and decided to check. They moved closer to the shop while passing through the crowd, first they saw the couple who looked really frightened and then they saw Vritra.
"O- Oh, Sir Jin Woo, so it was you, is there any sort of problem?" the guards instantly bowed before Vritra, the public was surprised to see the two be so respectful and afraid of Vritra.

"No, everything is fine, we were just having a friendly match," Vritra said, he didn’t want to linger around anymore as he took Fiona’s hand and walked away, the crowd moving away to make way for them.
"What happened here?" the guard asked one of the people in the crowd and got the whole story.

"..." Then the guards looked at Jaggy with pity, after sending the crowd away one of them spoke: "Sigh, ex-commander, how did you end up in a conflict with the only person in the kingdom you should have been afraid of?"
"What? I am still the commander—" Jaggy looked enraged, since Vritra didn’t seem to mind, he finally relaxed.

"Yeah, but not for long, do you even know who that was?" After speaking in a solemn tone, the guard looked around and whispered: "Don’t say it to anyone else but I have even seen the king kneel in front of him, what do you think our king will do to you after hearing of this incident?"
Jaggy froze and was drenched in sweat, his body was trembling in nervousness and fear, and he had never regretted anything so badly. He really wanted to cry at his own stupidity.
"Bitch, this is all because of you." Jaggy could only take his anger out on the woman with him, he slapped her again, but before it could happen the third time, the guards stopped him.
"Wait, the king is asking us to bring you back to the castle," one of the guards said, making Jaggy stumble in dread.
"S- So fast? How did he even know?"
"I had just sent the whole report back since any matter related to Jin Woo is of the highest priority, and the king seemed really mad," the guard replied, while shaking his head.
"..." Jaggy didn’t know what to do, forget about the job, his crime seemed serious enough that the king might even kill him. Feeling so much fear, his face turned pale instantly and he fainted.
"Let’s try this game now." Vritra walked towards one of the biggest game shops, the game here seemed really fun.

The participant had to remain standing upon the plain surface of the semi-spherical metallic ball, which was quite slippery, while they would be hit with balls from all sides and the metallic ball would be moving.
If they remained standing for five minutes, they would win.
"Yes, let’s play this." Fiona seemed really excited, they bought the ticket and entered the playground, lots of couples, kids, and people of all ages were trying it.
Vritra and Fiona climbed onto two different semi-spheres, after nodding towards one another, the game started.
The balls that were coming flying from random directions and hitting them were quite heavy, it wouldn’t hurt them but would push them slightly over the slippery surface.
It wouldn’t be any fun when abilities are used so Vritra didn’t use any abilities, though using them wasn’t against the rules as long as it didn’t destroy the property or hurt anyone.

One of the balls struck his back and because of the slippery surface he was pushed forward slightly, Vritra used absolutely no strength since he wanted to check something, he barely managed to stay on the surface.
While Fiona was really into the game, she really looked like a little girl who was enjoying herself to the fullest.
Vritra was managing to stay on the slippery surface while wondering if his plan would work and after a few seconds it indeed did.
[You have acquired the hybrid skill Recoil.]
’Woah, I really got it.’ Vritra read the lines of messages, and it was a hybrid skill.
He just stood still over the surface and when the ball hit him the next time, it was bounced back at twice the force while Vritra wasn’t affected at all.
’This date is quite nice...’ Vritra thought, the two skills he had obtained were very useful, especially the recoil.

After playing around for a while longer they left the shop, they visited several other places and tried various sorts of things. Vritra and Fiona even tried riding horses, and buying various sorts of helpful Glyphs that could be helpful in daily life.

Several hours passed in the blink of an eye, finally, they decided to have dinner at the best hotel present around. Though getting a table there was hard, Vritra got it rather easily since it belonged to the royal family, and they were all aware of Vritra’s identity.
It had gotten late and dark, Vritra booked a room in the same hotel and the two soon headed towards their room, finally, it was time.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: The Roleplay
paragraphs: Fiona and Vritra silently walked towards their room while holding each other’s hand; they could feel the heat in their bodies rising.
Soon they entered the room. The moment the door was closed, Fiona put her arms over his shoulders and pressed her body against him.
And then their lips met, Vritra’s hands resting over her waist.
Fiona’s lips felt so soft and delicious; Vritra instantly pulled her lips into his mouth and began biting them, sucking them hard as if he could really pull out something from her juicy lips.
Her sweet smell filled Vritra’s nose, the warmth of her body pressing all over him.
"Mmmm~ SLURP," moaning into his mouth, Fiona felt as if her lips were about to melt. Feeling his teeth biting into her lips, she felt soft all over.
Pulling back for a moment, Fiona’s breathing was heavy as she spoke while panting: "Since this is haa haa our first time, how about we make it a haa little special?"
’Special, huh? That play with Diana indeed made our first time special. The entire sex with mom was special since it had such a taboo feeling, but what can we even do?

I don’t think she is into masochism like Diana nor into dominating like Yennefer...’ Vritra wondered, but seeing the naughty glint in the redhead’s eyes, he was sure she had already thought of something.
"Sure, tell me what you want," he questioned.
Fiona brought her lips closer to his ear and then whispered in a sultry tone: "How about we do a roleplay?"
’As expected, she is into the thrill of roleplays,’ Vritra thought and asked: "Sure, what sort of roleplay?"
"Hmmm, how about student and teacher?" Fiona said, a naughty idea filling her mind.
"You are the student and I am the teacher?" he asked.
"No, it’s the opposite. I will be the teacher, and you will be the student. And it will be the taboo relation between the two as you try to seduce your teacher despite her resistance," she suggested.
Scratching his head, Vritra imagined this scenario, and indeed it would be exciting, but he wasn’t really sure how to actually do it.
"I can try..." he said, shrugging his head.
"Alright, let’s do it. From now on, don’t break the character no matter what. The one who breaks the character first will lose, okay?" Fiona said; she wanted to try so many things with him.
"Uh... okay," Vritra said, unsure of how he should play it out, but he was rather good at acting, so he was sure he could pull it off.

Fiona took a step back, then she walked over to the bed and sat down while facing in the opposite direction. She even took out a book from the storage glyph and began to read it, her posture really looking like that of a teacher.
’Here goes nothing.’ Vritra started walking towards her while playing the scenario in his mind. Since she wanted to feel that taboo pleasure from it, he decided to play along.
"Ms. Fiona, I finished putting up the list of marks you asked me to," Vritra said as he walked closer to her. Doing roleplay like this felt quite strange but also exciting.
"Oh Vritra, thank you. You really are the best student of my class," Fiona replied with a smile as she closed the book and turned to look at him.
"Although I didn’t mean to look around, while saving those files I saw something rather intriguing," Vritra said vaguely.
"W-What did you see?" Fiona asked, her brows knitting in nervousness.

"I didn’t think that as a teacher you would be reading that sort of novels—novels of taboo relations between a teacher and students. Is that why you became a teacher? Novels like:Secret Lessons After Class,I Only Wanted Extra Credit, Not the Teacher’s Heart,My Student Won’t Let Me Sleep... tch tch, I wonder what everyone will say if they were to know what our great teacher really is."
Fiona’s cheeks had a crimson blush as she heard all that. Vritra was slightly surprised at her acting skills; she was definitely talented in this field.
"T-That’s not true, you must have seen wrong," Fiona fumbled over her words while speaking. She stood up hastily and looked really nervous.
"I knew you would say that; that is exactly why I took the proof." After speaking, he pulled out a mobile from nowhere and showed her the screen.
"Uh... That’s... I don’t know how it appeared there, maybe it is because of s-some virus or something," Fiona said. She knew that mobile was just an illusion.

"Yes, I believe in you, really. But what would happen if everyone in the college got to know about this? Will they believe you? What about your reputation, your job? Sigh, a teacher who lusts after her student... you will remain on the news for several days," Vritra said with a shake of his head as he put away the mobile.
"N-No, please, you can’t do that. I know it was wrong, I won’t do that ever again, so please just forget about it," Fiona pleaded, looking really frightened.
"So you agree, you really read these things? The ecchi romance between student and teacher?" Vritra asked, a small smile on his face.
"Y-Yes, I did," Fiona turned her head down in shame and agreed.
"Thank you, and that’s all the proof I needed," Vritra said as he pulled a camera he had hidden in the room before.

"What are you planning to do with this? Please stop, I have never treated you badly. I can even give you extra marks if you want," Fiona said in a begging tone, her face ashen as if she had just realised Vritra’s true motive.
"Haha, I don’t need those extra marks, but all I want is you," Vritra finally said, a big grin spreading across his face.
"W-What? No way, we can’t do that, that’s a crime. Please, I am begging you, don’t ask me for something like this," Fiona showed surprise and slight interest before displaying her reluctance.
"Fine, then I will just show it to everyone. We can’t have a teacher like you lingering around in the school anyway," Vritra shrugged and turned around.
But Fiona panicked. She moved forward in haste and took his hand, then taking a deep breath, she finally spoke.
"Fine, do as you wish, but you have to delete that after just this time," she said resolutely.
"I will be the one to decide that. If you do good, then I will definitely delete it, but if you don’t, then I won’t delete it," Vritra added as he faced her with a smile.
Fiona acted as if she hated his smile so much, then she nodded in reluctance.
"So, Ms. Teacher, why don’t you show your enthusiasm—show me how much you have learned from those novels," Vritra added as he just stood there and made no move.
Fiona showed a reluctant expression, but then she nodded and took a step forward.
She shut her eyes and bit her lip in nervousness. Her shaky hands cupped lightly over his cheeks before she stood on her tiptoes and gently pressed her lips against his.
It was obvious that the teacher was also aroused by the situation, as she took the initiative to deepen the kiss.

Vritra was still taking in this wonderful surprise; just being able to see her like this made him a lot happier.
But this good time ended soon, and when around ten minutes had passed, Yasmine reverted back to her real form.
She coiled around, and her head rested over his shoulder.
"Yasmine, no matter what we have to face in the future, I won’t leave your side no matter how dangerous the situation becomes, and even if you force me to leave," Vritra said, releasing a long sigh.
The moment everyone got to know that the former dragon queen was still alive, he was sure lots of strong people might target her, and the secrets associated with many things would resurface.
"Mmmm." Yasmine didn’t respond.
The two of them had thoughts of their own, but it was hard to predict what the future might bring.
After staying there for a while longer, the two of them returned to the castle.
Vritra slept on the bed between Vanessa and Yasmine.
Though it wouldn’t be long before the other two women made their way into his room and onto his bed.
The next day was just as peaceful without anything special happening, and the whole day passed rather quickly.
Finally, the day when they were about to leave for the White kingdom arrived.
"Honey, how do I look?" Vanessa asked after wearing the new dress that she had bought recently.
"Beautiful, Mom, it feels like you are getting prettier by the day," Vritra said.
He was already dressed up and was sitting on the bed with Yasmine flying around the room.
Fiona and Diana were also present there; the two seemed to have become good friends now.
"You know, even though the White kingdom is so massive, it has a very, very big slave market that even the king finds hard to stop.
It is controlled by some big organisation there," Diana said, telling all sorts of things about the White kingdom to the curious redhead.
"But I wonder why this tournament is going to happen there.
They are conducting it at such a big level and spending so much money.
It is certainly to find the strongest and most talented people in the Topaz kingdom, but what after it?" the goddess wondered.
After living such a long life, she knew a lot about all the kingdoms.
"Maybe the king is organising this tournament to get the strongest people into his army?" Fiona wondered.
"Hmmm, we will know exactly what it is for when we arrive there.
Thankfully, King Henry has suggested such a good way to enter; otherwise, it could be really difficult to enter the White kingdom, especially now," the goddess added.
"Let’s continue with this discussion later; it is time." Vritra stood up and started walking towards the door.
Yasmine disappeared into his body, and the three women nodded and followed behind him.
They walked out of the castle, and outside, King Henry, along with several of his kids and a big crowd, was waiting for them.
More than ten carriages were lined up right outside the castle gate, and one of them looked especially exuberant and lavish — it was the favoured carriage of the king.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +207}
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +103}
"Ah, you are finally here, sir.
I have made proper arrangements.
There are several servants and everything you might need on this long trip.
Although these guards are weak, they will do their best to protect you." Henry humbly walked closer to Vritra and spoke, surprising all the other people.
The group of people who were going there to participate in the tournament comprised six people.
All of them wore luxurious clothes and seemed full of themselves.
{Sin Point Gained: Stared at +6}
Vritra ignored them.
He nodded towards the guards and servants before looking at the carriage and finally said,
"Good job, we can depart immediately."
Henry really felt like shedding tears of joy — this walking abomination was finally going out of his life.
He had barely managed to survive a cataclysm that he had brought upon himself accidentally.
"Yes, sir.
Everyone, let’s not waste a moment and make Sir Jin Woo wait here.
Get to your work," Henry said, clapping in a hurry.
Vritra shook his head at the king’s enthusiasm, but he didn’t mind it.
Ignoring the curious and arrogant gazes of those six people, Vritra and the others walked into the best carriage.
It was several times better than the one they had used when coming from the Dunshire kingdom.
There were many storage glyphs present inside — some filled with food, some with money, and many other things.
"Why is the king being so respectful towards him?
Just because he won that competition and is considered the best talent among the younger generation?" one of the men who was at the middle of the 1st Legion rank spoke.
This time there was no limit to age, so all people here had high levels, and all of them belonged to the rich and noble families of the Blue kingdom.
They had clearly used their connections to become a part of this envoy.
"Hmph, I don’t know.
And don’t speak to me like we are friends, tsk, ugly men." The only woman present in the group of six wrinkled her nose.
After spitting at the ground, she turned and walked towards her own carriage.
Each of them had gotten their own carriage.
The man who was just insulted had an ugly smile on his face as he watched the woman walk into her carriage; he seemed rather happy to be insulted by her.
Soon, everything was ready, and everyone had entered the carriages.
Finally, the ride began.
Henry was crying as he waved both his hands with all his might, saying goodbye to them.
"Finally, finally I am free.
Thank you, ancestors, for protecting me." He knelt on the ground in front of everyone and kowtowed.
Vritra kept the window slightly open so the people from outside could see him and he could obtain free Sin points.
It wouldn’t be too much, but it was better to get as many as he could.
"So how do you want to spend this free time?" Vritra looked at the four ladies and questioned, but they just looked back at him with a smile.
"We are just at the first season of that zombie series.
There are still ten more seasons to go, so I don’t think we need to think about it," Vanessa said, shrugging.
’Sigh, why did I watch so many things back on Earth?’ Vritra sighed and once again became a projector for them.
The ride was rather smooth and stress-free.
They mostly stopped when it was time to eat food or when someone asked for it.
The ride was fast, so in less than a day they were out of the Blue kingdom.
Vritra had closed the window since there were no longer any people around, but suddenly he heard the distant sound of loud and rapid footsteps which certainly didn’t belong to a human.
And he knew exactly who this was.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Diddy
paragraphs: Vritra opened the window slightly and looked outside, and soon he saw a bull madly charging forward on the path present in the forest. Monk Shitless was barely hanging onto his bull.

"Pitiful one, it is I, Monk Shitless. I’ll meet you on the other side. Oh right, be careful of the blood..." Monk Shitless’s loud voice reverberated across the entire space; all the others peeked out of their carriages to look outside.
"What do you—" Vritra wouldn’t take this evil monk’s words lightly anymore; they were always related to the future, but the hint was always so useless.

But just as he tried to speak, Vritra watched as the bull charged over a slight high slope before making a big jump — but it was a large canyon just on the other side of the slope, and the bull wasn’t able to cross it.
"Uwaaaaaaaaah—" Without a loud scream, the monk and the bull disappeared into the canyon.
"Oh, shouldn’t we help him? Will he be fine?" Fiona asked as she looked out from the other window.
"I am sure he will be fine... probably. He always survives, after all." Vritra said, his tone unsure.
’Sigh, at least he should’ve told me what it was about blood.’ Vritra thought, shaking his head. The canyon wasn’t too deep and there was even water below, so the monk should’ve survived.
After the momentary disturbance, their journey continued. In the middle of breaks, when Vritra and the three women walked out of the carriage, they didn’t pay others any attention.
After crossing the forest, they arrived in another kingdom and decided to rest for a while before continuing.
One of the six people walked out of the carriage while caressing a piece of stone that he had taken out of the ground the previous day.
"Diddy, why are you holding that stone?" another man asked as he got out of his carriage. He was one of the six participants as well.
"Hehe, this is the stone where Karen spat inside the Blue kingdom. Can you believe me? She spat at me... Hehehe..." Diddy said, as he drooled over the stone.
"..." The other guy looked at him in disgust and silently took a step away. This guy was just crazy for Karen, the only girl who was also heading to the White kingdom among the six participants.
"Tch, disgusting men." With her nose scrunched up in disgust, Karen looked at the two guys before walking away. She looked at the world as if everyone owed her something.

Vritra was still thinking about the word "blood" as he got out of his carriage and stretched his body, getting many sin points from the people in the market. Fiona and the others had decided to use veils to avoid unnecessary attention.
’I wonder what his parents were thinking when they decided to give him that name. Did they predict the future or something?’ Vritra thought as he looked at Diddy from the distance.
"Let’s go eat something." Diana said as she pointed towards a shop before happily striding towards it.
Since the next kingdom wasn’t too far, they weren’t going to stop in it and would just continue forward, with the next stop being in the forest.
All the people went in different directions; they had to gather back in less than two hours though.
This kingdom was similar to Dunshire in prosperity, so there wasn’t much to see, and even the highest level was below 1st Legion rank.
After eating food and strolling around for a while, Vritra and the others returned to their carriage.
"Looks like two of those participants got into fights..." Vanessa mumbled as she glanced at the five men who were looking down on a group of young men who looked beaten up.
The five people were good friends, and they would unite when fighting.
"..." Vritra ignored them. As long as they didn’t cause any trouble, it would be fine.
Soon their ride continued. So far, it had been quite peaceful, but Vritra always felt that when things stayed quiet for too long, the approaching storm was far too terrifying.
He just spent time with his family while gathering some sin points; the soul wraiths were making sure there was no trouble around, though they wouldn’t act without Vritra’s orders.
In less than a day, the carriages had crossed the two kingdoms and finally entered the dreadful Night Forest. The trees were so thick there that it was too dark in the forest.
"Are we going to stay in the White kingdom for long?" Diana asked while munching chocolate.
"Hmm... No, we don’t really have much to do there, and with the demonic war coming, we would be pulled into unnecessary trouble," Vritra said.
But he wondered what sort of opportunities this new kingdom would bring him.
Dunshire and the Blue kingdom had given him many pleasant surprises after all, and this kingdom was much superior to them both, so there ought to be a few great treasures.
"Wow, it really is so dark here." All of them glanced outside the carriage, and it was pitch black. There was no straight road and the coachman had to be extremely careful while driving.
There were even guides who had knowledge of the areas of the Night Forest, so they could avoid the dangerous areas and pass through safely.

They continued forward for a few hours without any problem, though the atmosphere around all the carriages was rather tense. Most of the people seemed rather afraid except those six participants, who feared nothing in the world.

Vritra also stayed vigilant. Just because his strength was increasing rapidly didn’t mean he would underestimate the dangers in such unknown areas — at least his Nether Eye was not hindered by the darkness.
THUD

Just when everyone seemed to be relaxing, there was a loud sound of something falling from outside and the carriages stopped abruptly. Vritra scanned the surroundings from inside the carriage and saw dozens of fallen trees blocking their path forward.

After searching the area, he saw at least thirty men who were hiding in the darkness — surely they were bandits. Vritra focused and saw that even the strongest bandit among them was barely at the 1st Legion rank.
"Even these bandits are so strong... not even the king of the Dunshire kingdom was at the 1st Legion rank.
I guess that just shows how dangerous this forest is," Vritra thought as his body broke into tiny particles and he disappeared from inside the carriage.
In the next moment, he materialised outside in the darkness. The bandits had their ways to see in the dark, and Vritra clearly saw their startled expressions when he appeared out of nowhere.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +47}
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +47}
The guards charged outside to check the surroundings; those six participants also came out of the carriages, joking and just chatting casually among themselves.
The bandits were clearly shocked to see so many people, and the auras of those young arrogant people who didn’t hide their presence at all were a clear indicator that they needed to flee.
Just crossing this forest was going to take more than ten days at the very least. It was just the outer part of the forest, and the bandits were already at such a level.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Howlers
paragraphs: "Hmm, but I am not alone, and it is better to have a few cannon fodders in an unknown place." Vritra replied. It had been so long, he wondered if he should hunt a few demons.
Finally, Vritra sent a few of his soul wraiths to look ahead and find any creature.
Just forty or so minutes had passed when strong wind started blowing. The trees were pulled off the ground, and heavy rocks were floating in the air. It seemed to be a tornado, but not a natural one.
"Another group of bandits? Just exactly how many people are living in this place? Sigh, no wonder the guards seemed so afraid to come on this trip." Vanessa spoke, rubbing her forehead.
"The bandits this time are a little stronger and more in numbers." Vritra said lazily. The barriers of the carriages stopped them from getting swept away in the storm.

This time, a fight broke out — the guards fought against the bandits. Although the bandits had the element of surprise, the well-trained guards quickly overpowered them and killed most of the bandits, while a few managed to flee.
After everything was settled, the ride continued on its journey.
Two days had passed since they had entered the Night Forest. Till now, they had been attacked by bandits more than thirty times, and each time it seemed the bandits were getting stronger.
The guards were already starting to struggle. It seemed they wouldn’t be able to hold on to the defences for long.
All the guards seemed rather depressed since they were sure they would all be killed before ever reaching the White Kingdom.
Vritra rested his head in Diana’s lap while the goddess fed him fruits. Vanessa and Fiona were busy chatting; his mother was teaching her various arts of seduction.
The pair of teacher and student were really into their lessons; Diana was also listening to the lessons.
THUD
Once again, something fell in front of the carriage and they stopped. Vritra rolled his eyes.
He was seriously getting bored by this development; he didn’t want to expose his soul wraiths, so he hadn’t ordered them yet to make a move.
He quickly scanned the surroundings and found that this time there was no one around. After a few seconds, there was a knock on the carriage door and a low voice sounded.
"Sir, we are going to enter the area of the swamp, and make sure you don’t leave your carriages no matter what you hear on the outside.

This is the region where Howlers live — the creatures who can make all sorts of sounds to lure us into their traps. We will be safe as long as we are inside the carriages." The guard finished and waited.
"Okay, I will be careful, thank you." Vritra said as he sat up and opened the window, before asking:
"How strong exactly are these Howlers?"

"We know little about their exact strength, but I have heard even the weakest of the Howlers are at the middle of the 1st Myriad rank. As long as the king Howlers don’t make a move, we should be fine in our carriages." The guard answered.
"What about the king Howlers? How much do you know about them?" Vritra questioned. They hadn’t even reached the middle of the Night Forest, yet they were already encountering such creatures.
"About that... those creatures might even be at the 2nd Myriad rank. I had heard that with just a single scream they could make anyone go wild.
But they are very lazy and just use other Howlers to bring food — though they occasionally go out." The fear in his voice was evident.
"Okay, you can leave." Vritra nodded. As the guard walked back towards his own carriage, Vritra shut the window and asked:
"Wifey, what do you have to say about it?" Vritra asked. Yasmine’s knowledge and advice were top-notch, so it was better to listen to her.

"We will be fine, don’t worry. With the barriers you have created around all the carriages, even the king Howler’s scream wouldn’t have any effect on us. And those creatures aren’t as strong physically.
Unless some fool leaves the carriage, no one would die here." Yasmine said as she appeared in her human-like form and sat over Vritra’s lap, wrapping her arms around his neck.
The others had already seen Yasmine’s human form. They were all surprised at her appearance; she possessed the sort of beauty that could create wars and destroy races.
"Wifey, after we arrive in your kingdom, how difficult do you think it will be for you to get your body back?" Vritra asked, pulling her closer into his arms, with his head resting over her chest.
"It will be very easy. We will enter without informing anyone and just need to steal a couple of things from my house." Yasmine said, her tender lips curling into a smile.
"Oh, sounds so simple. Breaking into one of the strongest races and then into their castle, stealing something, and then leaving — yeah, simple enough." Vritra nodded.
"I mean, you would be strong enough by then that we could just enter by the front door and take whatever we want—" Yasmine was just speaking when she was interrupted by a noise from outside.
"Agggggghhhhh! T-There is a king Howler, save meeeeee! Uwaaaaaah!" The scream of a man reverberated. All the carriages fell into complete silence, but they didn’t stop moving.
The horses pulling the carriages neighed and seemed afraid of the creatures lurking in the darkness, but they weren’t normal horses either.
Despite the eerie environment, they continued to march through the swamp.
The coachman didn’t need to control the horses; they hid inside one of the carriages.
That scream was just the beginning — soon, all sorts of sounds started coming from the outside.
Sometimes it was the cries of a baby, which gave chills to almost everyone. It was like they were experiencing a horror movie in reality.
Sometimes a sweet, melodic voice would come from the outside and call out to them.
"Diddy, help meeeee, ughhh they are haa hurting meeeee, it’s me, Karen." Another scream sounded soon, and Vritra pinched his temples in advance since he knew what was going to happen.
THUD
And just as he expected, the sound of a door opening from one of the carriages sounded, followed by a loud screech and then a painful scream.
No one tried to look outside or help him, as everything suddenly became silent.
Just when everyone thought he was dead, with another loud thump, Diddy’s voice sounded from the outside. He seemed to be in pain, out of breath, and extremely scared:
"FUCK! DIE! DIE! DIE! Ughhhh, Karen, I really loved you, now you will regret not accepting me." Diddy said before going silent once again.
"Tch, disgusting men." Karen’s voice sounded from one of the carriages.
’I wonder if she only knows how to speak those two words.’ Vritra thought. He finally got a good look at the so-called Howler.
"Hahaha, I was just joking. I am still alive, so Karen, you don’t have to worry — my eternal love will always be with you." Diddy’s voice sounded from his carriage.
