It was like they were experiencing a horror movie in reality.
Sometimes a sweet, melodic voice would come from the outside and call out to them.
"Diddy, help meeeee, ughhh they are haa hurting meeeee, it’s me, Karen." Another scream sounded soon, and Vritra pinched his temples in advance since he knew what was going to happen.
THUD
And just as he expected, the sound of a door opening from one of the carriages sounded, followed by a loud screech and then a painful scream.
No one tried to look outside or help him, as everything suddenly became silent.
Just when everyone thought he was dead, with another loud thump, Diddy’s voice sounded from the outside.
He seemed to be in pain, out of breath, and extremely scared:
"FUCK!
DIE!
DIE!
DIE!
Ughhhh, Karen, I really loved you, now you will regret not accepting me." Diddy said before going silent once again.
"Tch, disgusting men." Karen’s voice sounded from one of the carriages.
’I wonder if she only knows how to speak those two words.’ Vritra thought.
He finally got a good look at the so-called Howler.
"Hahaha, I was just joking.
I am still alive, so Karen, you don’t have to worry — my eternal love will always be with you." Diddy’s voice sounded from his carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Point Farming starts!
paragraphs: After the momentary pause, the carriages started moving again.

Diddy was back in his carriage, and this time everyone was more careful. The smell of blood had already spread across the area all because of that mindless simp, so the voices sounding outside had increased exponentially.
"Sigh, how long do we have to listen to these annoying noises? Should I just go and kill them all?" Vritra thought, as several of the Howlers continued to call him out in all sorts of voices.
"We should be out of here in a few hours, so it’s better to not get involved in this mess. The Howlers and other creatures of the swamp could be really annoying," Yasmine replied.
She was sure Vritra could kill them all, but that would make him waste a lot of time.
Sighing, Vritra did his best to ignore the voices that seemed to be going crazier with each passing moment:

"SOB, someone help me! I am the king of the White Kingdom, some damn hole swallowed me and now I am stuck in this place. If you help me, I will definitely reward you greatly once we arrive at the White Kingdom."
That one voice seemed to be especially loud.
Other Howlers changed their tactics when no one from the carriages responded after a time, but that one persistent Howler seemed to be dumb and kept repeating the same thing.

"Yeah, like we believe in you, you motherfucker! You’re lucky that I can’t get out of my carriage or I would have beaten your ass until you resemble a monkey—fuck, that darned Howler bit me in the wrong place—oh, Karen, you didn’t hear that, did you?" Diddy’s voice sounded from one of the carriages.
The ride continued without any pause. The voices of the Howlers were getting more absurd by the moment—from a kid to a beautiful woman and even old people, they were making all sorts of noises.
But no one fell into their trap again.

Nearly five hours had already passed, and the number of voices had increased to more than a few thousand, but they wouldn’t approach the carriages because of the precautions taken by the guards in advance.
"These Howlers actually aren’t that problematic, as long as—" Fiona was just speaking when suddenly a shock went through the carriages and the swamp.
"Looks like the king Howlers are actually here, sigh," Yasmine spoke as she rose in the air and sensed the few strong presences outside.
"Will it be a problem?" Vritra stretched his body after getting up. Maybe it was finally time for some action.
"Yeah, just like most other creatures, hunger could make them desperate, and in desperation they could—"
BAANNNGGGGG
Before Yasmine could finish speaking, several Howler kings rammed into the carriages.
Even though their physical strength was not that high, their levels were still quite high. They received injuries but succeeded in breaking a few of the carriages.
Of course, Vritra had protected his own carriage and a few others just in time with dust, so they were unscathed. The group of six participants weren’t as lucky though.

Their carriages broke instantly since they were off guard and weren’t really taking the Howlers seriously. The moment their carriages broke, the horses ran away in panic, and the six of them were thrown out.
Vritra decided to go out and see the show—he was getting bored inside the carriage after all. Just as he was about to leave, Vanessa spoke:
"Is it safe enough for us to go outside? Staying constantly in the carriage feels a bit suffocating."
"Hmm, let me go out and check first," Vritra said, as he disappeared and materialised outside the carriage, hovering in the air.
The surrounding was still completely dark, so it didn’t really matter whether it was day or night, but Vritra could clearly see the area.

And wherever his gaze went, all he saw was those creatures called Howlers. They looked like grouped-up fish with monkey-like heads and really sharp teeth, but their skin seemed as if they had been dipped in acid.
The size of the normal Howlers was around seven to eight feet, while the king Howlers were at least twice that size.
After observing the Howlers—whose numbers easily surpassed two to three thousand—he looked at the six people who were just besieged by these creatures.
"Looks safe enough, just maintain the barrier and keep your guard up." Yasmine appeared beside him and spoke. She looked at the scene on the ground in amusement.

The number of the king Howlers was around ten, and all of them were currently busy in a fight with those six participants. The guards couldn’t get out of their carriages even if they wanted to because of the dust layer.
"Mom, Fiona, Diana, you can come out." Vritra flew lower and opened the door, then he held Vanessa’s hand and brought her into the sky while Fiona and Diana flew on their own.

Vritra formed a small platform of dust in the air and all of them stood over it. Diddy was busy fighting against two of the kings, while still trying to stick to Karen, who was clicking her tongue even while fighting against the Howlers.
The other four were also barely managing to defend.
The level of the Howler kings was high enough to kill these six with a single scream, but Vritra was kind enough to protect them with his barrier so this was only a physical fight.
"You bastard, come down and help us! What are—haa haa—you doing up t-there and just watching?" one of the men spoke as he saw Vritra standing lazily along with others.
For some reason, no Howlers were getting close to them.
"Tch. Disgusting men." Karen spoke the regular thing as she slashed at the Howlers.

Vritra just watched them fight for a while, as the six of them barely survived. Seeing that scene, Vritra was reminded of the time when he got stuck in the labyrinth, though this was nowhere as dangerous.
"I guess that’s enough entertainment for one day," Vritra mumbled. Seeing that the six people were on the verge of death, he still needed those cannon fodders in the White Kingdom after all.
A mysterious fire that seemed unreal suddenly broke out of his hand before disappearing, then a heavy mist descended across the entire place.
"Time to farm some sin points." Vritra spoke.
The number of Howlers in this swamp was more than ten thousand. He might be cautious to use the Misty Essence Mythic Halo around humans, but using it here on a big scale was completely fine.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! activated.]
A large amount of energy was instantly sucked out of Vritra’s reserves, but with his magnificent ability he didn’t really have to fear complete exhaustion. Within moments, he was back to his peak.
The Howlers and the six people paused as their gaze first went towards Vritra.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3,654}
Then terrifying versions of the Howlers rose from the swamp. Their bodies looked extremely strong, and even the weakest among them was at the 2nd Legion rank.
The number of these new upgraded Howlers was at least twenty thousand.
{Sin Point Gained: Startled +13,557}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +10,952}

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Equality
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Startled +13,557}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +10,952}
Vritra smiled as he used his mana and mental energy to control such a massive illusion.
"Let the show begin."
SCREEEEEEECCCCHHHHHHHHHHHH
KRIIIIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE
"Uwaaaaaaaah Mommy, helpppppp cough"
"Karen, Karen Karen, wait for me, let’s die together and live in heaven together, but for the crime of stealing my heart y- you might go to hell uwahhhhhh ughhh..."
BAANNNNGGGGGG
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
WHOOOSSSSHHHHHH
All sorts of sounds instantly filled the area, all the Howlers were undoubtedly frightened, even the king Howlers were no exception.
Misty Essence doesn’t just show illusions but plays with the mind of the opponent and their emotions.
Vritra’s control over this mythic halo wasn’t perfect yet, but for his current level, it was more than enough.
The Howlers saw the things they feared the most, but it was the six humans who were letting out the loudest screams.
Vritra controlled everything from the sky. All the women were awed at such a scene, everything on the ground looked too real.
There was bloodshed, many Howlers were being killed in the illusion and it seemed as if they had really died. Those creatures themselves weren’t aware whether they were dead or not.
This continued on for a couple of hours, but at some point, no matter what Vritra showed, the number of sin points pouring in remained too low, so he finally decided to end it.
As a final act, the countless upgraded Howlers ran behind the wounded Howlers who hastily hid in the swamp, even the king Howlers made their escape in dread.
"Haa that was fun." Vritra said as he descended and created a layer of dust on the swamp to stand on.
"You asshole, what do haa think you were doing?" Diddy shouted in rage, looking at Vritra as if everything was his fault.

"Let’s continue with our journey, we have wasted enough of our time already." Vritra ignored the enraged gaze of the group and turned to gaze at the frightened guards who were peeking out of their carriages.
"Tch And how do you think we are going to continue?" Karen frowned as she stood up from the ground and threw back her blonde hair, looking at Vritra as if she was about to murder him.
"I think I missed the part where that’s my problem?" Vritra said, glancing at her emotionlessly before turning back.
"Hah Excuse me, if instead of just standing there you had just helped us in time then we wouldn’t be in this situation, so yeah all of this is your fault.
There is no way I am going to travel in the smelly carriage of these low lives so I will be travelling in your carriage and you have to leave it." she said, passing her judgement.
Without even waiting for an answer she started walking towards Vritra’s carriage.

"Yes, this is all your fault, so you will have to pay for it. As the sons of the noble houses, none of us can travel along with these peasants, so we will be travelling in your carriage—" Diddy said but Karen glared at him so he went silent and added:
"Sigh fine, we will take another carriage, we will do as Karen says." The other four men also nodded, most of them seemed to like this strange woman.
"Haha You are all so funny, but if you mutter any more gibberish I will beat you until you can’t even walk on your own." Vritra said with a smile.
"Excuse me!! Who do you think you are, do you even know who I am? I am fucking Karen, now get out of my way before I break your nose.
Disgusting men, always making excuses when it is time to take responsibility blah blah blah..." Karen continued with her noisy rambling.
Her voice was so annoying that it felt like getting stabbed by a knife. Vritra massaged his temples for a moment then started walking away from his carriage.
"Hmph you should have agreed from the start, making me waste so much of—"
Vritra paused exactly in front of Karen, then he raised his right hand and in the next moment—
SLAAPPP
A crisp sound of a slap rang out in the silent and dark swamp, everyone watching froze and all of them were shocked upon seeing this.
Fiona and Diana even laughed out loud as they got over their surprise, they quickly took out the photo glyphs from their storage and took several photos of her face — it looked too funny.
"You— How dare you, I am going to—" Karen’s face turned red in shame and rage, she raised her leg to kick his lower body but before that—
SLAAPPPPP
Another louder sound of a slap rang out, then another and another...
SLAAPPPPP
SLAAPPPPP
SLAAPPPPP
All the men were so shocked that they forgot they had to go forward to stop Vritra.
Karen’s face was swollen by now, tears and snot were falling down her face as she fell back and cried while holding her burning hot cheeks.

"..." Diddy’s body trembled as he finally came to his senses, endless rage filled his mind as his eyes became bloodshot. He roared like a mad beast and charged at Vritra, pouring a large amount of energy into his arms.
BOOOOOM!!
Vritra flicked his finger, creating a terrifying shockwave which collided with Diddy’s body and blasted him dozens of meters away. All the people were terrified upon seeing this.
The four men who were planning to make a move earlier stopped in their tracks, and they finally understood why the king was so respectful towards Vritra.
"So what were you saying earlier?" Vritra said as he looked at Karen, who was frightened out of her wits. The numbing pain seemed to be suppressed by the fear she was feeling.
"Uh..." Karen sobbed even harder as she dragged her body back into the swamp, getting completely dirty, but just then another scream sounded as Diddy charged forward once again.
This time he was holding a spear, and his body seemed to have grown a bit in size — he was going all out to destroy Vritra.
"Sigh these insufferable bastards, they never learn do they." Vritra’s brows knitted, feeling annoyed. He raised his hand and punched forward the moment the spear came close to his body.
BAANNNNNGGGGGGG

When Vritra’s fist collided with the metallic tip of the spear, the spear exploded from the tip to the bottom all at once and Diddy’s hand was almost blasted to pieces, while his body was blasted away hundreds of meters like a broken doll.
He had fainted while heavy injuries appeared all over his body.
"This is your last chance, if you bother me one more time in the future, you will be dead."
Vritra said, as he glared at the group and without caring whether Diddy was alive or not, he turned around and walked into the carriage.

’Whoa, my man is so cool and he is still the same, believer of equality hehe...’ Fiona had stars in her eyes as she watched Vritra make all the arrogant people grovel on their knees within moments. Truly, there was none other like him.
She looked to the side and saw the same enchanted expression on Diana’s face, while Vanessa looked at her son with pride and amusement.

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Slave Beast Gang
paragraphs: The guards emptied two of the carriages for these people. Thankfully, there was enough space in other carriages. Five men took one of the carriages while Karen took the last one.
Diddy had survived, and although his injuries were serious, they healed pretty easily with higher-quality healing potions — though he seemed traumatised.
Then they got out of the swamp area without any further incidents. Vritra was happy that he got to collect quite a lot of sin points, though it was nowhere near enough.
"Sigh, what more are we going to face in this wretched forest?" he questioned, looking at Diana, their permanent tour guide inside the Topaz continent.
"I am not really sure about it myself. You know I have little interest in fighting. But I heard we will only be facing bandits until we have reached half of the distance to the White kingdom.
After that, the territory of the Slave Beast Gang, the biggest gang of the White kingdom, will start, and no bandits would dare go into the territory of those gangsters."
"Slave Beasts... are they the same gang that operate the biggest slave market in the White kingdom?" Vritra asked, gazing out of the window and feeling that it was a pity no one was around.
"Yes, their strength has increased to the point even the king is having trouble controlling them," Diana answered.
"Darling, do you need a massage?" Fiona said with a strange smile on her face. She seemed to have just learned from Vanessa and wanted to test it on him.
Vritra looked at his mother with a gaze saying: "Mom, why are you teaching her weird stuff?"
But Vanessa just smiled and acted as if she couldn’t understand him, so Vritra could only nod.
And so Fiona began to give her massage, while also gauging Vritra’s reaction. This sort of massage was meant to make him excited, but after several minutes she didn’t see a single change.
"Hey, what is the next region we are going to enter?" Vritra asked the coachman, who had taken his position back once again.
"Um, s-sir, the next area will be full of bandits, and the ones hunting in the next part would be much stronger than all the others we have faced before," the coachman answered carefully.
"So more bandits..." Vritra sighed and decided to take a nap. The concept of day and night seemed foreign in the Night Forest.
He put his head over Fiona’s lap and closed his eyes, lying on his back with his face touching her soft belly, as he smelled her sweet fragrance.
The ride after that was, as expected, filled with bandits.
Those men chose all sorts of ways to kill the people travelling in the carriage, but Vritra was yet to locate a bandit whose strength had surpassed his own, so the problem wasn’t too big yet.
After travelling for a couple of days, most of the guards were exhausted and a bit injured after constant fights against the bandits, so they rested in their carriages.
The six participants were so frightened of Vritra that they barely ever set foot on the ground and hid in the carriages — especially Diddy and Karen.
BOOOOOM!!
Another loud sound came from outside. The guards were in no condition to put up a proper fight against the group of more than a hundred bandits.
"Why is travelling so annoying? Anyway, let’s just treat this as a break," Vritra said as he opened the door and stepped outside. The darkness didn’t bother any of them.
Looking ahead, he saw a big crater in the ground, and more than a hundred men had surrounded them.
"Dark knight, take care of them and swallow their souls," Vritra said lazily as a dark shadow that completely mixed with the darkness rushed out at extreme speed.
The guards were frightened when they thought they would have to fight again. They were sure that before reaching the White kingdom, all of them would be dead.
Faint sounds of wind blowing were heard, but not a single scream rang out as the dark knight cut the bandits to pieces and swallowed their souls.
These low-level souls were nowhere near enough to increase its strength, though.
"Haa, such a nice cold wind... only if the smell around here wasn’t so bad." All three of the women got out of the carriage and observed their surroundings.
In less than a minute, the dark knight had killed all the men.
Vritra ignored the messages that popped up in front of him and just relaxed for a while. He filled the crater in the ground, and soon the ride once again continued.
The number of bandits they were encountering increased, and not wanting to waste any time, Vritra just made his soul wraiths take care of them in advance.
And so they were able to travel peacefully for around two more days when all the carriages stopped. One of the guards knocked on Vritra’s carriage door.
"Yes?" Opening the door, he stepped out and looked at the guard with a questioning gaze.
"Sir, now we will be entering the Slave Beast Gang’s territory, and the number of demons in this region is also quite high.
We will do our best to protect you. I just came here to inform you so you could be more careful." The guards were no longer afraid of Vritra, seeing that he wasn’t a madman.
"Okay, thank you. How long before we reach the White kingdom?" Vritra asked.
"If nothing goes wrong, then we should be there in eight or so more days. The Slave Beast Gang’s men aren’t like bandits; they would let us pass as long as we pay them enough," the guard answered.
"Oh right, how were you going to return to the Blue kingdom?" Vritra questioned. There was no way these pitiful guards could go back on their own.

"Uhm... we will see about that after arriving in the White kingdom." Releasing a long sigh, the guard said with a wry smile. Who would think about returning when they were going to die before even reaching that place?
"Alright, good job," Vritra said as he patted the guard’s shoulder and then glanced at the path they were just about to head to.
’Eight more days... wifey, you were right, just flying there would have been better.’ Vritra shook his head, but there was no point in thinking about it.

"Seriously, the teleportation ports are so nice. We can go anywhere in little time. Anyway, there is something that I can feel from the White kingdom, but maybe because we are still quite far, it is hard to tell," Yasmine said, her voice unsure.
"Hmm, I just hope it isn’t anything bad. Now that I think about it, we haven’t even used the Divine Sin Wheel to pull out new skills in a while.

I am getting a lot of points once we arrive in the White kingdom, and after upgrading the Divine Sin Arrow, I will rotate the wheel so many times..." Vritra imagined receiving more of those great hybrid skills.
"Haha, my hubby got addicted to gambling, but I am more curious about this upgrade."
Yasmine and Vritra chatted as he got back into his carriage once again. After eating food, they continued on their way.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Quintuplets
paragraphs: After a few hours, the carriages paused. A few of the guards walked out, Vritra lay in his carriage and observed the surroundings.
These new men had set up barricades to stop anyone from passing, then after taking their toll they opened the door and the carriages were allowed to pass.
’Well, that went better than I expected.’ Vritra thought.
He had thought these gangsters would be problematic to deal with, but they were quite systematic—maybe that’s how they were able to expand over such a large kingdom.
In a single day, they saw around five more barricades but no demons, so the ride was smooth without wasting any time.
Five more days passed just like that, the guards had brought enough money with them so the gangsters didn’t cause them any harm.
Finally, it was the sixth day when the carriages stopped at one of the barricades as usual. The guards went ahead to pay, but this time they weren’t allowed to just pass.
The guards gave money but the door didn’t open, so respectfully one of the guards asked: "Is there a problem? Do you need more money?"
"Do you think we are thugs or something?" the man from the Slave Beast harrumphed with a haughty expression.
’Isn’t that exactly what you are?’ all the guards thought. Just in the name of protection against demons, they had hoarded a lot of money, but thankfully not a single demon had appeared so far.
"Then why aren’t you opening the gates?" the guard asked, trying his best not to curse out this group of thugs.

"You might know, but the condition inside the White kingdom is quite critical right now. We can’t tell you the details right now, but one of our sergeants is here and he would like to check your carriages. Don’t worry, it is just for show."
The man said before walking away and taking his seat.

Soon, a man with a heavy body walked out of a wooden room. His mouth was full of something and he continued to chew on it; red liquid was leaking from the corners of his mouth which then dripped down to his clothes.
"Uh, I–It’s good to meet you, sir." The guards said as they looked at the messy man, who pulled up his pants and said in a strange tone:
"Oken uk."
"S–Sorry, sir?" the guard leaned forward to hear.
"Umm I saig oken ukCHEW CHEW." The sergeant repeated himself, pulling his pants up and shirt down. His belly was clearly visible, hanging down from his shirt.
"Sergeant is asking you to open all the carriages, he would like to check them." One of the other men said.
"O–Oh, that’s..." the guards looked at one another and hesitated.
"Ik gare a grog–ughh GULP Is there a problem? Fuck, you made me swallow that!!" the sergeant shouted and slapped one of the guards, just hard enough for him to stumble back.
"N–No sir, you can check them out." The guards knew they had no way to fight back against these gangsters, so they could only agree.
"Humph, you should have said so from the start..." the sergeant said as he pulled up his pants and walked towards the carriage while the guards started opening the doors of the carriages one by one.
The first few carriages were full of guards, cooks, and other servants. After looking at them for a moment and searching around, the sergeant continued to move forward.
Then he saw the carriage in which the five men were resting. Spitting the red fluid to the side, he asked: "Are these the ones participating in the tournament?"
"Y–Yes sir." One of the guards answered.
"..." Then he pointed to the next carriage with his chin. When the door opened, he saw a woman with a swollen face.
"Tch, does the Blue kingdom only have such ugly women? What even is that? A chimpanzee?" the sergeant spat and moved to the next carriage hastily.
"Open this, what are you waiting for?" he said when he saw the guards hesitating.
"Y–Yes sir, I will." Instead of opening the door directly, the guard knocked on the door and waited.
"You can enter." A heavy voice sounded from inside, the guard heaved a sigh of relief and opened the door.
The sergeant stepped into the most luxurious carriage and looked around, but when he saw the five people sitting on the chairs, he frowned and asked:
"Why do the five of you look exactly the same?"
In front of the sergeant were five men with exactly the same appearance, all five looked like Giga Chad.
"Of course, since we are identical quintuplets. What sort of dumbass question is that? Tsk tsk, the supply of idiotic assholes these days is truly endless." One of them said while touching his chin.
"..." The sergeant was just so baffled that he didn’t know what to say. With a frozen expression on his face, he got off the carriage.
After wiping the greasy liquid from his face, he questioned: "W–What’s up with the people inside?"
"Yeah, I can understand. They do look out of this world, I was quite surprised myself when I saw them for the first time as well." The guard said, all of them looked so good after all.

"W–Well, you can pass." The sergeant said, still seeming quite puzzled. Then he added: "There are no more barricades ahead from our group, so be careful of the demons. There are many dangerous ones lingering around."
"Yes, we will be careful." The guards cursed him internally as they got back into the carriages.
The gates were finally opened, the sergeant watched as the carriages soon disappeared into the distance.
"Identical quintuplets, how strange, I have never even seen a single person like that..." he mumbled.
"Hahaha, his reaction was so hilarious, he would be in a daze for a long while." Yasmine laughed out loud along with the other women.
Vritra had already called back the soul wraiths; it wouldn’t be good if other people noticed them.
The ride continued smoothly without any disturbance for a day more, before finally a pack of demons suddenly launched an attack on them.
Vritra was sleeping when the carriages paused and loud screeching sounds were heard from outside. He sensed lots of presences from the outside who had surrounded them.
"Damnit, why is this trip turning out so difficult?" Vritra cursed. Without wasting a second, he flew out of the carriage and before the guards could even react, he slaughtered all the demons.
Then he returned back to his carriage after letting his soul wraiths swallow their souls.
Vritra decided to continue with his sleep as the ride once again started forward. The guards were overjoyed and thankful towards Vritra, they knew it was him taking care of all sorts of dangers.
Just twenty or so minutes had passed when suddenly—
THUD THUD
The carriages stopped abruptly, and Vritra almost fell down from the bed because the pause was just too sudden. His sleep was once again interrupted, filling him up with so much anger.
Vritra jumped off the bed, and while cursing out loud, he kicked the door open and moved out:
"You persistent bugs, why can’t you just let me sleep for a while—" but Vritra had just taken one step outside when he suddenly froze.
He rushed back at a speed faster than ever while wondering: ’D–Damnit, why is she here?!!’

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Ben
paragraphs: Vritra rushed back into the carriages at a speed faster than ever before, his heart beating wildly as he wondered: ’D–Damnit, why is she here?!!’
In the sky outside, two people were hovering. The trees were quite high, so despite flying, they were still surrounded by darkness.
One of the two people was a woman Vritra was well familiar with — the Empress Yennefer Aven — and beside her was Han Gratt, her number two simp.
The two seemed to be searching for someone.
When they saw a few carriages approaching, they decided to stop them and ask something. Han didn’t want to waste any time, so he just made the carriages forcefully pause in the air.
And so, they came to such an abrupt stop.

The coachmen and the guards were frightened, but before Han could explain anything, the door to one of the carriages burst open, and they faintly saw a man who instantly disappeared back for some reason.
"Huh? Who was that..." Han mumbled.
He did feel Vritra looked a bit familiar, but since he believed Vritra was already dead, he didn’t remember him very clearly.

After all, the Empress had killed him in her anger when she had failed to obtain the inheritance, and Han Gratt had done his best to stop the news from spreading, so even the people who had witnessed the scene had forgotten about the incident.
While Yennefer was busy looking away, she didn’t get a good look at Vritra’s face, but she did feel that something was wrong. Without a word, she flew directly towards that carriage.

"Ah, don’t worry, we don’t mean any harm. I am the protector of the Human Emperor, Han Gratt, and she is the Empress. We were searching for a demon lord — have any of you seen anything strange?" Han said as he looked at the frightened men.

"N- No, sir protector, we have not seen anything out of the ordinary, and if we actually did, t- then none of us would have been alive..." one of the guards answered, his heart still beating wildly in fear and excitement.

"Ah, makes sense. It seems the Empress wants to check something; you can leave after she is done." Han said as he watched Yennefer fly towards one of the carriages. He could never know what was going on in her head.
After failing to obtain the unknown inheritance, she had always seemed a bit different. Han didn’t know what had changed, but at least she was as unruly as ever.
After landing in front of the carriage, Yennefer just pulled the door open and climbed inside. First, she saw the several women — Vanessa, Diana, and Fiona.

But Fiona’s appearance had changed. She had shorter black hair, and even her face looked different. Yennefer couldn’t recognise any of them, and finally, her gaze shifted towards the only man in the carriage.
It was a sickly man in his early twenties, but he looked so handsome and pitiful that any woman’s heart would ache for him. He held a fan in front of his face, which had the letters written on it—
PROTECTOR OF THE UNIVERSE!!
"Oh hello, pretty." The sickly young master spoke to her with a wide smile, hiding the sound of his rapidly beating hearts.
"..." Yennefer stared at the young man, who looked very handsome and was wearing flashy clothes, but something about him felt a bit off. Yet she couldn’t tell what exactly it was.
"Who are you?" she asked, narrowing her eyes at him. She was also a bit surprised that he didn’t show a lustful expression like most other men despite seeing her so up close.
The three women were surprised by the sudden intrusion. The Empress looked so beautiful even though her face was covered by a veil.

"Hello, my lady, I am called Ben, Ben Tennyson. The protector of the universe— haha, just kidding. I am— COUGH— the son of a noble from the Blue Kingdom, and I am going to the White Kingdom for— COUGH— the tournament."
In his nervousness, Vritra just took a character from the cartoon he used to watch a long time ago.

"Ben, have we met before?" Yennefer stared intently at Vritra and questioned. Vritra was exhausting a large amount of his mana as he constantly used the Misty Essence Mythic Halo to maintain his own and Fiona’s current appearance.
At his current level, the Mythic Halo could barely fool the Empress, but thankfully she didn’t attack them to confirm whatever suspicion she had.
"Is there a prob— cough cough— ah, forgive me, is there a problem, pretty lady?" Vritra asked. He didn’t want to get too much of her attention, so he did show a slight bit of interest in her.
He picked up a glass with his slender hand and started drinking water. The gazes of the four women were fixed on Vritra.
Despite knowing that it was just an illusion, Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa wanted to go ahead and embrace the handsome and weak young master — he looked as if he might faint at any moment.
Yennefer stayed silent for a moment, then spoke, as an angry look appeared in her eyes:
"...There is a demon lord I had been chasing for quite a long time, but suddenly, one day, a damned spatial crack opened in the sky out of nowhere and she got swallowed by it.
And I know exactly who is responsible for all this — the moment I catch that brat, I will strangle him myself—"
SPAT
"COUGH COUGH— ah, forgive me, I have caught a strange disease so my body keeps getting weaker. Anyway, my lady, that sort of language and anger doesn’t suit someone of your beauty and status.
And about the said person, it might have been a mistake, so remember — forgiveness is a virtue." Vritra used the Misty Essence to the peak as he tried his best to hide his shock.

’Fuck, how could there be such a coincidence? When fighting against the Grieves, the abilityNullindeed went out of control. Sigh, so now she hates me for more than one reason... She better not recognise me or I would be dead meat.’ Vritra thought.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}
Vritra almost froze as he glanced at one of the new messages, and he didn’t like the look in Yennefer’s eyes.
"There are people in this world who don’t deserve forgiveness. Anyway, you can leave now." After giving one last long look to Vritra, she disappeared from their sight and appeared back in the sky.
"Be safe on your journey... Mr. Tennyson." The Empress said, a strange sort of chill in her voice.
"Thank you, pretty lady. Oh, and are you two a couple? You look good together." Vritra said, and instantly saw a gloating expression on Han’s face.
"Y- You think so?" Han asked, barely hiding his joy.
But Yennefer frowned, and without wasting a moment, she just disappeared. This was Vritra’s way of sending away the dangerous lady who kills without giving a second thought.
"Oh, Empress, please wait for me!!" Suddenly in a great mood, the protector nodded towards Vritra and then disappeared.
"Sigh, that was so damn tough..." Vritra wiped off the sweat from his forehead and finally felt how tense his body had been.

He did feel Vritra looked a bit familiar, but since he believed Vritra was already dead, he didn’t remember him very clearly.

After all, the Empress had killed him in her anger when she had failed to obtain the inheritance, and Han Gratt had done his best to stop the news from spreading, so even the people who had witnessed the scene had forgotten about the incident.
While Yennefer was busy looking away, she didn’t get a good look at Vritra’s face, but she did feel that something was wrong.
Without a word, she flew directly towards that carriage.
"Ah, don’t worry, we don’t mean any harm.
I am the protector of the Human Emperor, Han Gratt, and she is the Empress.
We were searching for a demon lord — have any of you seen anything strange?" Han said as he looked at the frightened men.

"N- No, sir protector, we have not seen anything out of the ordinary, and if we actually did, t- then none of us would have been alive..." one of the guards answered, his heart still beating wildly in fear and excitement.
"Ah, makes sense.
It seems the Empress wants to check something; you can leave after she is done." Han said as he watched Yennefer fly towards one of the carriages.
He could never know what was going on in her head.
After failing to obtain the unknown inheritance, she had always seemed a bit different.
Han didn’t know what had changed, but at least she was as unruly as ever.
After landing in front of the carriage, Yennefer just pulled the door open and climbed inside.
First, she saw the several women — Vanessa, Diana, and Fiona.
But Fiona’s appearance had changed.
She had shorter black hair, and even her face looked different.
Yennefer couldn’t recognise any of them, and finally, her gaze shifted towards the only man in the carriage.
It was a sickly man in his early twenties, but he looked so handsome and pitiful that any woman’s heart would ache for him.
He held a fan in front of his face, which had the letters written on it—
PROTECTOR OF THE UNIVERSE!!
"Oh hello, pretty." The sickly young master spoke to her with a wide smile, hiding the sound of his rapidly beating hearts.
"..." Yennefer stared at the young man, who looked very handsome and was wearing flashy clothes, but something about him felt a bit off.
Yet she couldn’t tell what exactly it was.
"Who are you?" she asked, narrowing her eyes at him.
She was also a bit surprised that he didn’t show a lustful expression like most other men despite seeing her so up close.
The three women were surprised by the sudden intrusion.
The Empress looked so beautiful even though her face was covered by a veil.
"Hello, my lady, I am called Ben, Ben Tennyson.
The protector of the universe— haha, just kidding.
I am— COUGH— the son of a noble from the Blue Kingdom, and I am going to the White Kingdom for— COUGH— the tournament."
In his nervousness, Vritra just took a character from the cartoon he used to watch a long time ago.
"Ben, have we met before?" Yennefer stared intently at Vritra and questioned.
Vritra was exhausting a large amount of his mana as he constantly used the Misty Essence Mythic Halo to maintain his own and Fiona’s current appearance.
At his current level, the Mythic Halo could barely fool the Empress, but thankfully she didn’t attack them to confirm whatever suspicion she had.
"Is there a prob— cough cough— ah, forgive me, is there a problem, pretty lady?" Vritra asked.
He didn’t want to get too much of her attention, so he did show a slight bit of interest in her.
He picked up a glass with his slender hand and started drinking water.
The gazes of the four women were fixed on Vritra.
Despite knowing that it was just an illusion, Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa wanted to go ahead and embrace the handsome and weak young master — he looked as if he might faint at any moment.
Yennefer stayed silent for a moment, then spoke, as an angry look appeared in her eyes:
"...There is a demon lord I had been chasing for quite a long time, but suddenly, one day, a damned spatial crack opened in the sky out of nowhere and she got swallowed by it.
And I know exactly who is responsible for all this — the moment I catch that brat, I will strangle him myself—"
SPAT
"COUGH COUGH— ah, forgive me, I have caught a strange disease so my body keeps getting weaker.
Anyway, my lady, that sort of language and anger doesn’t suit someone of your beauty and status.
And about the said person, it might have been a mistake, so remember — forgiveness is a virtue." Vritra used the Misty Essence to the peak as he tried his best to hide his shock.
’Fuck, how could there be such a coincidence?
When fighting against the Grieves, the abilityNullindeed went out of control.
Sigh, so now she hates me for more than one reason...
She better not recognise me or I would be dead meat.’ Vritra thought.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}
Vritra almost froze as he glanced at one of the new messages, and he didn’t like the look in Yennefer’s eyes.
"There are people in this world who don’t deserve forgiveness.
Anyway, you can leave now." After giving one last long look to Vritra, she disappeared from their sight and appeared back in the sky.
"Be safe on your journey...
Mr.
Tennyson." The Empress said, a strange sort of chill in her voice.
"Thank you, pretty lady.
Oh, and are you two a couple?
You look good together." Vritra said, and instantly saw a gloating expression on Han’s face.
"Y- You think so?" Han asked, barely hiding his joy.
But Yennefer frowned, and without wasting a moment, she just disappeared.
This was Vritra’s way of sending away the dangerous lady who kills without giving a second thought.
"Oh, Empress, please wait for me!!" Suddenly in a great mood, the protector nodded towards Vritra and then disappeared.
"Sigh, that was so damn tough..." Vritra wiped off the sweat from his forehead and finally felt how tense his body had been.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Into the White Kingdom
paragraphs: "Ohhh, honey you look so weak..." Vanessa wasted no time as she got off her seat and hugged Vritra, rubbing her cheek against his. Fiona and Diana followed soon.

’It seems I might be meeting her again in the White kingdom, so I can’t use Jin Woo’s appearance. I guess it is time to change the character,’ Vritra thought and now decided to really be Ben Tennyson.
"Sir, should we start moving?" one of the guards approached the carriage and questioned from outside. He didn’t look inside or he would have been surprised.
"Yes." Vritra answered, finally relaxing a bit.
After six more days of travel, they had finally arrived at the boundary of the White kingdom.
Maybe it was because of the Empress and Han that they didn’t meet one demon on their way, so it was as smooth as it could get.
After getting out of the Night Forest, they finally saw the sun after such a long time. Vritra opened the window and looked outside.
The wall of the White kingdom was actually white in colour and was so high, it reminded him of that one anime which had high walls for protection.
’I wonder if these walls are also built to protect them from something.’ Vritra thought. Outside the boundary of the White kingdom, there were a lot of houses and shops.
"The White kingdom is so big, so why are they living outside?" Fiona asked, attracting gazes of the people from all around.
"A lot of people who had committed some sort of crime—after spending their time in prison—they are thrown out of the kingdom. So they have no choice but to live here.
They can’t possibly travel through the Night Forest after all." Diana answered.
"And the higher-ups of the White kingdom also know this, so they must have put them all here for some reason, maybe as some sort of first line of defence." Vritra wondered.
"Sigh... I never thought we would actually be able to arrive in the White kingdom. Just from outside, this place looks like some sort of dream." One of the guards spoke.
Even though the wall was in sight, it was still a few hours’ distance away, so they decided to take one more break since they had been travelling without any breaks for quite some time.
"Haa... I just wish I don’t meet Yennefer again. Everything else should be fine." Vritra mumbled as he stepped out of the carriage in his new character.
The six participants were still quite traumatised, but they finally decided to go out of their carriages. After carefully stepping out, they looked around and didn’t see Vritra anywhere.
"W-Where is that sir?" Diddy called one of the guards close and questioned.
"Ah, you mean sir Jin Woo? He is right there—huh? Why is someone else getting out of his carriage?" The guard and the six people were surprised.
"Um... hello, who are you and where is sir Jin Woo?" The guard approached Vritra and asked respectfully.
"Ah, I am a friend of his. You can call me Ben, and he had gone out to finish a task. He told me he would be back soon." Vritra said, looking around at the market.
The type of market that was in the capital city of the Blue kingdom was present outside of the White kingdom. The difference in strength and status was so apparent.
"Oh, okay." The guard nodded and walked away. He didn’t really care; after they entered the White kingdom their work would be done anyway.
Now he needed to worry about getting back to the Blue kingdom.
"Oh, he is not here anymore?!!" The six participants were overjoyed and their lost confidence returned instantly.

"Tch... disgusting men. How dare he slap me. I am so going to get back at him for this. Just wait till I show my talent in this kingdom and reach the top." Karen said, a look of arrogance on her face.
Fiona and Diana rolled their eyes and ignored the useless nobles, deciding instead to have a nice meal before entering the kingdom.
They weren’t sure yet what would be waiting for them in this place.

"That feeling has gotten stronger now, and I can feel it more. It is the exact feeling I got when we were in that strange space, along with Nine Pacts and the Golden Moon, when you got the Divine Sin Arrow." Yasmine’s voice sounded in Vritra’s head.

’Hmm, could there be another of the Divine’s treasures or secrets hidden here? Well, I can tell our time here is going to be anything but peaceful.’ Vritra spoke and shook his head as they headed towards one of the closest hotels.
The guards and servants were all full of joy at surviving this long and being able to see the majestic White kingdom, while the six participants once again acted as if they owned the world.
"How stupid do you have to be to act like that? Do they think you would never return or something?" Diana said as she watched the six people with a frown.
"Heh, you were similarly arrogant before, you know. You wouldn’t look equally at anyone. Had it not been for your arrogance, I might already be dead."
Vritra laughed as Diana’s expression changed to a pout. She always felt so bad about her past actions.
"But I wasn’t that stupid..." she muttered in a mosquito-like voice.
"Enough joking, let’s eat now, shall we?" Vanessa said as the waiter brought the food to their table.
After an hour or so, their break ended and they were ready to leave.
"Sir, let’s go." One of the guards excitedly approached Vritra and said before asking: "Is sir Jin Woo not going to join us?"

"Don’t worry about him, he will join us later in the kingdom." Vritra said as he climbed onto the carriage. He felt so cooped up in this small space and wouldn’t want to travel in a carriage for a long time.
"I see. He is so strong, I am sure he should be fine, haha." The guard said before walking back.
"He isn’t going to join us!!" The group of five men and one woman felt as if they were on cloud nine. That demon was finally out of their lives.
"Haha, Karen, so God really does exist. He listened to our prayers and now that bastard has disappeared. I am sure he must have met a disaster or something." Diddy said, wiping the tears of joy.
"Tch... disgusting men. Kekeke... now just wait, I will show everyone my true strength." Karen spoke, laughing maniacally.
And so, the ride began for the last time. After arriving near the large white gates of the White kingdom, they paused and joined in on the long line of people who were entering.
The checking seemed quite strict. Each person entering was getting checked up so thoroughly.
"Is it because of the approaching demon war?" Vanessa wondered, gazing at the men in armour who were doing the checking.
"Hmm, most probably. But the atmosphere seems rather tense in this place." Yasmine, who was resting over Vritra’s lap in her human form, spoke, but no one could see her because of Vritra.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Disappearance
paragraphs: Finally, after some time, it was their turn. The guards walked towards the armoured men and began to answer their questions.
"Okay, we need to check up all the carriages before you enter." One of the White kingdom’s guards said after reading the letter from the king of the Blue kingdom.
"Yes sir, please go ahead." The guard no longer felt any nervousness, anyone they were meeting wanted to do a check-up for some reason.
"..." After giving the letter back, they began to check the carriages one by one. And after twenty or so minutes of thorough check-up, the guards gave the green light for them to pass.

The large gates opened and the carriages finally entered the awaited White kingdom. All the windows of the carriages were open at this time, as everyone waited to see what this kingdom actually looked like.
"!!!" And upon entering, they were all actually shocked. The houses, the dress, and everything was so different from what they were used to.
There weren’t even carriages on the road, instead some sort of machines which didn’t need horses to pull them and were moving quite fast.

"Whoa, those things look quite similar to cars. The houses... it almost feels like I am back on earth but in the past!!" Fiona’s eyes were wide open. Unlike the previous kingdoms they had seen, there were even high buildings that resembled Earth.
The working method of everything was different. There had been many people who had come to this world from Earth in the past, but the advancement in technology was still a surprise.
’Wifey, are the places outside this continent even more developed?’ Vritra asked. This kingdom could still not be compared to Earth, but many of the technologies could be spotted here.
"Yeah, though it is all possible thanks to glyphs." Yasmine answered. She wasn’t really surprised by all this.

All of them watched the kingdom in amazement as the carriages moved through the city. They were going straight to the capital to meet the king, and for that they needed to travel around six to seven hours.
While watching the wonderful sights, the group finally arrived in the capital and in front of the castle, which seemed just out of this world.

Its structure looked so advanced and impossible. The entire castle was resting over ten pillars that raised it high in the air. Lots of guards were placed outside the door, their strength was above the 1st Legion rank.

Vritra waited in the carriage while the guards from the Blue kingdom informed the castle guards. After settling in the castle, his first goal was to gather as many sin points as he could. Not only did he plan to upgrade the arrow but at least one of his skills.
"You can enter, I have informed the commander about your arrival but be careful inside." The castle guard informed, and finally the carriages were allowed to enter.
The guards and servants separated from the six participants and Vritra’s group. They would be given separate living places for the time being.
While the group of ten was led into the castle by one of the guard commanders, Vritra was surprised since the level of all the people was so high.
"Please wait here, someone will come soon to explain a few things and make arrangements for you all." The commander said as he pointed to a room before taking his leave.

"Hah, what sort of shitty manner is it to treat your guests like this? They dare to leave us unattended? Heh, once I win the competition, I will beat the shit out of that lowly commander." Diddy said while following behind Karen.
"What the fuck! Why aren’t there any servants here?" another man said, as they entered the room.
Vritra shook his head. He took seats away from those embarrassments and chatted with the ladies with him.
It wasn’t long before a servant brought them various things to drink and eat.
And after a wait of around ten minutes, a middle-aged man wearing a robe and looking like an official working for the king entered the room and greeted them all warmly.

"Forgive me, I know this is not the best hospitality we could have given, but the times are rather tense. You ten had just arrived here, but I have bad news to deliver to you all." The robed man said as he pinched the bridge of his nose and sighed.
Finally, he continued: "Some time ago, our king, while giving a speech to the public, disappeared—or it would be more correct to say a strange spatial crack swallowed him."
COUGH COUGH
Vritra choked on a sip of juice. He put the glass aside and asked: "The king was swallowed by a spatial crack? Like how long ago was it?"
"Yes, it was too sudden, and we weren’t able to do anything. The time was around a month ago." The robed man answered.
’So it was because of me!! Fuck, so even before arriving here I had already dug traps for myself—wait, by trap there is something I remember.
While in the swamp, wasn’t there someone trying to impersonate the king of White kingdom...’ Vritra wondered, and his gaze shifted towards Diddy, who seemed frozen.
Diddy was the one to curse at that voice after all, so it really might have been the real king?!!
"Is something the matter, young man?" The official looked at Vritra and questioned.
"Uh... no, nothing at all." Vritra said, and Diddy heaved a sigh of relief. He almost pissed in his pants at the thought that he might have cursed at the real king.

"Anyway, I have already made arrangements for you all. Please follow me, I will personally show you to your rooms. My name is Sean, I am one of the ministers, and you can reach out to me if there is anything you need."
While speaking, Sean led them all to the 3rd floor of the enormous castle. It was entirely painted in white and looked really beautiful and lavish.
Ten rooms were arranged for the group, and each room was better than the rooms of kings of other kingdoms.
"So, what are you planning to do now?" Yasmine asked, as Vritra entered his room and started looking around.

’The tournament is still quite far away, and I need to know a bit more about this place before I can plan anything, while also being careful of Bone Blood Cult, Nine Pacts, Yennefer and... that’s all I think, for now.’ Vritra answered, as he made sure that there was nothing wrong with the room.
"Honey, these rooms are so spacious. What do you think if the four of us just take one room? You know, we should conserve space..." Vanessa asked, smiling mischievously.
"...Sure, if they are fine with it." He replied, wondering what his mother might be planning now, as Vanessa went to meet up with Fiona and Diana.
"Hmm, should we go out and explore this place a little?" Vritra wondered. He needed to gather more information and maybe try to find what Yasmine was sensing.
Vritra walked out of the room as well. He went to the next room where the three ladies were talking. After informing them, he walked out of the castle.

"Hmm, should we go out and explore this place a little?" Vritra wondered.
He needed to gather more information and maybe try to find what Yasmine was sensing.
Vritra walked out of the room as well.
He went to the next room where the three ladies were talking.
After informing them, he walked out of the castle.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Agent
paragraphs: It is quite easy to get information in such a big and crowded kingdom. Pulling out the paper fan from his inventory, Vritra started walking in the market street.
Although this place was so prosperous and developed, most of the people walking on the street had a slave or two with them. Some slaves were humans and some were demi-humans.
’How do I increase my sin points though?’ he wondered while just walking aimlessly.
Just then a message popped in front of Vritra.
Quest: Become and stay as an agent for five days.
Reward: The Divine’s secret map.
"!!!" Vritra paused all of a sudden, as he dumbfoundedly stared at the message. This was the first time he had obtained a quest not related to his survival and the reward...
’The Divine’s secret map, but what does it mean by agent? Do I have to join some kind of organisation?’ he wondered. The reward was too appealing to ignore this quest.

"It might be related to the thing I had sensed before, we have to obtain that map at any cost." Yasmine spoke. Anything related to the Divine is a treasure that could easily match the mythic halos and the greatest of the treasures in all the universes.

’Yeah, I do plan to get it but first I have to find what agent means. It would have been so much easier had this message just included details.’ Vritra complained. He looked to the side and saw a fancy restaurant.

Vritra continued to move and soon found a rather average hotel with a lot of people eating there. It is easy to obtain information at crowded places. So he soon walked to a table where three people were seated. All of them looked like normal workers.
"Can I take this seat?" Vritra asked, grabbing the attention of the three.
All of them glanced up and looked at the sickly man in expensive clothes, though these clothes seemed a bit out of place for the White kingdom.
"Are you new in this place?" the first man asked, putting down his booze.
"Yeah, so I wanted to talk to someone, how about I pay for your food?" Vritra asked and sat down. Of course, the three of them were happy upon hearing about free food.
"Sure, sure, young friend, but are you ill?" the second man asked, patting Vritra’s shoulder lightly.

"Sigh... Yeah, both my parents died before I was born. It wasn’t until I was a couple of years old that I started speaking, and haa you won’t believe this, but only after growing up did I find out that my height couldn’t grow anymore. My life has been very hard..." Vritra replied, his tone full of self-misery.

"Sob... My little brother, I didn’t know you suffered so much. You can treat me as your brother from now on and I will help you settle here properly. Just tell me if you need anything." The first man said.
The three of them were fairly drunk, but maybe the second man wasn’t as drunk.
"Before you were born, hmm?" he wondered.
"Forget about all that, drink more." Vritra filled their glasses and asked for more booze, then he decided to get to the point.
"The atmosphere in the capital seems quite tense, is something wrong?"
The laughter of the three men instantly stopped. They looked almost sober as the third man spoke:
"You have not heard it yet it seems, but around a month ago, our king disappeared and since then there has been no news of him.
Of course everyone is panicked, the demons might start the war at any time and without the king how are we going to survive?"
"Oh, that’s so terrible. But anything aside from that?" Vritra probed further.
"Hmm... You have heard about Bone Blood Cult, right? Those mad cultist bastards have been too active lately.
Many people have even disappeared, and everyone believes they might also be behind the king’s disappearance." The first man said as he gulped another glass of booze.
"Oh, BBC huh, yeah those pigs need to die. But has there been some kind of recruitment around here?" Vritra just asked directly.
"Yes, there is actually a recruitment currently going on, but don’t tell me you want to join it?!!" the second man asked, as the three looked at him strangely.
"Uh... is there something wrong with joining it?" Vritra questioned.
"Of course, it is the recruitment of the Slave Beast Gang after all. You want to be a gangster? Those assholes are also big sinners, selling off people is such a big crime, sigh." The first man said.

"Ah, so is there a name for this post? By the way I am not planning to join it, but I should still know about it." Vritra asked. Those gangsters seemed to be quite systematic, so it really might be a post for that gang.

"What rank would those kidnappers need? They are just recruiting people who could kidnap their targets, but they are calling it something like agent." The third man answered, anger evident in his voice.
’Fuck, why does it have to be them?’ Vritra felt a headache coming. He didn’t want to be a part of such an organisation but he needed to complete the quest.
"But why is the king not stopping them? The slavery is going on so openly." Vritra said and looked towards the roads, where all the rich people had slaves with them.
"Our great king is a kind man and he loves all his people too much. It is under him that the White kingdom has seen such a big development.

But before he knew it, the kingdom was split into two religions. Those gangster bastards played it all with their minds, creating a fake god of slavery, and they were able to pull nearly half of the population of the White kingdom towards them.
There is no way our king could murder half his subjects." The first man answered.
’So the people here are crazy about religions?’ Upon hearing that, Vritra’s lips curled up and the perfect idea popped in his mind.

’The third religion would soon be coming to this kingdom I guess, haha I am going to get so many sin points by just speaking a few words.’ Vritra knew that people crazy over religion are quite similar to cultists. As long as he could gain their trust and reverence, then he could get hundreds of thousands of sin points by just sitting.

"Thank you for telling me all that, it was so nice to talk to you." Vritra stood up, but putting a pause to his excited thoughts he asked: "You people wouldn’t know where the recruitment is going on, right?"
The three looked at him strangely, so Vritra added: "I should know so I don’t end up there accidentally."
"Ah, yeah makes sense. The recruitment is going on at the 1st base of the Slave Beast Gang, which is quite close to the castle.
If you ask someone they could easily point out the direction so you don’t end up there accidentally." The third man nodded in understanding and replied.
Vritra paid the bill for them and then waved at the three happy men. Walking in the market aimlessly, he started thinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: The Thief
paragraphs: ’I just need to join those gangsters and stay in their gang for five days, it shouldn’t be too hard, right? And I don’t really need to kidnap anyone, but why would the system give me such a strange quest?’ he wondered.
"It does seem strange, the system although gives quests rarely — which isn’t certainly true in your case — but it would never try to send you to the evil path.
Maybe there is some reason behind making you join it." Yasmine said. Vritra couldn’t be measured by normal standards after all.
’Yeah, I will only know about it after going there, I guess—’
WHOOSH
Suddenly, a man in his thirties breezed past Vritra at a really fast speed. He was so fast that normal people wouldn’t even notice him, though Vritra felt his presence the moment he got close.

Vritra felt a faint sensation as if he had just touched his shoulder, but the man didn’t pause and continued to run at extreme speed. His strength was definitely at the peak of 2nd Legion rank or even above.
Even Vritra was having trouble keeping track of him with his eyes.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Vritra used the third eye to its limits, but under his disguise the eye didn’t appear over his forehead. Instead of the Intra Shuffle, he was using the Misty Essence after all.

And instantly he saw how that man, who was wearing normal worn-out clothes, was tapping on people’s shoulders while running at such speed, and every time he tapped on a person’s shoulder, a faint light flashed before disappearing into his hand.
Vritra was shocked to find exactly what was going on.
’He is stealing directly from people’s inventory?!!’ Without wasting a moment, Vritra scanned his own inventory and saw that aside from some gold coins nothing had disappeared.
"NO!! ZENGIS ISN’T THERE!!" Vritra was instantly enraged. Maybe he just stole Zengis thinking of it as some treasure, but there was no way Vritra could let him take away his best friend.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength + Endurance → Agility]
Agility: 187,773
Strength: 29,549
Endurance: 28,731
Vritra’s speed increased and with a slight push of his feet, his body exploded forward at extreme speed, even surpassing the thief.
Pushing himself to the limits, Vritra quickly got close to the other guy and muttered.
"Forbid: Agility."
[Forbidden Activated]

The thief was baffled as his speed suddenly decreased. He almost stumbled but managed to balance himself just in time, but when he glanced back and saw Vritra catching up to him, he was even more shocked.
He could even sense a strong killing intent coming from the person in his pursuit.
’He is only around the middle of the 2nd Legion rank, I am sure I can take care of him on my own, but it wouldn’t be good to fight here.
I have to bring him away from the crowd.’ The thief thought as he gritted his teeth and pushed his skill to the limit, exhausting a large amount of energy, and once again his speed increased.
"..." Vritra started to blast dust near his back, making loud explosive sounds, not caring if he was pulling attention towards himself as he got a boost once again.

He could tell what the thief might be thinking, and that’s why he was just focusing on running. Vritra soon appeared beside the man in worn-out clothes and delivered a punch packing all his physical strength in.
BOOOM
The thief barely managed to dodge the attack but still a loud noise was created as a shop’s ceiling was blown into the sky.
’Damnit, I only stole a few gold coins from his piles of treasures and one of those low-level stones, why is he chasing me as if I have stolen his family heirloom?
And he is making so much darn noise, things will get too problematic at this rate.’ The thief cursed. He was just stealing innocently, why did Vritra have to react so violently?
Stomping his feet against the ground, he flew into the air and rose high up before rushing away.

Vritra also rose high. He extended both his hands to his sides as they grew in size to the point they looked like gigantic dust hands, and then he slapped at the thief with both hands with all his strength.

This time the thief wasn’t fast enough to dodge, so he could only defend against this attack. Just in time he took out a glyph and inserted his mana into it as it transformed into a shield, and wrapped around him.
BAAANNNNGGGGGGG!!
CRACK
But when the attacks landed on him, the shield broke apart after holding on for a second, and finally the thief was forced to take the brunt of the attack.

’Ughh, he is certainly strong for someone his level, but I am still sure I can handle him on my own.’ he thought. The powerful attack barely did any damage to him, but it did attract the gaze of thousands of people towards the two giant hands in the sky.
{Sin Points Gained: Watched +14,753}
{Sin Points Gained: Shocked +16,925}
{Sin Points Gained: Amazed +17,183}
{Sin Points Gained: Frightened +12,064}
Lots of messages popped in front of Vritra but he didn’t pay them any attention. His sole focus was the thief who had stolen Zengis.

Vritra was even ready to use the demon lord’s energy if that’s what it took to kill that guy, but a part of his brain was still rational and he knew exposing himself in front of so many people would lead to great trouble.

’Tch, he looks so weak as if he might die by a light breeze, but how is he so fast despite his level? Should I just throw back his coins and that stone?’ But being a respectful thief, how could he just return something he had stolen? Wouldn’t that ruin his reputation as a thief?
The man took the challenge to his ego and doubled down his effort on escaping. He wasn’t called the White Flash for no reason, not even the capital guards could keep up with his speed.
"Heh, catch me if you can—" looking back with a mocking look, he said to Vritra.
BANG
The moment he turned his head forward, the thief’s face smashed into some sort of dark fog that was way too solid. Moving at such high speed and then colliding, he received some real injuries.

His nose broke instantly and waves of blood splattered out, cracks appeared in his skull and his head spun like crazy. The thief’s body fell down at high speed as Dark Knight disappeared after its task was complete.
BANNGGGG!
Vritra changed his direction and flew towards the falling figure who headed towards some sort of round open field and then smashed into the solid floor, creating a big hole in the ground.
BOOM
Vritra landed on the ground with a loud sound, as he walked towards the crater with his fists balled. This thief was definitely going to pay the price for his deed.
Jumping into the crater, Vritra grabbed the dizzy and bloodied man by the collar and shook him violently before speaking: "RETURN ZENGIS TO ME, RIGHT NOW!!"
"Ughh, cough cough..." the dizzy man soon recovered from his injury a little bit. He was about to shout back when the two noticed hundreds of pairs of eyes locked onto them.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Onest
paragraphs: Vritra held the thief’s collar and shook him violently, just when the dizzy man was about to shout back, the two noticed hundreds of pairs of eyes locked onto them.
He and the thief looked around them, it seemed they had accidentally crashed into some sort of event, and almost all of the people gathered there seemed above the 2nd Legion rank.
After looking at them, Vritra focused his attention back on the thief as he slapped him hard before speaking: "Return what you stole from me."

Getting back to his senses, the man pushed Vritra’s hands away and jumped back, rubbing his head and wiping off the blood; after cracking his jaw he spoke: "Come on dude, I only stole just a few gold coins, I didn’t think you would be that petty. Ha, just take them."
After speaking he threw the gold coins towards Vritra as they landed near his feet, but Vritra’s face remained just as enraged.
"I don’t need the gold, return Zengis to me."
"Huh? I am a respected thief, not a kidnapper, I have not taken anything other than those gold coins and a low level weapon, you know I was testing my skills." He said.
"You crook, that is Zengis, return him to me." Vritra shouted, barely holding himself from transforming into a demon and turning his head into minced meat.
"What?!! So all of this was just because of a low level stone?!!" he asked in surprise.
"That is my friend, now shut the fuck up and return him." Vritra said as he took a menacing step forward.

"Hah What a psycho, fine take it back. And I am not Crook, my name is Onest." After speaking he took out Zengis from his inventory and then tossed it towards Vritra who caught it and after looking over it, he put Zengis back into his inventory.

"Onest? Were your parents on meth when they named you? You should be named Mugger. And since you are so desperate then keep this, your well-earned pittance." While speaking, Vritra flicked his finger as the gold coins on the ground flew towards Onest.
"You jerk, I am not a beggar!!" Onest shouted as he dodged the deadly gold coins.
"Heh you speak as if being a thief is better than being a beggar. You useless weight of society." Vritra retorted.
"At least I am not psycho enough to call a rock my frien—" Onest was speaking when the two’s fight was interrupted.
"Young men, stop fighting. Sigh Seriously, the two of you are fighting like teenagers—" An old man stepped out of the crowd and spoke.
"But I am nineteen." Vritra looked at the old man and said, making him pause.
The old man had a height of around five feet and a long beard, he stood with his chest puffed out and hands behind his back, the aura around him was quite strong.
The old man seemed centuries old and with a calm demeanor.
"Hmmm Interesting, anyway, you two are here for the recruitment, right?" the old man questioned, his eyes narrowing dangerously at the two.
A heavy pressure descended upon the two, making them freeze for a moment.
He was way too strong, definitely even stronger than Dark Knight and Hellmancer. Vritra and Onest glanced at one another but none could speak a word.
After a moment, Vritra asked while enduring the oppressive pressure: "... This is the recruitment for the Agent position, right?"
The old man relaxed and the pressure disappeared instantly, he smiled towards Vritra and with a curt nod of his head he replied:
"Yes, although you came a bit late but seeing your youthfulness I am reminded of my younger days, haa I still remember my first love. Cough anyway, I have decided to give you a chance."
"But sir, all the others had already been tested, I don’t think they would be happy about this—" a man who looked like someone managing the event spoke respectfully.
And the more than hundred people who looked exhausted and worn out were glaring at Vritra and Onest.

The old man raised his hand and silenced everyone, then he sized up the two young men. Onest looked to be in his twenties, and quite handsome, his muscles were properly developed but he had a lean body, looking very agile.
He had brown hair and a face that looked so innocent, but from his clothes he seemed rather poor.
On the other hand, Vritra looked rich, extremely handsome and very weak, as if he was suffering from some serious disease.
But the strange thing was that just now, it seemed Vritra was the one who was winning in their battle despite his appearance and lower level.
"I have made up my mind, I will let these two youngsters take the tests, we are searching for the best, what does it matter if their tests were taken a little late." The old man spoke, glancing back.
’Sigh so this is the Slave Beast Gang, how strange that I ended up here. But since I was planning to join anyway so I guess it’s all good.’
Vritra thought, then he glanced at Onest and said in a whisper: "This kind of place is just perfect for a mugger like you."
But unlike what Vritra expected, Onest didn’t retort, instead he dazedly stared around at the people and the place.
Vritra was new here so he wasn’t aware, but as someone living in the White Kingdom since birth, he was well aware about the organisation they were surrounded by.

’S- Shit, how did I end up at the base of the Golden Moon? I am a thief, how can I join the Golden Moon?!!’ he gulped. What he didn’t know was that a demon was also about to join the Golden Moon along with him.
"Sir, I am ready to take the tests." Vritra said, feeling amused by Onest’s reaction.
"Good good, and what about you, young man?" the old man looked at Onest and questioned, there was a faint smile on his face.
"Um... I just came here to bring this good friend of mine to this place, since he is new here, anyway I will be taking my leave now." Onest said, then turned around.
"Aye Don’t be shy now, my friend, you were so excited about becoming an agent. Haha sir, he is just nervous, my friend here is a little sissy.
Sigh You won’t believe, he still needs to hold his mum’s hand while peeing at night." Vritra said with a shake of his head.
’You Fuckerrrr, stop it!! We just met, this psycho I am so going to skin you alive.’ Onest felt like crying, as he chewed on his fingers.
"N- No sir, I am not like that— I mean I am not here to—"
"Hahaha You two are quite funny, in any case, let’s not waste anymore time and get to the tests, shall we?" the old man interrupted him and pointed towards one part of the large field.
’Heh How do you like that, asshole Mugger.’ Vritra looked at him with a big grin.
’Just you wait, psycho, I will get back at you for this.’ Onest cursed, as the two were brought in front of a square platform.

"That is my friend, now shut the fuck up and return him." Vritra said as he took a menacing step forward.
