chapters.title: Chapter 289: Suspicious
paragraphs: "Oh, how careless of me, I almost forgot to introduce myself. I am Joey, what are the names of you youngsters?" the old man asked, as he stopped in front of a large square platform.
"I am Ben Tennyson." Vritra said, wondering what sort of tests this evil organization would have.
"I am Onest." Onest said, releasing a sigh and leaving himself to his destiny.

"So, Ben and Onest, your first task will be to fight against a dummy and survive against it for ten minutes. It will be a couple of levels higher than you, but don’t worry, you don’t have to put your life on the line for this." Joey explained while pointing towards the square platform.
"So who among you two will be going there first?" he questioned, looking at the two with a calm smile.

"I will—" Vritra just wanted to get this over with, so he didn’t want to waste any time. But just as he raised his hand, one of the organizers of the event ran up to Joey and whispered something into his ear.

"Oh, why all of a sudden?" Joey looked quite surprised after hearing the news, then he straightened his clothes and combed his beard with his fingers while hastily walking towards the door of the field.

’What is going on now?’ Vritra thought. Everything was so strange from the start. Right after receiving that quest he somehow ended up at this place, the place of the Slave Beast Gang, it was too much of a coincidence.
Vritra and Onest glanced at one another, then looked away in hatred and watched the old man walking towards the door in a strange manner—he seemed to be tripping.
All the calm demeanor and aura he showed earlier seemed to have disappeared.
Just then, two new guests appeared at the gates of the field. Vritra leaned to the side to look ahead of Joey and froze the moment he saw the guests.

"Welcome, Empress!!" Joey shouted in an excited tone, then he added: "A- And Protector Han, welcome. I wonder why you two suddenly decided to come to this place when you clearly rejected the offer earlier."
"Why, we can’t come after refusing?" Han said, narrowing his eyes to put the old man in his place.

’I wonder too why the Empress suddenly wanted to come to this place, sigh, as if she wasn’t already strange enough, and now her behavior is becoming so random.’ Han thought, but he just loved every side of her.

Even if the two couldn’t be together in this life, he would always stay close to her and protect her from every kind of danger. If he had enough power, Han wouldn’t have let her get engaged to the king in the form of a deal.

"I—T- That’s not what I meant, haha. Please enter, I had already prepared a lot of nice dishes for you. But unfortunately, all the participants have already given their tests—oh wait, only two are left. If you want, I can push them to some later time." Joey spoke, shivering under the pressure of the Protector.

"There is no need for that, I will watch the remaining tests." Yennefer said, as her gaze shifted to the two boys standing in the distance. To be specific, she focused on the weak-looking young master, who seemed to have become paler.
"Oh, that is perfectly fine. Please come inside, I have also prepared good seats for you." Joey said as the three walked into the field.

’What the hell?!! How come she is here too? And wasn’t this supposed to be the Slave Beast Gang’s recruitment? Then is she here to stop it? Or did she allow such a thing?’ Vritra felt like pulling his hair out.
The Empress was a dangerous woman. If she really were to find out he was Vritra, she would kill him first and ask questions later.
"H- Hey, is she here to stop the recruitment?" Vritra leaned to the side and asked.

"Huh? Why would she stop it? Well, she kind of holds a high position in the Golden Moon, so she must be a guest in their recruitment—" Onest answered. He straightened up; as a thief, how could he not feel afraid in the presence of those two?
"You mean to say this is the recruitment of the Golden Moon?!!" Vritra abruptly turned his head and asked in shock.

"Of course it is, then did you think all these people are here to get admitted to a kindergarten?" Onest replied, sighing to himself. It seemed either his profession as a thief would come to an end, or he would end up in prison.
’I guess, if I can pass the test then joining the Golden Moon wouldn’t be so bad, not that I have a choice.’ Onest thought, and decided to let fate take its course.

’Fuck!! Why do both organizations have recruitment going on at the same time and for the post with the same names?’ Vritra cursed. He wasn’t sure anymore which Agent the system meant, but he had to get out of there.
"These are the only two participants left now, they were a bit late." Joey said.
"..." Onest froze, and without saying anything he just bowed.
"Hello there, pretty lady and her... friend." Vritra quickly got into character, trying to be as calm as possible.
"Ben, is it? I didn’t expect to meet you again so soon." Yennefer said, the corners of her lips rising ever so slightly.
’Damnit, she definitely came after knowing I am here, so she has suspicions about me.’ Vritra looked at that slight smile and felt goosebumps.
"Oh, it is you, good man." Han also recognized him; this was the person who mistook him for the Empress’s husband after all.

"Yes, I am Ben. It is really nice to meet you, but I have something urgent so I will be taking my leave now. And sorry, sir Joey, it seems I won’t be able to get that post." Vritra said. But before he could take a step, the cursed Onest pulled his arm and spoke:
"Aye, don’t be so shy now. I know you perform bad under pressure but everything will be fine. Sir Joey, we are childhood friends and I know him well. Let’s start the test."
"Empress, your seats are that way." Joey said respectfully, but Yennefer didn’t reply, her piercing gaze burning holes in Vritra’s weak body.
"We are fine, get started with your recruitment." Han said, seeing the strange behavior of the Empress.
"Okay then, Ben, why don’t you head inside first." Joey said.
Vritra sighed, and trying his best to maintain his fake identity, he stepped onto the square platform. The moment he entered, a barrier appeared around the platform.
A faint light passed through Vritra’s body, probably to gauge his level, and then a glyph rose from within the land which transformed into a metallic puppet.

Its body structure was similar to a human’s, and it looked really agile. From outside Joey added: "These dummies can’t use mana, but their physical aspects are enough to match your level, so be careful."
’It’s fine, it’s fine, she hasn’t recognized me yet.’ Vritra refused to even look at Yennefer as he focused on the puppet. Then he took out a sword from his inventory and got ready for the battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Bounded
paragraphs: ’Just ten minutes against this thing.’ Vritra’s shift skill was still working so his agility was at max, and so he didn’t really have to worry about dodging the attacks.
But he wondered: ’Will the forbidden skill work on this puppet?’
’Forbid: Agility.’
[Forbidden activated.]
And it did. The forbidden even worked against things that aren’t alive. Vritra hadn’t really thought about this before.
"Alright, start!!" Joey gave a loud shout. Instantly the puppet rushed in Vritra’s direction, it had no fingers but two heavy fists.
WHOOSH
Jumping to the side, Vritra easily dodged the punch, though he acted as if he was on the edge.
Aside from his Blood Lock and Fourth Dimension, Vritra hadn’t really shown any of his skills to Yasmine, yet he was careful not to show anything.
If she researched even a little about him, then she might know about his dust ability.
"Ughh." A kick landed on Vritra’s shoulder as his feet skidded against the floor, but he barely stopped himself from colliding against the barrier.
Vritra glanced towards Yennefer and was startled when he saw the faint smile on her face widening ever so slightly. Maybe she could tell that Vritra was holding back.
’Fuck this.’ Vritra thought, and then stood straight as the puppet approached him, its fist swinging with dangerous speed and strength.
’Forbid: Mana.’
[Forbidden activated.]
The moment forbidden was activated, the light glowing in the puppet’s eye sockets went out and it fell down with a heavy thud just a few inches in front of Vritra, without a single trace of movement.
"Oh, A- And we have a winner." The old man announced in bewilderment. Even he wasn’t able to see exactly how Vritra had defeated the puppet that was supposed to be stronger than him.
"H- He won? Just like that? Is the match rigged or something?" Onest and all the participants who had already given their tests looked at Joey and others from Golden Moon suspiciously.
Only Yennefer and Han looked at Vritra in amazement, but even they weren’t sure exactly what sort of skill he had used.

The barrier disappeared and Vritra walked out, but his steps came to a halt when he found Yennefer standing in his way. Maintaining a fake smile, he questioned: "Do you have anything to say to me, my lady?"
"Hmm. Clever, stopping the flow of mana to defeat the puppet. But I wonder how exactly did you stop it..." Yennefer said, looking deeply into his eyes as if searching for secrets.
"Haha. That’s a secret." Vritra replied. To others it might seem the two were flirting, but Vritra was clearly fighting for his life.

"Are you sure we have never met before? You clearly resemble someone I met before, someone I have seen very, very closely..." the empress asked. Her scent and those eyes were really intoxicating; all the men felt their hearts skip a beat when they heard her speak.
’How strange, the empress doesn’t speak too much to strangers.’ Han wondered, but he didn’t really mind since Ben was a good guy.

"Oh, there is no way I can forget about a lady as beautiful and calm as you. Maybe you are mistaking me for someone else." Vritra said, and before Yennefer could speak anything else, he stepped to the side and started speaking to Joey.
The empress’s natural aura was so oppressive that it was hard to talk to her, especially if you knew she might kill if you got caught.
"I heard the Slave Beast Gang also has a recruitment going on currently, and the post there is Agent as well." Vritra asked.
"Those fuckers—sigh, sorry for the language—but those bastards just copied us. I just wish I could put them in their place. They only created that event after hearing about us."
Joey’s face turned red in anger, then taking a deep breath he spoke: "You did excellent just now. Can you tell me a little about yourself?"

Vritra glanced at Onest, who had already entered the square platform and was easily evading the puppet. Then he looked at the empress, who didn’t seem the slightest bit interested in Onest and was only looking at him strangely.

"Actually, I am from the Blue Kingdom. I had just recently come here and I heard about this recruitment. I don’t really have any family aside from a few friends, and about that thief, I don’t really know him..." Vritra made up a few things.
Within a few minutes, even Onest actually defeated the puppet in a strange manner that most present weren’t even able to understand.
"Whoa, another one?!!" Joey looked truly shocked. He thought for a couple of minutes and finally spoke: "Alright, I have decided.

Although there was only supposed to be one post originally, now there will be two. I need to do a simple background check on you two, but that’s just formality. So you two are officially the Agents of the Golden Moon."
The moment he spoke that, all the other participants were enraged and they started shouting.
"What kind of scam is this? So you already had these two chosen for the post? I didn’t expect something like that from the Golden Moon."
"I am going to complain about you, I am clearly better than those two—"
"SCRAM!!" Joey gave no explanation as he glared at the participants, frightening them with his aura as their bodies stiffened and they had no choice but to leave silently.
[You have successfully become the Agent!!]
A message flashed in front of Vritra. He felt better knowing that at least he wasn’t at the wrong place.
Soon all the participants left the field, grumbling to themselves about the unfairness of the world.
"Joey, I don’t think you need to do a background check about Ben. I know him and he is trustworthy." Yennefer spoke all of a sudden.
She was behaving so different from her real character.
"Oh, okay. I understand." Joey nodded and began to explain a few things to Vritra and Onest.
The job of an Agent was quite dangerous, but for now their tasks would be of low level and their position in the Golden Moon would be rather high.
They would officially join the Golden Moon the next day. After getting all the details, the two of them decided to leave the place—they didn’t want to stay in such a dangerous place anymore.
"Goodbye, Ben." When Vritra was leaving, Yennefer said with no emotion on her face.
"Uh... Goodbye, my lady." Vritra said and walked out of the field.
"You bastard, you made a thief join the Golden Moon. How absurd is that? What will happen to my reputation now?" Onest spoke after walking some distance away from there.
"What reputation? I am sure people call you by curses more often than by your name." Vritra said, while thinking that isn’t it more absurd for a demon to join Golden Moon.

The two ignored one another and went their separate ways. Vritra headed towards the castle. He would think about his plan of farming sin points and getting that map later. For now, he just wanted to be away from Yennefer’s evil clutches.

"Heh. Hubby, looks like you two are bound together by an invisible thread already. The more you try to avoid her, the more she appears in front of you. I also feel she might have suspicions about you." Yasmine spoke.

Only Yennefer and Han looked at Vritra in amazement, but even they weren’t sure exactly what sort of skill he had used.
The barrier disappeared and Vritra walked out, but his steps came to a halt when he found Yennefer standing in his way.
Maintaining a fake smile, he questioned: "Do you have anything to say to me, my lady?"
"Hmm.
Clever, stopping the flow of mana to defeat the puppet.
But I wonder how exactly did you stop it..." Yennefer said, looking deeply into his eyes as if searching for secrets.
"Haha.
That’s a secret." Vritra replied.
To others it might seem the two were flirting, but Vritra was clearly fighting for his life.
"Are you sure we have never met before?
You clearly resemble someone I met before, someone I have seen very, very closely..." the empress asked.
Her scent and those eyes were really intoxicating; all the men felt their hearts skip a beat when they heard her speak.
’How strange, the empress doesn’t speak too much to strangers.’ Han wondered, but he didn’t really mind since Ben was a good guy.
"Oh, there is no way I can forget about a lady as beautiful and calm as you.
Maybe you are mistaking me for someone else." Vritra said, and before Yennefer could speak anything else, he stepped to the side and started speaking to Joey.
The empress’s natural aura was so oppressive that it was hard to talk to her, especially if you knew she might kill if you got caught.
"I heard the Slave Beast Gang also has a recruitment going on currently, and the post there is Agent as well." Vritra asked.
"Those fuckers—sigh, sorry for the language—but those bastards just copied us.
I just wish I could put them in their place.
They only created that event after hearing about us."
Joey’s face turned red in anger, then taking a deep breath he spoke: "You did excellent just now.
Can you tell me a little about yourself?"
Vritra glanced at Onest, who had already entered the square platform and was easily evading the puppet.
Then he looked at the empress, who didn’t seem the slightest bit interested in Onest and was only looking at him strangely.
"Actually, I am from the Blue Kingdom.
I had just recently come here and I heard about this recruitment.
I don’t really have any family aside from a few friends, and about that thief, I don’t really know him..." Vritra made up a few things.
Within a few minutes, even Onest actually defeated the puppet in a strange manner that most present weren’t even able to understand.
"Whoa, another one?!!" Joey looked truly shocked.
He thought for a couple of minutes and finally spoke: "Alright, I have decided.
Although there was only supposed to be one post originally, now there will be two.
I need to do a simple background check on you two, but that’s just formality.
So you two are officially the Agents of the Golden Moon."
The moment he spoke that, all the other participants were enraged and they started shouting.
"What kind of scam is this?
So you already had these two chosen for the post?
I didn’t expect something like that from the Golden Moon."
"I am going to complain about you, I am clearly better than those two—"
"SCRAM!!" Joey gave no explanation as he glared at the participants, frightening them with his aura as their bodies stiffened and they had no choice but to leave silently.
[You have successfully become the Agent!!]
A message flashed in front of Vritra.
He felt better knowing that at least he wasn’t at the wrong place.
Soon all the participants left the field, grumbling to themselves about the unfairness of the world.
"Joey, I don’t think you need to do a background check about Ben.
I know him and he is trustworthy." Yennefer spoke all of a sudden.
She was behaving so different from her real character.
"Oh, okay.
I understand." Joey nodded and began to explain a few things to Vritra and Onest.
The job of an Agent was quite dangerous, but for now their tasks would be of low level and their position in the Golden Moon would be rather high.
They would officially join the Golden Moon the next day.
After getting all the details, the two of them decided to leave the place—they didn’t want to stay in such a dangerous place anymore.
"Goodbye, Ben." When Vritra was leaving, Yennefer said with no emotion on her face.
Goodbye, my lady." Vritra said and walked out of the field.
"You bastard, you made a thief join the Golden Moon.
How absurd is that?
What will happen to my reputation now?" Onest spoke after walking some distance away from there.
"What reputation?
I am sure people call you by curses more often than by your name." Vritra said, while thinking that isn’t it more absurd for a demon to join Golden Moon.
The two ignored one another and went their separate ways.
Vritra headed towards the castle.
He would think about his plan of farming sin points and getting that map later.
For now, he just wanted to be away from Yennefer’s evil clutches.
"Heh.
Hubby, looks like you two are bound together by an invisible thread already.
The more you try to avoid her, the more she appears in front of you.
I also feel she might have suspicions about you." Yasmine spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Secret Realm
paragraphs: Inside a small room, around a round table several men were seated, creating a tense atmosphere. They silently stared at the centre of the table.
Faceless, Blunder, the Leader of the Slave Beast Gang, and a person with a strangely twisted body sat there. There were two humans and two demons.
Faceless was wearing a mask, while Blunder was covered in ragged clothes, a strong stench of blood coming from his body. All the wounds he got after his fight with Vritra hadn’t healed yet.
The leader of the Slave Beast Gang was, in reality, a demon who had disguised himself as a human and had obtained a significant amount of power in the White Kingdom.
The fourth person was a demon working under the demon general who was about to wage war against the White Kingdom.

"There is no need for so many of our brethren to die. Just give me a few more years and these humans will obediently start following us. I have already got over half of the people here." Slave spoke. His appearance was of a charming man in his thirties with a powerful aura.
Slave and Beast were two demons working under the same demon general. Slave’s strength was his brain, while Beast was, just as his name suggested, only brute force.
His body structure was quite strange, with four arms, a curved back, and skin that looked as if it was covered by moss.
BAM!
Slamming his fist against the round table, Beast spoke: "The time you asked for is already over. There is no way we would waste such a good opportunity where the king has disappeared mysteriously."
"It is exactly because of the king’s disappearance that I am even more sure that I will be able to—" Slave started speaking but was interrupted by Beast in the next moment:
"You know, our general is the one to make the choice. We just follow his orders. So just use whatever strength you have gathered so far and make it easier for us to win this war."
"Sigh... Fine, if that’s the general’s orders..." Slave agreed with a helpless sigh.
"Yeah, the plan will be starting soon but..." Beast frowned and asked in an angry voice: "What are these two humans doing here?!!"
"These are the leaders of the White Kingdom’s branch of the Bone Blood Cult and Nine Pacts—Blunder and Faceless." Slave introduced the two men, who had been silent till now.
"I asked, what are these two humans doing in our meeting?" Beast’s voice rose even higher. He looked like he was about to go berserk.
"These two friends of mine could be of great help to us in our upcoming war. Why don’t the two of you tell us how you could be of use to us?" Slave said, his voice still calm.
"I am Faceless. The Nine Pacts has been working in the White Kingdom longer than you know, and as you know we are conducting a few special researches—" Faceless started explaining.
"Just get to the damn point." Beast spoke with a menacing gaze.

"Sigh... Beast, be careful of your tone. Don’t think for a moment that I am afraid of you. Hoo... anyway, as I was saying, one of those special researches could help you not only win the war but even increase the strength of your demons." Faceless said.
"And what is it you want in return?" Beast spoke. His temper was bad, but he wasn’t stupid.
"It isn’t anything too precious, just a little something for our research." After a pause he added: "A constant supply of demons."
Beast stared at him for a few seconds, but then without saying anything he turned to look at Blunder and asked: "And what about you?"

"Heh, I have a way to make any and every one of your strongest opponents inside the White Kingdom disappear without a trace—forever." Blunder said, a wide grin on his face which was also covered by a mask.
"Oh, elaborate." Beast showed interest as he leaned onto the table.
"Have you heard about... the Divine?" Blunder said and looked at everyone’s reaction, then he continued: "I guess you have at least heard his name.
Aside from the fact that he is an extremely powerful being to the point that he could even kill gods, I don’t know anything about him.
But recently, in this kingdom, we have discovered one of his secret realms—or so we believe it is—since whoever entered it to explore never returned.
In other words, we have found the entrance to the Divine’s secret land. No matter who enters it, they will never return, though even I don’t know what happens to them inside."
"Divine..." Beast wanted to hear more about Blunder’s plan, but first he asked: "And what exactly is it you want for helping us?"
"Chaos, death, bloodshed, and... revenge." Blunder said as he shivered at the nightmarish memory, the wounds on his body still making him feel the pain.
The two demons smiled. A great chaos was about to envelop the White Kingdom as the demons shook hands with two of the strongest evil organisations.
’Just you wait, Vritra, I will erase you from every nightmare of mine.’ Blunder thought. He was ready to do anything just to kill Vritra.
Vritra was heading back towards the castle when he suddenly felt a shiver. He looked around but didn’t find anyone, so shrugging his shoulders he started walking.
"He should be here by now. I wonder when can I meet him." Vritra mumbled to himself as he scanned his surroundings for any kind of commotion, but there was none, so Monk Shitless wasn’t there yet.
"They will start puking blood if those Golden Moon members were to know who they just allowed to join." Yasmine spoke, feeling amused by the whole situation.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Just as his body disappeared, Vritra rose into the air and then flew towards the gates of the White Kingdom. He needed Monk Shitless’s help to earn a lot of sin points.

’I have seen in several movies where the criminal and the police are the same person. They are often quite fun.’ Vritra said. After leaving that field, he had removed the Shift, so his body was in its weakened state right now.
While the two were talking, Vritra finally heard loud shouts from near the gate, and as he got closer he saw a small crowd forming at the entrance.
’Now what kind of trouble has he gotten himself into?’ Vritra shook his head. If Monk Shitless was the one to receive the Divine Sin Wheel, then he would certainly be getting a lot more sin points.
"Arrest this demon for interrogation!!" one of the kingdom guards shouted as they circled around a bull on which a person was seated.
"Like I said, I am not a demon." The person on the bull said in a very heavy tone.
Vritra got out of the Fourth Dimension and passed through the crowd, and after getting closer he finally got a good look at Monk Shitless.
"Pfffttt... M- Monk Shitless, is that you?" Vritra barely stopped himself from laughing as he saw a swollen baldie. He looked as if he had been intimately kissed by lots of bees.
"Pitiful one!! They think I am a demon, please help me..." Monk Shitless pleaded.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: A New Neighbour
paragraphs: "Pitiful one!! They think I am a demon, please help me..." Monk Shitless shouted.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +47}

All the eyes instantly shifted to Vritra, who barely stopped himself from laughing out loud — the evil monk looked so funny. After taking his time and letting a few more sin points flow, he finally stepped forward and spoke:
"He is indeed a human, even if he might not look like one."
"And who are you exactly?" one of the guards asked, a frown on his face.
"..." Without saying a word, Vritra took out the emperor’s emblem he had received from Rich and pointed it towards the baffled guards.
"O- Oh sir, please forgive us, we will let him go immediately." The guards all became extremely respectful instantly and bowed. There was no way it was fake.
"Thwank you, pitiful one, sob..." Monk Shitless felt like crying — Vritra saved him in this foreign land after all.
"Let’s go." The two walked out of the crowd and entered the White kingdom. Vritra took out a couple of healing potions and passed them to the monk.
Shitless drank the potions, and within a few seconds, his body started to return to normal.
"I saw you falling down that cliff, how did you arrive here so fast?" Vritra asked. Somehow, this monk always survived the most dangerous situations.
"Hehe I am Monk Shitless, nothing can kill me!!" he replied.
Rolling his eyes, Vritra spoke: "You can stay in the castle if you want—"
But the monk interrupted him: "Y- You aren’t planning to turn me into Sonia again, right? That prince was crazy, even after seeing my real appearance he chased me for days."
"Uh... No, anyway can you do two simple things for me?" Vritra spoke, glancing at him.
"W- What is it now? And why have you changed your appearance again?" Shitless asked, a bit of trauma clear in his voice.
"I just want you to spread two simple news..." Vritra explained his plan, as a big grin started appearing on Monk Shitless’s face.
"Oh, great!! I will do that but I would need some money for that, and I am broke." He added, shrugging his shoulders.
"Well, money is no problem, but by tomorrow morning this news should spread as much as it could." Vritra said and gave a large amount of gold coins to him before the two went their separate ways.

’Sigh, I need to get as many sin points as I could before chaos starts to brew up, and my level... how do I increase it rapidly?’ Vritra wondered, but he was sure he would get to fight strong opponents soon.
"Hubby..." Yasmine called, her tone sounding a bit strange.
"Hmm? What’s wrong?" Vritra asked. He arrived near the castle in a short time.
"I can faintly sense the presence of a dragon around us, it is in the capital, I am sure of it." Yasmine replied, sensing the distant faint aura.
’A dragon?!! Is it strong, and can it sense us? By any chance, do you know who it is?’ Vritra asked, pausing for a moment before continuing.
"I am not sure if I know them or not, but that dragon certainly can’t sense us so you don’t have to worry.
And yeah, that dragon is certainly strong. We don’t have to worry too much, but just don’t use your dragon transformation for now." Yasmine warned.
’Okay, sigh, looks like the peace won’t remain for too long.’ Vritra sighed as he started climbing the stairs. It wasn’t long before he arrived near his room.
Fiona, Diana, and Vanessa didn’t seem to be in the room, but Vritra could sense them in the next room. He decided not to disturb them and just walked into his own room.
First, he took a bath with cold water and changed into a new set of clothes, deciding to buy new clothes that suited the White kingdom more later on.

Then he decided to have dinner. Walking out of the room, Vritra knocked on the door where the three ladies were. There wasn’t any sound from inside for a few minutes, and Vritra wondered what the three of them were doing.
Finally, after a few minutes, the door opened and the three ladies walked out with strange expressions on their faces.
"What’s wrong?" Vritra asked, taking a step forward.
"Uhm... We have got a new neighbour..." Vanessa spoke as she stepped to the side, and finally a woman came into his view. She was seated on a chair, sitting with a graceful aura around her.
"!!!" Vritra was startled. He took a step forward and stood in front of the three, questioning with a frown on his face: "Empress, what are you doing here?"
"Mm. Why are you acting so cautious? We met just earlier in the field, and do you think I am crazy enough to attack random people?" Yennefer spoke, looking at Vritra in a strange way.
"Why are you here?" Vritra repeated, staring at the empress.

"Why, I am here for the same reason as you. I will be staying here for a few days. You know I am searching for a demon lord who disappeared because of a certain someone, don’t mind me, I won’t hurt your family." Yennefer added.
"Honey, don’t worry, I don’t think she would harm us." Vanessa said, putting her palm over his shoulder.
Vritra turned and gestured for the three women to come closer and whispered:
"Mom, Fiona, you two might not know but she is a bit on the psycho side, I even heard she murdered a family just because they didn’t bow to her. It is better to stay away from people like that."
Yennefer pursed her lips and spoke: "I can clearly hear you, you know, and what do you mean people like me?
Don’t spread false rumors about me. There is no way I would ever kill a family over something so small... it was only one man that I killed."
They all glanced back at her and then returned to their discussion, forming a small circle: "See, I told you, she is crazy. Should we leave the castle?"
Vritra spoke. He was completely sure by now that Yennefer had some idea about his real identity.
"..." Yennefer listened to them, rolling her eyes at Vritra’s discreet talk. Even she herself wasn’t sure why she was here or why she was trying to confirm her suspicions.
"Wait, I didn’t bow to her earlier, are we on her killing list as well?" Fiona wondered.
"I am a goddess, and even if I am in front of the emperor, a goddess would never bow." Diana said, showing no fear towards the empress.

But seeing the empress, Diana suddenly felt that she needed more strength as well. She really needed to increase her level. She regretted not doing enough till now, but she was going to do her best to become strong in the future.
’How pitiful would it be to be the weakest in the group, sigh, I guess I have played around enough. Now I should seriously start leveling up.’
Diana thought. Her leveling speed was faster than any of them, so she could easily surpass the two ladies as long as she worked hard.
’Not just for Vritra but for myself as well, I want to be the best potion master in the world and the strongest goddess.’ She promised herself.

"..." Yennefer listened to them, rolling her eyes at Vritra’s discreet talk.
Even she herself wasn’t sure why she was here or why she was trying to confirm her suspicions.
"Wait, I didn’t bow to her earlier, are we on her killing list as well?" Fiona wondered.
"I am a goddess, and even if I am in front of the emperor, a goddess would never bow." Diana said, showing no fear towards the empress.
But seeing the empress, Diana suddenly felt that she needed more strength as well.
She really needed to increase her level.
She regretted not doing enough till now, but she was going to do her best to become strong in the future.
’How pitiful would it be to be the weakest in the group, sigh, I guess I have played around enough.
Now I should seriously start leveling up.’
Diana thought.
Her leveling speed was faster than any of them, so she could easily surpass the two ladies as long as she worked hard.
’Not just for Vritra but for myself as well, I want to be the best potion master in the world and the strongest goddess.’ She promised herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Comfortable~
paragraphs: ’Not just for Vritra but for myself as well, I want to be the best potion master in the world and the strongest goddess.’ While Diana was busy setting her future goals, Vritra and the others discussed their future options.
"Like I said, there is no need for you to think so much, I won’t hurt any of you." Yennefer said, rolling her eyes as she listened to them.
"And where is that protector of yours?" Vritra asked, turning to face the empress.
"You don’t need to know that. Anyway, I’m really curious how you were able to raise your level to such an extent while being in the Blue Kingdom.
Not even the king has managed this feat there." Yennefer asked in an interrogative tone.
Vritra was sure she was just putting on an act. Yennefer is a very cold and emotionless woman after all; she wouldn’t even look at weak people like them normally.

"Well isn’t it good enough already that despite her suspicions she hasn’t tried to kill you? After all, the Yennefer I know would kill first even if she had the slightest bit of suspicion about someone. So I call it progress." Yasmine spoke.
At their current strength, if Yennefer truly tried to kill them, there just wouldn’t be a way to survive.
’Yeah, since she has been acting a bit normally I almost forgot how dangerous she is. Sigh, for now we can just continue with our act.’ Vritra took a breath as a smile appeared on his face.

"Haha, I was just curious about him. Anyway, it’s a pleasure having such a pretty lady as our neighbour. Hope your stay in this place is full of mis– cough, fortunes." Vritra said before turning towards the dining room, but just then the empress called out from behind.
"Oh right, I don’t see that girl with black hair with you now—the one I met when you were coming here. And Fiona wasn’t there with you at that time..." Yennefer asked in an innocently curious tone.

"..." Vritra paused and felt like slapping his forehead. He didn’t think that the empress would follow him to the castle, and Misty Essence wouldn’t work from such a large distance because of his current level.
’She knows, she knows...’ he thought and after a brief silence he replied: "You don’t need to know that."
’Oh no, even I forgot that I was disguised the last time we met...’ Fiona felt a headache, but there was nothing she could have done.
’Ah, I should have used the Illusion Halo, though I doubt it could do much against the empress.’ Diana thought. She felt a bit worried in the empress’s presence. After a moment she spoke:

"Ah, you must be talking about Risa. Yeah, she did come here with us, but we went our separate ways after entering the kingdom. And as for Fiona, well she accidentally got separated from us in the Night Forest."
’...’ Vanessa too couldn’t have done anything even if she remembered, so she just sighed and started following Vritra towards the dining area.
Yennefer didn’t follow them this time. As the four disappeared from her sight, she finally mumbled: "Vritra... I am almost sure it is you. You won’t be able to escape this time."
When the four of them arrived there, Diddy and the other five were already there, and it seemed they were back to scum forms.
"Diddy, come here." Vritra called out. His weak appearance looked strangely attractive to the women.
"..." Diddy, who was trying to steal a piece of meat from Karen’s plate, frowned upon getting interrupted. He looked towards the sickly man and questioned: "What the fuck do you want?"
"Oh, you’ve got quite the voice huh?" Out of nowhere, Vritra in his Jin Woo form suddenly appeared beside Diddy and the group of six was instantly frightened.
"Ah S–Sir, you are back? S–Sorry for shouting earlier, I didn’t know you were here." Diddy stood up from his seat so fast that he hit and flipped his chair and the table.
"Be careful of your behaviour, I will be around." Jin Woo said before disappearing, leaving the six people shivering in dread.
Finally, as the annoying voices came to a halt, Vritra and the three ladies started to eat, though they only talked about useless things.
After finishing the food, the group took a walk around the castle, watching the strange state of the place since the king was nowhere to be found.
After thirty or so minutes, they headed back to their new room.

Yennefer was still seated in her chair and was reading something in a rather ancient-looking book. Upon hearing the approaching sounds she raised her head and watched the four of them heading to the same room.
"..." Frowning, she stood up abruptly and asked: "Wait, you four are sleeping in the same room? There are so many vacant rooms, wouldn’t it be better to get your separate rooms?"
"Thank you for your advice, Empress, I will definitely think it over." Vritra said with a smile and without pause.
"Wait, don’t tell me, the four of you are in a romantic relation?" Yennefer walked towards the entrance of her room and asked. She seemed quite opposed to this idea.
"Huh, why do you even want to know that? But anyway, yes we are." Vritra answered, without glancing back.
BAM!
"..." Yennefer was about to speak more when Vritra shut the door close with a loud sound. The empress was left standing in the hallway with a deep frown etched on her beautiful face.

’So he wasn’t lying about having multiple women before... tsk.’ Suddenly in a bad mood, Yennefer stormed into her room. The temperature around the castle itself seemed to have dropped by a few degrees.
Vritra looked at the bed in his room and then at the three women. He had agreed to stay in the same room, but he thought they would arrange more beds.
"Should I take out another bed, since it doesn’t seem the four of us will be able to sleep on it comfortably?" Vritra asked, ready to pull the bed from his inventory.
"No, there is no need for that darling, I’m sure if we just adjust a bit we will be able to sleep re~ally comfortably..." Fiona said, with a seductive smile on her face.
"Yes, just leave it to us, master." Diana said as she pulled Vritra’s hand and climbed onto the bed.
After a few seconds, the four of them lay on the bed, Vritra at the centre. Both of his arms were being used as pillows and he was completely surrounded by softness.
The goddess lay to his left, her soft breasts pressing against his body as she stuck close to him, while Vanessa was hugging on his right. Both the women pressed against him tightly.
"Fiona, are you sure you are comfortable there?" Vritra asked. Fiona was lying on top of him with her head resting over his chest and her boobs pressing against his belly.
"Why, do you think I am heavy?" Fiona said with a cute pout as she looked up into his eyes, their faces so close that they could even feel each other’s warmth.
"Of course not, that’s not what I meant but—"

chapters.title: Chapter 294: The God
paragraphs: "Of course not, that’s not what I meant, but isn’t it comfortable sleeping like this?" Vritra asked, surrounded by warmth and softness.
It indeed felt quite nice, and with his strength the weight of their soft, voluptuous bodies wasn’t a problem for him.
The ladies knew exactly where this path would lead them to, and they were ready for it.
A few minutes had passed. Inside the next room, Yennefer was strolling casually, she would occasionally stop near the wall and try to sense exactly what was happening in the next room.
Vritra had set up barriers, but they didn’t really put up any resistance to her prying, and Yasmine couldn’t be exposed to outsiders, so she didn’t add any barrier.

"Tsk, that room is so big, why is there only one bed? The king has disappeared, and the people here have forgotten about hospitality. And who even sleeps like that?" she spoke to herself, her voice slightly agitated.
After a while, the group of four in the next room fell asleep, and soon Yennefer also decided to stop her strolling, as she climbed onto her bed and lay down.
’Sigh, why am I even wasting my time in this place?’ The empress wondered as she closed her eyes.
The night passed quickly, and the morning was rather lively.
It was around seven in the morning, the weather seemed a little rainy with dark clouds covering the sun.
Right outside the castle, the guards watched as one person after another kept walking close to the door and lining outside. Already there was a crowd of a few hundred men and women.
"What exactly is going on here? Is this even allowed?" one of the guards asked, staring at the crowd.
"I heard it is for some sort of recruitment, and the one responsible for it is one of the guests from the Blue kingdom. As long as nothing goes wrong, we should be fine."
The other guard replied, staring at the crowd that kept growing bigger.
Right outside the castle boundary, a few meters to the left side of the gates, Vritra sat on a chair on one side of a table to interview the people coming.
Monk Shitless stood beside him, and the great monk was responsible for the entire event. This was the first task Vritra had given to him — to spread information about a recruitment.
It was a recruitment post for a servant who would help the God of Mercy with tea, water, and serving food in day-to-day life.
And it was the pay that shocked everyone: they would need to work five days a week and get a full payment of 1,000 gold coins every month, with other holidays and bonuses.
The people were suspicious and confused about two things — first about the God of Mercy, and second about such absurd pay.
They even heard that whether a person was selected after the interview or not, they would still get 2 gold coins.
Although people felt that it was some sort of scam, many still came to give it a try, pulled by the lure of money, just to see if any of the said things were true or not.
And upon finally arriving outside the castle boundary, they indeed found the frail but handsome interviewer and the baldy manager. Despite their doubts, a few of the people gave it a try.
Although all of them were rejected, they did get the promised gold coins, and so after hearing about this, more and more people started coming for the interview.
The news about this job recruitment was the first rumour that Monk Shitless started, while the second was about a God who had descended to bring mercy to everyone in the White kingdom.
The slaves, the people who wanted to end the slave system, and everyone else — a god who had arrived to bring change. This interview would also serve for the second major event of Vritra’s plan.
Fiona, Vanessa, and Diana sat in the distance and just observed everything.
Now they knew exactly why Vritra always pulled so much attention towards himself, so they were quite excited as more and more people flooded in.
"What’s your name and speciality?" Vritra asked, looking at the old man who was wearing a cowboy outfit while his teeth were chattering non-stop.

"I could kill a thousand men with a single strike, and I have served water to soldiers all my life. I am the best servant for you, the respectful God of Mercy." The old man said, raising his wobbly and thin hand.
"Next!" Vritra called out as the old man got two gold coins from Monk Shitless and watched the small crowd that had already been rejected and was now just waiting to see who would get selected.

"The man in black! Heh, do you think I wouldn’t remember your face after you already got rejected? Any person who tries to get 2 gold coins again will be beaten like this!!" Monk Shitless shouted and gestured towards his bull.
"Bullo, charge!"
Mhhooooooo...
Letting out a loud sound, the bull charged into the crowd, scaring everyone, and the person who was sneaking into the line again ran away in fright.
Vritra didn’t really care about the post or the interview. The only thing that truly mattered was...
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +918}
{Sin Point Gained: Intrigued +932}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +920}
As more and more people heard about this recruitment event, all the members of the family rushed to the place.
People with big families were especially happy since they were going to get 2 gold coins each.
Monk Shitless managed the crowd and gave the important information in the midst of interviews.
The main objective was to introduce a new God in this kingdom so they could gain even higher sin points with their next plan.
’Wifey, this much should be fine, right? The god won’t put a legal strike on me for using the title or anything, hmm?’ While interviewing a middle-aged woman he asked.
"Yeah, don’t worry. This much is fine as I have said before. Since you are not targeting any gods or disrespecting them all collectively, you are in the safe zone." Yasmine replied.
Vritra nodded as he glanced around and didn’t see Yennefer. She had probably gone out to continue with her demon lord searching mission.
After just thirty minutes since the interview started, more than a thousand people had gathered outside the castle, and the space outside became very crowded.
It was no longer fine to conduct the recruitment there.
The guards decided to put a stop to it. After all, they couldn’t conduct their duties properly with there being such a large crowd.

"ALL HAIL THE GOD OF MERCY, THE GOD WHO HAD DESCENDED TO TAKE AWAY ALL OUR PROBLEMS! HE WOULD END SLAVERY, MAKE SURE EVERYONE HAD ENOUGH FOOD ON THEIR PLATES, AND LET THEM LIVE THEIR LIVES HAPPILY!! THE GOD WHO COULD DO ANYTHING AS LONG AS YOU HAVE ENOUGH FAITH!!"
Monk Shitless shouted, his voice reverberating all across the place.

Spreading his name and getting a lot of people to worship him madly wasn’t an easy task, but Vritra planned to get a lot of sin points and increase his strength significantly before leaving the continent.
Just then, a weak voice came from the crowd...

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Fraud
paragraphs: Just while Vritra was busy taking the interview of a middle aged woman and monk Shitless was shouting his heart out, a weak voice sounded from the crowd.
"C- Can you help me too, G- God?"
The crowd parted and a small girl around ten or so years old nervously walked forward, she was wearing ragged clothes and was carrying a heavy bag full of vegetables.

Both her feet were shackled with heavy chains that connected all four of her limbs and neck, covered in dust and wounds, her appearance was quite dirty so all the people around her stepped back not to get dirty.
"And how do you want me to help you?" Vritra leaned forward slightly as he looked into the little girl’s eyes, this could be really nice start for his plan.
"I- I want..." the little girl looked quite frightened, as all the gazes focussed on her and it seemed she might start crying at any moment.
Seeing this, Vanessa, Fiona and Diana approached her as they passed through the crowd. Then vanessa picked her up and with a smile, she spoke: "Don’t be afraid, everything is fine."
Diana gently touched her cheek as the girl got covered by a faint white light, in the next moment all her wounds disappeared along with the dust.
"Tell us, what help you need." The goddess said, the words of the three women were very calming, the girl felt at ease and she finally gathered the courage to speak.
"I don’t want to be a s- slave anymore a- and my parents... can you help us, God?" the little girl spoke in a very desperate tone, her voice still cracking in pain and despair.
Vritra stood up and walked up to them, then looking straight at her he replied: "I will, but for that you just have to do one simple thing, okay?"
Without even knowing the girl nodded, she just wanted to be free and not get beaten without even a reason or watch her parents be beaten by those evil owners.
"Return to the house you live in, then point at the people who had enslaved you and say:Almighty Push.Can you do that?" Vritra spoke and everyone listening to it looked at Vritra strangely.

So it seemed he was just trying to make a fool of the little girl, of course a random guy calling himself God wouldn’t be able to go against the entire Slave Beast Gang, none of the people who had gathered here really believed anything that monk Shitless had said.
They were here for the money after all.
"Sigh All those big words and he already got the reality check, haha all those big words, I knew it was just bullshit, he is just a fraud-" one of the man spoke while shaking his head.
"Shhh... don’t you want to get those free 2 gold coins? Stay quiet but yeah he shouldn’t make a fool of that little girl with false hope." Another person said in a hushed tone.
Similar discussion were taking place among more than a thousand people, even the guards looked at Vritra as if he was some sort of scum, spouting non sense to get famous.
{Sin Point Gained: Taunted +1,574}
{Sin Point Gained: Belittled +1,529}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +1,165}
Vritra smiled as he watched the speed of message flashing increase exponentially, the more he stimulated the emotions of people the more sin points he received.
"Yes I will!!" the little girl said with determination, as all the people looked at her with pity. She would most probably be beaten for doing something like that.

"Sigh Poor thing, if only I could put people like that in their place, the rich ones believe they could do whatever they want, I just want to bea-" a man spoke, but before he could speak a flying slipper struck his face.

"What did you just said? If you are so brave then why don’t try putting a fight against the Slave Beast Gang, huh? You wont be getting a single coin now." Monk Shitless said, fuming at the absurd comments.
Vritra ignored just them, whether they like him or hate him he would still keep getting sin points so he could ignore such comments.
He looked around and gestured at one of the frowning guard to coming closer, he too didn’t seem happy about Vritra fooling a little girl, but since he was a guest, the guard couldn’t ignore Vritra.
"Yes?" stopping in front of Vritra, the guard spoke, giving a ’what do you want now?’ kind of look.
"Can you bring her back to the place where her parents are through one of the rides?" Vritra asked, the frown on the guards face deepened, he wouldn’t want to get into useless trouble.
"Why should I-?" the guard started to speak but Vritra interrupted him as he handed over a small pouch containing a few gold coins and said:
"Just bring her there and you don’t have to do anything else, wait there for five minutes and then bring her back here."
"uh... Fine." The guard took the pouch and looked inside at the gold coins in joy, even in white kingdom, this number of gold coins was quite a lot.
The same currency worked all across the continent so Vritra could use all the money he had gathered before.
Under the gaze of the crowd, the guard brought the girl along with her and got into a ride which was similar to a car, and soon it disappeared from everyone’s sight.
CLAP
"Alright everyone, let’s get back to the interviews." Vritra said with a loud clap that brought all the attention back to him, although the people were unhappy but they still wanted the gold coins.
And so the interviews continued, whenever someone passed a nasty comment, a slipper would fly and hit right at the target. Vritra looked at Monk Shitless who was enjoying beating up people.
Around thirty more minutes had passed, the number of people was already more than two thousand.
The guards could no long let this sort of situation continue, but they were all just waiting for that one guard to return and see how Vritra react when the girl comes back with new wounds.

It wasn’t long before a ride stopped outside the castle, all the eyes drifted towards it. Then the guard got out of the ride along with the little girl, most of the people couldn’t see anything because of the crowd.
The guard picked the girl and hastily walked towards Vritra as the crowd made way for him, all the people that saw the expressions of the girl and the guard were shocked.
"Sir- God, i- it worked..." after arriving in front of Vritra the guard put the girl down and then spoke in a flabbergasted tone, as everyone became silent.
"Are you free now?" Vritra looked at the little girl with a smile and asked.
"Yes!! Thank you sob God, Zia is finally free sob my mommy and papa were sob so happy thank you." The girl started crying while speaking, but there was a big smile on her face.
Everyone looked at the guard and started asking questions.
"What happened exactly? Is she really free now? Just by pointing a finger at her owners and saying those words?"

"C- Can you help me too, G- God?"
The crowd parted and a small girl around ten or so years old nervously walked forward, she was wearing ragged clothes and was carrying a heavy bag full of vegetables.

Both her feet were shackled with heavy chains that connected all four of her limbs and neck, covered in dust and wounds, her appearance was quite dirty so all the people around her stepped back not to get dirty.
"And how do you want me to help you?" Vritra leaned forward slightly as he looked into the little girl’s eyes, this could be really nice start for his plan.

So it seemed he was just trying to make a fool of the little girl, of course a random guy calling himself God wouldn’t be able to go against the entire Slave Beast Gang, none of the people who had gathered here really believed anything that monk Shitless had said.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: The Sin Rain
paragraphs: "What happened exactly? Is she really free now? Just by pointing a finger at her owners and saying those words?" one of the people in the crowd asked in bewilderment.
"Yes, she just did as he had asked and... everything just changed." The guard spoke, he still couldn’t get out of his shock.
"Tell us in detail, what exactly happened?" A few of the people shook the guard violently, bringing him back to his senses.
"Upon returning to that house, I just decided to watch how it goes.
When she entered and walked up to her owners, I was sure she was going to get beat up but... right after she said those words, everything seemed to change.
The owners instantly removed the slave collars and even gave more than half of their money to her family. So yes, this girl and her family are now free.
The owners still seemed to be repenting their actions." The guard spoke while pushing others away.
"J- Just like that? You aren’t lying to us, right?" someone spoke, but the collar and chains really had disappeared from around her body.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +2,967}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +770}
{Sin Point Gained: Mocked +2,895}
The guard looked at Vritra and spoke in utter respect:
"G- God, this place can’t handle any more people, so how about you allow us to shift it all to a more spacious place?"
"...Alright." Vritra nodded. This was just the start, he was going to get a whole lot more Sin Points very soon.
Vritra, along with all the people, moved to a large arena where Vritra was at the centre while all the people were seated on the chairs and waited for their turn.
This new news of the God of Mercy helping a girl and her family spread quite fast. Within just an hour, the news of the interview and the God had spread quite far in the capital.
More and more people flooded into the arena, most to get free gold coins while a few to get help from Vritra.
In reality, Vritra had used Psyche to help that little girl.
The moment she pointed at them, Psyche turned into a fog-like form and flooded into their minds, turning them into good people who would never support slavery again.
By the time it was 11 in the morning, thousands of the seats of the arena were filled as the people waited for their turns.
Monk Shitless was hard at work, controlling everything along with the guards.
Of course, most of the people still wouldn’t believe Vritra easily but the start was pretty good.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +27,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +27,055}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +10,823}
’Haa this is so nice, so many sin points.’ Vritra thought. He abruptly stood up, surprising all the people. They thought the recruitment was over and felt really bad, sending waves of sin points.
Then Vritra stretched his body and continued with the interviews, making everyone feel happy and sending even more sin points.
"Hey everyone, if you want to get interviewed before others then pray to the God of Mercy, and you will get those free coins faster!!
And you just might get some extra coins." Monk Shitless shouted, as even the people who still didn’t believe in Vritra started to pray.
The number of people in the arena was increasing rapidly, and now the guards were worried that even such a large arena might not be enough for this simple recruitment.
Soon enough, there isn’t such a large crowd even at the recruitment of big organisations.
It wasn’t long before the number finally crossed forty thousand. Buying sin points with gold wasn’t a bad deal at all.
Monk Shitless would give a few extra coins to people praying to the God of Mercy, motivating all else to do the same, as they sent thousands upon thousands of sin points.
Vritra was gloating at the endless rain. Just by 1 in the afternoon, the crowd was close to reaching fifty thousand, and the supply of sin points wouldn’t slow down for a moment.
One more slave approached Vritra after hearing about that little slave girl. He gathered all the courage and asked for the God’s help.
And Vritra told him to do the same thing. Just this time, he did not ask any guard to go along, though many people followed the slave on their own.
And the result was, after around twenty minutes, even more people started to have faith in him and the number of people continued to increase.
Though this news also reached the Slave Beast Gang, and they definitely were not happy about it.
One more slave was freed that day, and the God of Mercy started to gain popularity at an explosive rate.
It was close to 3 o’clock when a man cut the line and appeared in front of Vritra. The people were obviously not happy about it. Vritra looked up and spoke:
"Oh mugger, you want a job as well? Sure, since we have been friends for so long, I can do you such a small favour."
"What? Do you think I am poor? I am a thief, not a beggar!!" Onest said, showing a respectful look on his face.
"Hah, as if a thief is better than a beggar. Does this tingle your stealing urges?" Vritra said as he took out a golden coin.
No matter what he did or spoke, he kept getting lots of sin points. This was such a great feeling.
{Sin Point Gained: Amused +51,892}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +53,048}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +53,002}
{Sin Point Gained: Cursed +1}
"Hmph, I can even steal your ability if I want to— I mean copy it for a few minutes. Now, should I steal your ability?" Onest said with his arms folded in front of his chest.
"Oh, is that so? Then give it a try." Vritra was intrigued. After a moment, he mumbled:
"Forbid: Sight."
[Forbidden activated.]
Onest lost his composure as all of a sudden his vision went dark, but he quickly calmed and spoke:
"This was the skill you used to slow me down and stop that puppet yesterday, right? I had already seen it three times, this is so easy."
He fell silent and activated an ability of his, targeting the Forbidden skill.
One second...
Two seconds...
One minute passed in utter silence yet no change appeared. Onest was sweating heavily by now.
"Heh, you can’t do it, can you?" Vritra asked.
"Just what kind of ability is that?" Onest asked in surprise.
"Pitiful one, who is this robber? I can see the clouds of misfortune forming above his head." Monk Shitless spoke.
"Who is this Baldy now? Haa, anyway, it is time for us to go to the Golden Moon. Remember we were selected as the new agents?" Onest said, ignoring the Baldy.
"Oh right, I almost forgot about that..." Vritra said. It was a pity that he would have to end the sin point farming event for now and become an official member of the Golden Moon.
But he had already gained quite a lot of sin points, and this was just the first day. Now Monk Shitless no longer had to spread the rumors since all the people gathered would do that job.

{Sin Point Gained: Revered +64,651}

chapters.title: Chapter 297: A small help
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +64,832}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +64,651}
{Sin Point Gained: Called +64,829}
"Sorry everyone, it is unfortunate but we will have to end this recruitment event right here for now.
You can vent your frustrations on my friend here, it is all because of him after all that the event is ending so soon."
After speaking, Vritra started walking in a really, really slow manner.
The people instantly started cursing Onest, while many pleaded for Vritra to not stop the recruitment.
Since the crowd made it impossible to leave, Vritra started floating, moving at the speed of a snail while getting thousands upon thousands of sin points.
"Will you start moving already? Why the hell are you so slow?"
Onest flew up before anyone could attack him, frustrated at seeing Vritra move so slowly.
"Don’t worry everyone, we will meet tomorrow as well. And even if you failed today, you might get another chance tomorrow." Vritra spoke while waving his hand at the crowd.
{Sin Point Gained: missed +64,846}
{Sin Point Gained: Followed +34,005}
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +64,632}
This was the fastest he had ever collected so many sin points.
Greed for money and belief in a miraculous entity are some of the fastest ways to get a person to do anything.
Onest waited impatiently.
It took Vritra more than ten minutes just to rise high enough in the air, but since they were getting a bit late, he had no choice but to finally end this session.
"That went so well, hehe, but it was quite funny to watch. And I wonder if the number of people will cross one hundred thousand tomorrow."
Yasmine spoke, feeling excited as she saw the large number of sin points that had already been collected.
’If nothing goes wrong, then I would have so many sin points very soon. Even after the upgradation of the Sin Arrow I will still have a lot of them left.
Anyway, what sort of work will I have to do for the Golden Moon?’ he thought, hoping he could stay in that place until he completed the quest.
"The profession of an agent is quite special. You must be ranked much higher than a person with a similar level in the Golden Moon.
They often do work like killing, information collection, delivering important objects or information, and all sorts of dangerous tasks." Yasmine replied.
While the two chatted, Onest flew along in silence, wondering if Monk Shitless’s words about his misfortune would come true.
It wasn’t long before they arrived at the base of the Golden Moon, which was quite close to the field they had visited the previous day.
The guard outside allowed the two to go inside directly.
It was a building with more than ten floors, and it really looked like a corporate office back from Earth, though a bit less developed, with a lot of differences.
The two first went up to the reception, where a young man was seated to help people with their queries.
"Oh, you are the new agents. Welcome, sirs. Sir Joey is waiting for you in the training area at the back of the building. Please head there." The receptionist said with a smile.
Vritra and Onest nodded and headed to the training area.
"With how you are coping through life by stealing, I believe you live alone in the capital." Vritra spoke.
"Ughh, so what? I was a slave before, and luckily someone saved me." Onest replied.
"Oh, who was that stupid person?" Vritra asked.
"You psycho huff..."
They soon arrived in the training area, where Joey was standing along with many other members of the Golden Moon.
They were all wearing different types of dresses, some were in white, some in red, and very few in greyish dress.
"Welcome our newest agents, Onest and Ben Tennyson!!" Joey spoke in a cheerful tone as soon as he saw the two.
"Oh, are we in the presence of a God?" Just then Vritra heard a familiar voice.
Sighing internally, he glanced to the side and saw the empress sitting there, while Han was protectively standing some distance away from her.
"Haha, I also heard about that. Well, you are doing a great job, but I wonder how exactly you performed those miracles.
What was that... Almighty Push, right? Hahaha. Anyway, I welcome you two to the righteous Golden Moon Organisation. I hope even in the future you continue to help everyone."
Then, taking out two storage Glyphs, he handed one to each of them and said: "These are a few essentials like your uniforms, badge, identity token and so on. Keep these things safe."

"Yes sir." Vritra and Onest nodded. After taking the glyphs, they scanned the contents. Aside from the things Joey mentioned, there were some high-level potions, a few weapons, maps, and several more things.
"Now, why don’t you go and get changed into your new uniforms?" the old man added.
After five minutes, Vritra and Onest joined the group of Golden Moon members. The uniform for agents was grey, and all of them were facing Joey.

"Since you are new, we should have given you proper training and introductions, but the situation here is quite bad and there is a lot of work. Still, you only need to complete small tasks for now. If you two have any questions, then ask away." Joey said.
Vritra raised his hand and, after Joey nodded, he spoke: "Can I get five days off?"
"No. Anything else?" answered the old man.
’Well, it was worth a try.’ Vritra thought.
"Alright, then I will be assigning a few tasks to you all." Then Joey started giving different tasks to all the members.
The most dangerous and harder or discreet missions were given to the agents.
"Now, as for you two, why don’t you keep an eye on the entrance of the kingdom? I heard several demons have been seen there lately. Just stay there for two days.
If demons attack and you can’t handle them, then give a signal to us and we will instantly send help." Joey ordered.
"Okay." Vritra nodded. He had to do it anyway, so there was no use complaining, and it’s not like he couldn’t use that time to gather sin points.
After receiving a few more instructions, they got ready to leave, but Yennefer suddenly appeared in front of Vritra.
"This uniform suits you quite well, Ben—oh wait, God.
Actually, I was wondering if you would like to go to a special place with me. I might need your help there." Yennefer said, mentioning a special help she had taken from him.
"Sorry, even if you are the empress, I can’t let anyone get in the line of our duty. I am an agent, see, I am the godfather of humanity." Vritra said while pointing at the badge on his chest.
"But didn’t our duty start from tomorrow? It is only 4 now and there is still quite some time." Onest said with a wide grin.
"See, that beggar friend of yours is right. Then shall we go?" Yennefer asked, giving a critical hit to Onest.
"In any case, that is highly inappropriate. Don’t you know I have three ladies waiting for me back at home?
What would people say about my character if I go around with an engaged woman? Sorry, I can’t help you." Vritra added.
