Greed for money and belief in a miraculous entity are some of the fastest ways to get a person to do anything.
Onest waited impatiently.
It took Vritra more than ten minutes just to rise high enough in the air, but since they were getting a bit late, he had no choice but to finally end this session.
"That went so well, hehe, but it was quite funny to watch.
And I wonder if the number of people will cross one hundred thousand tomorrow."
Yasmine spoke, feeling excited as she saw the large number of sin points that had already been collected.
’If nothing goes wrong, then I would have so many sin points very soon.
Even after the upgradation of the Sin Arrow I will still have a lot of them left.
Anyway, what sort of work will I have to do for the Golden Moon?’ he thought, hoping he could stay in that place until he completed the quest.
"The profession of an agent is quite special.
You must be ranked much higher than a person with a similar level in the Golden Moon.
They often do work like killing, information collection, delivering important objects or information, and all sorts of dangerous tasks." Yasmine replied.
While the two chatted, Onest flew along in silence, wondering if Monk Shitless’s words about his misfortune would come true.
It wasn’t long before they arrived at the base of the Golden Moon, which was quite close to the field they had visited the previous day.
The guard outside allowed the two to go inside directly.
It was a building with more than ten floors, and it really looked like a corporate office back from Earth, though a bit less developed, with a lot of differences.
The two first went up to the reception, where a young man was seated to help people with their queries.
"Oh, you are the new agents.
Welcome, sirs.
Sir Joey is waiting for you in the training area at the back of the building.
Please head there." The receptionist said with a smile.
Vritra and Onest nodded and headed to the training area.
"With how you are coping through life by stealing, I believe you live alone in the capital." Vritra spoke.
"Ughh, so what?
I was a slave before, and luckily someone saved me." Onest replied.
"Oh, who was that stupid person?" Vritra asked.
"You psycho huff..."
They soon arrived in the training area, where Joey was standing along with many other members of the Golden Moon.
They were all wearing different types of dresses, some were in white, some in red, and very few in greyish dress.
"Welcome our newest agents, Onest and Ben Tennyson!!" Joey spoke in a cheerful tone as soon as he saw the two.
"Oh, are we in the presence of a God?" Just then Vritra heard a familiar voice.
Sighing internally, he glanced to the side and saw the empress sitting there, while Han was protectively standing some distance away from her.
"Haha, I also heard about that.
Well, you are doing a great job, but I wonder how exactly you performed those miracles.
What was that...
Almighty Push, right?
Hahaha.
Anyway, I welcome you two to the righteous Golden Moon Organisation.
I hope even in the future you continue to help everyone."
Then, taking out two storage Glyphs, he handed one to each of them and said: "These are a few essentials like your uniforms, badge, identity token and so on.
Keep these things safe."
"Yes sir." Vritra and Onest nodded.
After taking the glyphs, they scanned the contents.
Aside from the things Joey mentioned, there were some high-level potions, a few weapons, maps, and several more things.
"Now, why don’t you go and get changed into your new uniforms?" the old man added.
After five minutes, Vritra and Onest joined the group of Golden Moon members.
The uniform for agents was grey, and all of them were facing Joey.
"Since you are new, we should have given you proper training and introductions, but the situation here is quite bad and there is a lot of work.
Still, you only need to complete small tasks for now.
If you two have any questions, then ask away." Joey said.
Vritra raised his hand and, after Joey nodded, he spoke: "Can I get five days off?"
"No.
Anything else?" answered the old man.
’Well, it was worth a try.’ Vritra thought.
"Alright, then I will be assigning a few tasks to you all." Then Joey started giving different tasks to all the members.
The most dangerous and harder or discreet missions were given to the agents.
"Now, as for you two, why don’t you keep an eye on the entrance of the kingdom?
I heard several demons have been seen there lately.
Just stay there for two days.
If demons attack and you can’t handle them, then give a signal to us and we will instantly send help." Joey ordered.
"Okay." Vritra nodded.
He had to do it anyway, so there was no use complaining, and it’s not like he couldn’t use that time to gather sin points.
After receiving a few more instructions, they got ready to leave, but Yennefer suddenly appeared in front of Vritra.
"This uniform suits you quite well, Ben—oh wait, God.
Actually, I was wondering if you would like to go to a special place with me.
I might need your help there." Yennefer said, mentioning a special help she had taken from him.
"Sorry, even if you are the empress, I can’t let anyone get in the line of our duty.
I am an agent, see, I am the godfather of humanity." Vritra said while pointing at the badge on his chest.
"But didn’t our duty start from tomorrow?
It is only 4 now and there is still quite some time." Onest said with a wide grin.
"See, that beggar friend of yours is right.
Then shall we go?" Yennefer asked, giving a critical hit to Onest.
"In any case, that is highly inappropriate.
Don’t you know I have three ladies waiting for me back at home?
What would people say about my character if I go around with an engaged woman?
Sorry, I can’t help you." Vritra added.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: The Venerable One
paragraphs: "What would people say about my character if I go around with an engaged woman? Sorry, I can’t help you." Vritra added.
"You know having three women isn’t that common either so going to help her should be fine—" Onest began to speak but Vritra suddenly pinched his ear and dragged him away.
"In any case, I won’t be able to help you, Empress." Vritra said as he dragged Onest out of there by his ear.
"Uh... Empress, what kind of help do you need from him?" Han asked, feeling really curious.
He did feel that Vritra wasn’t ordinary but he couldn’t understand how someone so weak could help someone like the Empress.
Yennefer stayed silent and in the next moment she disappeared, Han sighed and followed behind her.
"Ughh, my ear, what’s wrong with you? I was just helping you get such a beautiful woman, don’t you like collecting pretty ladies?" Onest spoke while massaging his ear.
"Yeah yeah, I will meet you tomorrow, don’t be late mugger." Vritra said as he started flying away.
"Ha! I should be the one to say that, you psycho." Onest clicked his tongue and left as well.
Vritra didn’t fly too high, lots of gazes were attracted towards him because of his special uniform; normally it was forbidden to fly in the capital but a few people were an exception.
After a while, he finally arrived at the castle and found that the three had gone into the market and they left behind a note for him.

"Haa... such a tiring day, I spent a lot of money but well I still have a lot to spare, soon people will come without even the mention of the gold coins." Vritra mumbled as he fell back on the bed and closed his eyes.
"Remember the dragon I told you about? I can sense that it is somewhere near the castle." Yasmine spoke suddenly.
"The dragon? Could it be looking for you?" Vritra wondered, as he sat up and created several layers of barriers around the room just to be sure, Yasmine did the same.

"I don’t think so but I can tell he is indeed looking for someone. Anyway, it is better if you don’t meet that dragon for now, there is no way we can defeat someone like that with our current strength and—" She replied and suddenly fell silent.
"What’s wrong?" he questioned, hoping nothing went wrong.
"It seems the person that dragon is searching for is also a dragon, and an alive one."
Yasmine answered and knowing what his next question was going to be she continued:
"I can faintly sense the presence of several Dragon Enchant Flowers, just as its name suggests, it kind of hypnotizes a dragon and pulls them closer.
The moment you smell its scent, you would be forcefully transformed into your dragon form."
"Oh, looks like I will have to be extra careful. The demon Yennefer is searching for and this dragon, I wonder if they are related somehow..." he mumbled.
The two chatted for a while and soon the three ladies returned with lots of shopping bags, they had purchased a lot of clothes for Vritra too.
"Wow, you sure went all out." Vritra said, watching as they pulled one bag after another from their storages.
"Watch, honey, these are the clothes the three of us bought for you, do you like them?" Vanessa spoke, a beautiful smile spreading across her face.
"Hmm, yeah they all look great, thank you. And have you eaten yet? I sure am feeling very hungry." He said, after looking at all the things they had purchased.
"Let’s go eat together. So how was your first day at Golden Moon?" Diana asked, she was wearing a black dress and looked absolutely gorgeous.
"It was fine, but because of the chaos in the kingdom instead of giving any basic training or lessons, I am given a duty to keep a watch over the entrance of the kingdom."
While chatting they went to the dining area, they took their seats and asked the servants to bring food for them.
The remaining day passed quite peacefully, Yennefer didn’t return to her room until late in the night and so Vritra didn’t meet her.
But she sure felt annoyed at the poor hospitality in the castle, that four people had to share one room and one bed on top of that.
The next morning, Vritra got dressed in his clothes instead of his uniform and just wore the badge. They ate breakfast and before seven the four of them were ready to head out.
"Shall we go?" Vritra asked as he gazed back at the three ladies, who looked really beautiful in their new dresses but had their faces covered by veils.

"Yes darling, when we went out the last time we heard that the members of the Slave Beast Gang might come to cause trouble for your recruitment today, just let us handle them if their level is up to the middles of 1st Legion rank."
Fiona said, an intense aura burning around her body.
"Sure." He nodded.
"Are we allowed to kill them? It would be better if I could gain levels while killing those good-for-nothings." Diana said, something had changed in her and she no longer ran away from fights.
"But I heard we can’t gain levels by killing humans, so how?" Fiona asked curiously.
"I am a goddess, those rules don’t bind me. So can I kill them?" Diana asked. Killing them might make the whole situation too intense and a full-blown war might start, so she decided to ask first.
"Oh, I didn’t know that either, and yeah, kill them if you want. At most I will have to drag the kingdom’s guards to battle against them." Vritra said.
Instead of taking a ride to the kingdom entrance, the four flew since it was faster but only Vanessa couldn’t fly yet, so Vritra brought her along.
Monk Shitless had already told everyone that the venue of the recruitment was going to change so lots of people had already gathered near the gates.
When the four figures got closer, Shitless turned back to the crowd and spoke: "Do it just like we practiced, one two three!!"
"ALL HAIL THE GOD OF MERCY!! BRING KINDNESS TO THE WORLD, PLEASE SPANK THE CRIMINALS AND SLAUGHTER SLAVE BEAST GANG!! THAT’S ALL, HEHE SHITLESS IS THE MOST EVIL, BOW TO ME PEASANTS—"
All the people shouted.
"Stop, stop!! You weren’t supposed to speak the last part." Monk Shitless shouted, feeling embarrassed as Vritra and the three women landed beside him.
"Hehe, this was a surprise I planned for you." Shitless said, scratching his bald head.
But Vritra didn’t really pay much attention to this, he just looked at the messages refreshing crazily in front of him.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +83,194}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +82,902}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +83,049}
The place was so crowded that it seemed around half of the capital had gathered in the first city itself, and more people were still coming there.
"I AM HERE TO FREE YOU OF ALL YOUR PROBLEMS, I WILL ERASE SLAVERY FROM THE WHITE KINGDOM, I WILL SLAUGHTER EVERY SINGLE DEMON THAT THREATENS YOU ALL!!"
Vritra’s regal voice reverberated far and wide, carrying with it an undeniable weight of authority and grandeur.

{Sin Point Gained: Looked up to +102,849}
{Sin Point Gained: Exalted +103,038}

chapters.title: Chapter 299: Begone
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Venerated +102,869}
{Sin Point Gained: Looked up to +102,849}
{Sin Point Gained: Exalted +103,038}
Waves upon waves of sin points flooded in.
Seeing the numbers, Vritra almost stumbled in the air. Just by his entrance he had earned more than five hundred thousand Sin Points.
His goal of earning vast numbers of points wasn’t too far, and as people’s faith in the God of Mercy increased...
’I wonder if one day I can earn up to one million sin points just by speaking a single word, this is so damn nice.’
Barely stopping a grin from spreading on his face, Vritra landed on the ground and looked at the arrangement Monk Shitless had made along with the guards.
Although there wasn’t any arena this time, they had spread lots of seats all around the outside of the entrance of the kingdom, so managing a lot of people there was no longer a problem.
"Haa, such an attention seeker you are, why do you always go around with such a large crowd?" Just then a familiar annoyed voice sounded, as Onest flew from the distance.
But just as he was about to land, hundreds upon hundreds of objects such as eggs, rotten fruits, slippers flew towards him while the people shouted in rage.
"Thot begone!! Get lost, don’t you dare snatch our God again."
"This beggar bastard is here again, everyone, hit his face, his face."
"Ughh, his face is so ugly, I need to wash my eyes with acid now. God, please allow us to butcher this thief bastard."
All sorts of curses rained down on Onest even before he could set his foot down on the ground.
"Haha, the people here sure love you a lot. So this is the respect you earned as a respectful thief, huh." Vritra enjoyed Onest’s situation and the Sin Points rain.
{Sin Point Gained: Protected +104,923}
{Sin Point Gained: Cared for +103,204}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +104,826}
"What the hell? Make them stop, how am I going to do my duty like that? And have these people gone crazy?" Onest felt shivers hearing so many curses at once.
"..." Vritra didn’t speak for a while. When the number of sin points he was receiving started to decrease, he gestured towards Monk Shitless.
"Calm down everyone, this thief has turned to a new flower—uh, plant? Leaf? Whatever, he is a changed man and now a servant of our God of Mercy, so it is fine." Monk Shitless spoke in a loud voice.
"Ah, so he is a servant of our God now? You should have told us sooner haha." The people finally calmed down.
"Ha! As if you gave me the time to speak anything. And what servant, I am no one’s serv—"
Onest was feeling truly enraged but he suddenly paused when seeing the expressions of people change again, so he added:
"Yes yes, I am the servant of the Great God of Mercy, all hail the God!!"

Soon everyone took their seats. Vritra, just like before, sat on one side of a table where he was going to take the interviews, and now people were even more enthusiastic about becoming his servant, not just because of the money.
The three ladies sat beside Vritra though they were just watching the show for now, while Onest sat far away from them all.
And so the interviews began. Just after a few minutes, a few slaves in ragged clothes walked out from the crowd, nearly half were men, some women, and even a few kids.
The oldest man in the group, who looked to be around 50, stepped in front of the group and spoke in a hesitant voice: "G-God, can you help us?
We want to be free, sob... those monsters had already killed two of the kids. If we stay there none of us will survive."

All these slaves worked for a rich family. Two of the kids got ill and instead of treatment those poor children were worked to their death. Even to their last moments they suffered from inhumane pain.
"Hmm..." Vritra pondered for a moment then he added: "Return to that house, point at that family and decide whether you want them to die and disappear or be arrested.
In any case you would be free. Take their money so you all can have a better life."
"T-Thank you God..." all the slaves bowed before Vritra, who gestured towards a guard to bring them to the house.

"Yes, God. If they decide to forgive that criminal family then I will arrest them, and even if they disappear, it won’t be a problem." The guard understood his task. He quickly booked a few rides and took all the slaves with him.
{Sin Point Gained: Prayed to +106,052}
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +105,983}
Vritra watched as vast amounts of sin points flooded just because of a single sentence. After the guard and slaves left, he resumed the interviews.
This was definitely the best way to gather Sin Points. Onest didn’t want to get cursed at again by so many people, so he maintained his distance.
Meanwhile, Monk Shitless was still controlling the entire event, teaching the crowd different things.
Before long more slaves appeared. The White Kingdom was full of slaves and getting rid of slavery is an almost impossible task.
Though if someone like Yennefer tried, it might not be so hard, but she can’t interfere in the kingdom’s matters too much unless the entire kingdom is in grave danger.
It might also be because of her that demons had yet to start the war.
Vritra had sent Psyche with the previous group of slaves, this time he sent Hellmancer when they asked for his help.
More and more people started to arrive there, not for the job but to see a God performing his miracles, cheering him, and feeling happy that someone could finally stop slavery.
Within just an hour, more than five groups of slaves had asked Vritra for help and he helped them all either by repenting their owners or just killing them off.
’I wish the next few days as an agent just go by this comfortably. Anyway, I will only look at the sin points after collecting them for a few more days.
Haa, it feels so bad to not be able to use the Gacha to get more of those OP abilities.’ He thought as he rejected another person and Monk gave them 2 gold coins.
Ghost and Ghoul were tasked to keep surveillance of the surrounding area.
The two soul wraiths were flying through the outer parts of the White Kingdom where the exiled humans lived.
Then they flew into the Night Forest, their presence couldn’t be sensed.
Their duty had started the moment Vritra had arrived near the gates.
Around two and a half hours had passed when they sensed a change in the surroundings.
Both flew silently through the darkness and suddenly paused when they saw an army of demons approaching.
There were at least a few thousand demons, their levels ranging from First Legion rank to Second and even a few Third Legion ranked commanders.
Without wasting a moment they sent a mental command to Vritra and waited for his orders, while at the same time, more danger approached from another side.

Onest didn’t want to get cursed at again by so many people, so he maintained his distance.
Meanwhile, Monk Shitless was still controlling the entire event, teaching the crowd different things.
Before long more slaves appeared.
The White Kingdom was full of slaves and getting rid of slavery is an almost impossible task.
Though if someone like Yennefer tried, it might not be so hard, but she can’t interfere in the kingdom’s matters too much unless the entire kingdom is in grave danger.
It might also be because of her that demons had yet to start the war.
Vritra had sent Psyche with the previous group of slaves, this time he sent Hellmancer when they asked for his help.
More and more people started to arrive there, not for the job but to see a God performing his miracles, cheering him, and feeling happy that someone could finally stop slavery.
Within just an hour, more than five groups of slaves had asked Vritra for help and he helped them all either by repenting their owners or just killing them off.
’I wish the next few days as an agent just go by this comfortably.
Anyway, I will only look at the sin points after collecting them for a few more days.
Haa, it feels so bad to not be able to use the Gacha to get more of those OP abilities.’ He thought as he rejected another person and Monk gave them 2 gold coins.
Ghost and Ghoul were tasked to keep surveillance of the surrounding area.
The two soul wraiths were flying through the outer parts of the White Kingdom where the exiled humans lived.
Then they flew into the Night Forest, their presence couldn’t be sensed.
Their duty had started the moment Vritra had arrived near the gates.
Around two and a half hours had passed when they sensed a change in the surroundings.
Both flew silently through the darkness and suddenly paused when they saw an army of demons approaching.
There were at least a few thousand demons, their levels ranging from First Legion rank to Second and even a few Third Legion ranked commanders.
Without wasting a moment they sent a mental command to Vritra and waited for his orders, while at the same time, more danger approached from another side.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Battle of Mercy
paragraphs: Vritra frowned slightly as he saw the scene of the demon army.
Just this big of an army was definitely not here for war, but it seemed they were here either to probe or finish some sort of mission.
’And what great timing for a mission, just when I was stationed here. Doesn’t seem like a coincidence to me.’
He thought, and just then he received another report from Bob, who was keeping an eye inside the kingdom.
A few hundred men from the Slave Beast Gang wearing their uniforms were rushing in his direction at the same time.
’Oh, does this mean both parties are here to get rid of me?
They wouldn’t have sent such big armies just to kill me, but to slaughter everyone present here to put fear in the hearts of all the people in the kingdom.’ Vritra concluded.
He was sure that the Slave Beast Gang and the demons were definitely connected somehow, but this was not the time to think about all that.
In fact, it was time to farm experience points and even more Sin Points.
"Get ready, demons and Slave Beast Gang are approaching. Mom, Diana, Fiona—you are free to kill them all and do not worry about your safety, I will take care of that.
So go all out, don’t hide any of your abilities and just get stronger. Leave the rest to me." Vritra said.
He could use the Misty Essence Mythic Halo so no one could see their abilities or true identities as Succubus Queen, Phoenix Queen, or the Goddess.
"As for you, just continue with your work, good job." Vritra spoke to Shitless, who nodded and ran towards the crowd, ready to resume his job.
Onest also sensed the presence of approaching enemies soon, he flew towards Vritra with a frown.
"Did you sense it as well?" he asked.
"Yes, don’t worry, the enemies aren’t too strong. I can take care of them." Vritra said confidently.
"Huh? Why did you suddenly become so diligent? Shouldn’t I send the signal back to the base?" Onest asked.
He could sense a few powerful presences among the enemies whose levels might even be higher than his own.
"There is no need for that, just protect the people." Vritra said, as he slowly started floating in the air.
"EVERYONE BE SILENT!!"
Monk Shitless’s voice thundered through the place as everyone became silent and listened carefully.
"THOUSANDS OF DEMONS AND THE SLAVE BEAST GANG ARE APPROACHING TO STOP OUR GOD AND TO KILL ALL OF US!!"
Just as he spoke, all the people panicked but before it could turn into a stampede Shitless added:
"BUT DON’T YOU WORRY, OUR GOD WILL KILL THEM ALL, HE WILL PROTECT US. SO PRAY TO THE GOD OF MERCY!!"
Monk Shitless spoke, as all the people began to cheer Vritra on.
Vritra, the three ladies, Onest and all the shadow wraiths got ready for the approaching battle.
Since the soul wraiths couldn’t be shown openly, Vritra would just use the Misty Essence Mythic Halo to influence everyone.
Finally, dust flew around and the ground started shaking, distant roars of the approaching demons became louder and louder while the clanking sound of their weapons filled the area.

The people were traumatized upon seeing so many bloodthirsty demons and members of the Slave Beast Gang, their prayers paused as fear crept into their hearts and even running away didn’t seem to be an option now.
"Watch, don’t be afraid, they are all weak."
Vritra said as he created two large axes from dust, looking extremely heavy and dangerous.
His calming voice spread through the crowd as everyone became silent and only focused on him.
His presence brought confidence and a feeling of rage in their bodies, a rage to retort and be free.
Vritra’s body broke into countless clones, half of which rushed towards the Gang members while the other half rushed towards the demons.
It was all just for show from the shadows the soul wraiths would be the ones claiming the kills.
He himself rushed towards the Night Forest, while the three ladies went to kill the Gang members first and Onest stood in front of the public as the last line of defence.
ROAAARRRRRRRRR
Several deafening roars sounded as waves of demons rushed towards the crowd.
But just then a wave of dust storm swept through as Vritra’s figure flashed through it, striking the demon at the front with all his strength.
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification (2%)]
A bluish energy flooded through his veins and entire body as Vritra’s strength soared. Under the expecting gaze of the crowd, Vritra slashed at the demons.
WHOOOOOOOSH
The wave of energy cut through the air and then sliced off the bodies of more than thirty demons at once, their levels well around the middle of 2nd Legion rank.
Their bodies were cut into several pieces as the destructive energy wreaked havoc through their bodies, giving them no chance to heal.
While Hellmancer finished the kill as waves after waves of messages popped in front of Vritra.
{Sin Point Gained: Worshipped +135,287}
{Sin Point Gained: Idolized +134,985}
{Sin Point Gained: Prayed to +135,064}
[You have killed a level 2584 Demonic Golem.]
[You have killed a level 2392 Demonic Golem.]
[You have killed a level 2642 Demonic Golem.]
[+Exp]
[+Exp]
[You have levelled up!!]
[You have levelled up!!]
[You have levelled up!!]
[You have gained 20 Stat Points.]
[You have gained 20 Stat Points.]
[You have gained 20 Stat Points.]
[You have gained 20 Allocation Points.]
[You have gained 20 Allocation Points.]
Like a wild beast, Vritra brutally tore through their bodies while the demons didn’t even have the time to register anything when they came out of the Night Forest.

The Dark Knight, Hellmancer and all other soul wraiths worked discreetly as they killed one demon after another, while Ghost, Ghoul, Bob, and Bobby started killing the Gang members along with the three women.
The crowd watched the one-sided slaughter in awe, although most of the details were hidden by Vritra, they could still clearly see the bloodbath.
Two large white wings appeared behind Diana as she took out two daggers.
Holy energy swirled around her body as she flew through the crowd of men, slicing off their heads.
Her sacred body was covered in blood as she started slicing them into pieces, killing the humans.
Fiona and Vanessa saw that Diana and the four soul wraiths could easily handle the humans, so they changed their targets and rushed towards the demons.
An air of sweet smell flew through the air and all the demons that smelled it became absent-minded.
Right at that moment Vanessa would chop their bodies with her sword.

She used her abilities as the Succubus Queen—two horns appeared on her head, two wings on her back and a long tail with a pointy tip. The beautiful seductress was going all out as her level started climbing up.
Fiona’s body was covered by flames as she transformed into her phoenix form.
She even used the energy of the First Phoenix Queen and then shot out enormous pillars of flames that engulfed the demons and burned them down until their bodies disappeared completely.
The soul wraiths were also collecting the souls of all the dead creatures, whether humans or demons, as the brutal battle continued.
